body: Home Popular News feed Reels Экономика Интервью Общество Спорт Назначения Происшествия Культура president.uz 17 сентября в Намангане Шавкат Мирзиёев выступил на III международном форуме «От бедности к процветанию». Глава государства отметил, что на фоне геополитической, экономической и социальной нестабильности в мире, а также из-за последствий изменения климата темпы глобального экономического роста замедлились, что в свою очередь привело к увеличению числа малоимущих. В столь сложный период в Узбекистане борьба с бедностью возведена в ранг государственной политики. Все усилия нацелены на то, чтобы каждый человек мог в полной мере раскрыть свой потенциал. В обновлённой Конституции закреплено, что размеры пенсий, пособий и социальной помощи не могут быть ниже минимальных потребительских расходов. Благодаря последовательным реформам 7,5 млн человек выведены из состояния бедности, а в 2024 году её уровень снижен до 8,9%. До конца года поставлена задача уменьшить показатель до 6%. Существенную роль сыграл рост экономики в 2 раза. Ожидается, что доход на душу населения по итогам года достигнет $3500. На основе апробации новых инициатив и изучения передовой мировой практики сформирована модель Нового Узбекистана по сокращению бедности. Введены адресные социальные реестры, в период пандемии на бесплатные лекарства и социальные выплаты направлено в общей сложности $8 млрд. Это позволило не допустить попадания 5,2 млн граждан в «ловушку бедности» и предотвратить экономическую рецессию. Также внедрена система работы в разрезе махалли – на самом низовом уровне. С каждой семьёй ведётся индивидуальная работа, выделяются необходимые ресурсы для наращивания доходов. Ежегодно на благоустройство махаллей, улучшение жизни людей и развитие инфраструктуры предпринимательства направляется $2,5–3 млрд. Для повышения доходов сельских жителей на 235 тысячах гектаров сокращены площади под хлопком и зерновыми, а гражданам выделены участки по 30–50 соток. Это стало важным шагом к росту доходов 800 тысяч человек. «Благодаря столь масштабным усилиям Узбекистан стремится досрочно выполнить взятое обязательство — сократить бедность вдвое к 2030 году. Более того, сегодня мы готовы определить ещё более высокую планку: к 2030 году по международным критериям в Узбекистане есть все возможности полностью искоренить абсолютную бедность, и мы обязательно этого добьёмся, – подчеркнул президент. 3388 Share Telegram Facebook
title: К 2030 году в Узбекистане есть возможность полностью искоренить абсолютную бедность — президент

Лойиҳада таъкидланишича, айрим ҳайдовчиларнинг ҳаракат қоидаларига риоя этмаслиги — хусусан, қарши йўлга чиқиши, светофорнинг тақиқловчи сигналига бўйсунмаслиги ёки белгиланган тезликдан ортиқ ҳаракатланиши — оғир оқибатли ЙТҲларнинг кўпайишига олиб келмоқда. Шунингдек, ҳайдовчиларнинг қоидаларга бефарқ муносабати, ҳаракат маданиятига амал қилмаслиги ва бошқа йўловчиларга ҳурматсизлик кўрсатиши ҳолатлари ҳам кундан-кун ортиб бораётгани қайд этилган. Таклифга кўра, агар ҳайдовчи бир ой ичида 10 марта қуйидаги қоидабузарликларни содир этса: тезликни 40 ёки 60 км/соатдан ортиқ оширса; тақиқловчи светофор чироғига ёки назоратчининг тақиқловчи ишорасига қарамай йўлни кесиб ўтса; ПЙҚга зид равишда қарши йўлга чиқса ёки бошқа йўловчиларни хавф остига қўйиб, аварияли ҳолат яратса, у ҳолда охирги қоидабузарлик учун қўшимча тартибда 6 ойга ҳайдовчилик гувоҳномасидан маҳрум этилади. Вазирликнинг таъкидлашича, қонуннинг қабул қилиниши ҳаракат қоидаларига қатъий риоя этилишини таъминлайди ва оғир оқибатли ЙТҲларнинг олдини олишга хизмат қилади. Лойиҳа муҳокамаси 25 сентябргача давом этади. 773 Share Telegram Facebook

body: Photo: Darren Carroll / Usopen.org World No. 2 Elena Rybakina , who will officially become World No. 1 on Monday, defeated World No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the 2026 U.S. Open final. The 2026 U.S. Open women’s singles tournament has come to an end. This final echoed the 2026 Australian Open final, with the same result. Of their 18 matches, Rybakina and Sabalenka have played seven finals. In the opening set at Arthur Ashe Stadium, Rybakina looked more confident, especially on return. Sabalenka struggled to counter the Kazakhstani’s backhand. Rybakina consistently neutralized Sabalenka’s powerful serve with her crosscourt shot. In turn, the Kazakhstani’s serve was difficult for her opponent to handle when it wasn’t an ace. After breaking in the fifth game, Rybakina didn’t give her opponent a chance to break back. The Kazakhstani sealed the set in 44 minutes on her second set point, 6-4, echoing the score of the first set in Melbourne. In the second set, the two leaders of women’s tennis continued to demonstrate high-level attacking play, with both having chances to take the set. Although both players had break points, neither managed to convert one for a long time. At a crucial moment in the 10th game, Rybakina saved two set points to level at 5-5. But she then lost two consecutive games. Sabalenka sealed the set 7-5 in 56 minutes on her third set point. The 2026 Australian Open story repeated itself: 1-1 and a deciding set, continuing the thrilling match. In the third game, the Kazakhstani broke her opponent and then held serve to make it 3-1. She later secured another break in the seventh game to seal the 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 victory in 2 hours, 21 minutes, confirming her status as World No. 1 and claiming her first U.S. Open title. The U.S. Open is an annual hard-court tournament and the last of the four Grand Slam events on the tennis calendar. The total prize pool for this year’s New York major is $108 million, the largest in Grand Slam history. body: Céline Dion makes long-awaited return to stage in Paris Published September 11, 2026 17:44 Tanat Kozhmanov Senior Editor t.kozhmanov@kursiv.media canada france music Photo: x.com/popbackupp, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova Céline Dion , the renowned Canadian singer whose French- and English-language hits have earned her a huge fan base worldwide, is preparing for a major return to live performance in Paris, The Guardian reported. The artist has not performed regularly since 2022, when she revealed that she had been diagnosed with a rare neurological disorder called stiff-person syndrome. However, on March 30, Dion announced a series of concerts in the French capital, immediately drawing the attention of fans worldwide. Paris authorities expect more than 30,000 fans to attend her sold-out comeback shows. The long-awaited event has already drawn visitors to Paris, while public karaoke events across France are celebrating her return. Thanks largely to her successful French-language albums, Dion has long enjoyed enormous popularity in France. As the singer revealed in her 2024 documentary «I Am: Céline Dion,» her condition has caused severe muscle spasms, difficulty walking and other limitations in her daily life. After several years away from regular live performances, Dion’s health has stabilized enough for her to return to the stage. However, she continues to take precautions to protect her health while rehearsing and performing. Demand for the concerts has been exceptionally high, with millions of people registering for access to the ticket presale. Fans of Dion’s French- and English-language hits are traveling to Paris not only from across France but also from North America and other parts of the world. The series of sold-out concerts is also expected to provide a significant boost to hotels, restaurants and other tourism businesses in the Paris region. Share Link copied
title: Céline Dion makes long-awaited return to stage in Paris

body: Photo: Shutterstock, photo editor: Dastan Shanay Kyrgyzstan has, for the first time in its history, established domestic production of its national currency, the Kyrgyz som. Previously, som banknotes had been printed exclusively abroad for more than 30 years, according to the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic. Notably, the first banknotes were printed during celebrations marking the 35th anniversary of Kyrgyzstan’s independence. «In recent years, pursuant to the instructions of the President of the Kyrgyz Republic, the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic has consistently and systematically worked to establish its own production of the national currency,» the central bank noted . The first banknotes produced domestically were in denominations of 20 and 50 som. «This marks another important step toward strengthening Kyrgyzstan’s economic self-reliance and state sovereignty,» the central bank said. body: Kazakhstan’s QR payments go abroad Published September 11, 2026 15:36 Svyatoslav Antonov Senior Journalist of the Business News department s.antonov@kursiv.media economy kazakhstan QR code Kazakhstanis will be able to pay for purchases with QR codes in China and India / Illustration by Kursiv.media, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova The National Bank is working to expand QR payment access for Kazakhstanis in China, India, the UAE and several other countries by mid-2027. According to National Bank Deputy Chairman Binur Zhalenov , who took part in the Central Asia Fintech Summit 2026, the regulator is continuing work to enable cross-border payments for Kazakhstanis through their banking apps. Zhalenov said the National Bank has signed agreements with 11 countries — including China, India, the UAE, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan — to enable cross-border payments. He said the system is expected to be operational in China by the end of the year, with other countries following in phases starting mid-2027. According to the official, the agreements will allow Kazakhstanis to pay for goods and services in other countries simply by scanning a QR code through their bank’s app. They can also generate their own code so residents of those countries can pay them. The commission for such payments will be determined by the individual bank processing the transaction. Meanwhile, not all retail outlets in Kazakhstan have yet updated their static QR code stickers to support the unified QR code. According to Zhalenov, if a terminal does not accept such payments, it constitutes a violation. Share Link copied
title: Kazakhstan’s QR payments go abroad

body: Mongolia’s president stuns social media with 20 bench presses Published September 11, 2026 15:28 Aset Smagulov LifeStyle Journalist a.smagulov@kursiv.media Photo: Akorda, photo editor: Dastan Shanay Mongolian President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh , 58, has unexpectedly demonstrated his strength during a visit to a military unit. He took off his jacket, lay on a bench and completed 20 consecutive bench press repetitions. The video quickly went viral, with users discussing how much weight the president was lifting. Kursiv LifeStyle looks at how Mongolian officials surprise the internet. The video was recorded when Khurelsukh visited Mongolian Armed Forces Unit 084. The president, dressed in semi-formal attire, put the barbell back on the stands after the set as if nothing unusual had happened. Посмотреть эту публикацию в Instagram Публикация от DD.NEWS (@d_d_news) Reports say that Khurelsukh bench-pressed 100 kilograms for 20 repetitions. However, several users examined the markings on the weight plates and estimated that the total weight could have been either 80 or 90 kilograms. However, even at those weights, completing 20 consecutive repetitions is still an impressive result, especially for a 58-year-old. Ukhnaa Khurelsukh is not exactly a typical politician. Alongside his political career, he is into heavy music and plays guitar in a rock band he founded after turning 50. He is also a motorcycle enthusiast and even founded a Harley-Davidson fan club in Mongolia. He served in the military in his youth and has been interested in sports and strength training for many years. Netizens also remembered former Mongolian President Battulga Khaltmaa , who served from 2017 to 2021. Посмотреть эту публикацию в Instagram Публикация от Battulga Khaltmaa (@battulgakh) Battulga is also known as a sports enthusiast. When he was young, he was part of Mongolia’s national sambo team. He later took up judo and bodybuilding. He also headed the Mongolian Judo Association and trained regularly even while in office. Previously, Kursiv.media reported that Kazakhstan and Mongolia discussed establishing a direct highway link between the countries when Khurelsukh visited Astana on a state visit. Share Link copied
title: Mongolia’s president stuns social media with 20 bench presses

body: Princess Diana’s ‘Revenge Dress’ set for December auction Published September 11, 2026 14:17 Tanat Kozhmanov Senior Editor t.kozhmanov@kursiv.media auction fashion Photo: Martin Keene, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova The black dress Princess Diana wore to a Vanity Fair fundraising event for the Serpentine Gallery in London on June 29, 1994, the same night then- Prince Charles publicly admitted to infidelity, is set to go up for auction this December, Euronews reported. Sotheby’s will offer the dress in New York with an estimated value of $150,000 to $300,000. Before the sale, it will be exhibited in London from Sept. 18 to 24, then travel to Hong Kong and Geneva before arriving in New York on Dec. 2. Part of the proceeds will be donated to NHS Lothian Charity on behalf of the Royal Edinburgh Hospital. Designed by Christina Stambolian , the fitted, off-the-shoulder dress became one of Princess Diana’s best-known fashion statements. Diana reportedly initially planned to wear a Valentino dress to the event but changed her outfit after details of her original choice became public. At the time, the media described the striking black dress as a statement of independence and confidence, and it became known as the «Revenge Dress.» Share Link copied
title: Princess Diana’s ‘Revenge Dress’ set for December auction

body: Kazakhstan to move away from bank-centric economy, official says Published September 11, 2026 14:00 Zhanbolat Mamyshev Senior Journalist of the Business News department zh.mamyshev@kursiv.media economy kazakhstan national bank Timur Suleimenov, Kazakhstan’s central bank chairman / Photo: Serikzhan Kovlanbayev, photo editor: Dastan Shanay Timur Suleimenov , governor of the National Bank of Kazakhstan , believes the country needs to move away from a rigid, bank-centric financial system in which banks account for 80% or more of the entire financial sector. Read also: High deposit inflows meet rising credit stress in Kazakh banking . He said brokers, dealers, insurance companies and the stock market as a whole should roughly double their share of the financial system, from the current 20% to 40% over time. «In other words, if banks are active, then the economy exists, and funding for the economy exists. If banks have problems, then we have no other source,» he told reporters on the sidelines of Astana Finance Days 2026 , answering a question about why he wants to reduce Kazakhstan’s reliance on banks. In his view, the current structure is «neither good nor bad.» He said it is common in many countries, particularly those with civil-law systems and transition economies. However, the National Bank governor said he wants to see Kazakhstan gradually change that structure. «Therefore, we now want to gradually and intelligently move away from the situation where we have 80% — let it be 60%, and the rest will be the securities market. Will it be KASE, AIX or perhaps Alatau City? Will it be standard stocks and bonds, or tokenized assets, or assets from new finance? Time will tell, but it’s crucial that we attract all available funding sources for the development of the real sector and not be bank-centric,» Suleimenov said. Developing the broader financial system Suleimenov stressed that the policy is not intended to work against banks, but rather to develop Kazakhstan’s financial system as a whole. «This is normal logic — it’s not directed against banks. Let the entire pie grow. Let the absolute share of banks grow, but the share of other funding instruments should also be added,» he said. The goal, he said, is to ensure that businesses and the broader economy have access to a wider range of funding sources rather than relying predominantly on bank financing. Binance and the export of financial services Suleimenov also said Binance Kazakhstan has been operating in the country for several years, serving clients from Kazakhstan. He said the company could now attract up to 3 million international clients to Kazakhstan. The clients would reportedly come from the Middle East, Eastern Europe, Southeast Asia and other regions to access financial services in Kazakhstan. As a result, Kazakhstan could generate a significant export of financial services. A memorandum of understanding has already been signed, and the parties are now discussing a roadmap for its implementation. Share Link copied
title: Kazakhstan to move away from bank-centric economy, official says

body: New York honors 9/11 victims, recreates Twin Towers with drones Published September 11, 2026 12:39 Daniil Devyatkin Senior LifeStyle Journalist d.devyatkin@kursiv.media drones new york usa Photo: instagram.com/skyelementsdrones, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova On the eve of the 25th anniversary of the tragic attack on New York’s World Trade Center on Sept. 11, drones recreated the Twin Towers in the sky over New York Harbor. Kursiv LifeStyle found out what the light installation looked like. According to the New York Post , the installation used 2,977 drones, with each light representing a person killed in the 9/11 attacks. The drones recreated the outline of the Twin Towers, which stood in New York City until 2001. Посмотреть эту публикацию в Instagram Публикация от Sky Elements Drones (@skyelementsdrones) The light installation appeared over Lower Manhattan on Sept. 9, near the «Tribute in Light» art installation . Created in remembrance of the attack, «Tribute in Light» has become an annual event, sending powerful beams of light into the sky from the former World Trade Center site. Historical context On Sept. 11, 2001, terrorists hijacked four passenger planes. Two crashed into the World Trade Center towers in New York City, another struck the Pentagon and the fourth crashed in Pennsylvania after passengers and crew attempted to overpower the hijackers. To date, it remains the deadliest terrorist attack in U.S. history in terms of death toll. The World Trade Center’s Twin Towers were built in the 1970s and, before the attacks, were considered among New York City’s most recognizable landmarks. Share Link copied
title: New York honors 9/11 victims, recreates Twin Towers with drones

body: Photo: youtube.com/@PBSNewsHour, photo editor: Dastan Shanay With midterm elections looming, the Republican Party is working to mobilize its supporters, promising a brighter future and touting economic relief. But what stood out most at the party’s gathering in Dallas this time was Vice President JD Vance ’s speech, Reuters reported. Addressing 20,000 members of the MAGA movement, Vance framed Republicans as the voice of common sense, leading many observers to view his remarks as more of a presidential nominating speech than a typical midterm rally. The 42-year-old vice president fed off an energized crowd, some of whom broke into chants of «48, 48,» referring to the possibility of Vance becoming the nation’s 48th president. Vance, however, downplayed the talk, steering attention back to the more immediate task of winning November’s midterm elections. Still, the moment underscored how Republicans are increasingly looking past Trump — who is barred from seeking a third term — toward the party’s next generation of leadership, with Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio frequently mentioned as top contenders. body: Don’t сall it a hijab: The history of the kimeshek, the white wimple of the steppe Published December 17, 2025 19:06 Gulnar Tankayeva Central Asia culture kazakhstan Not a hijab: The unique story of the Central Asian kimeshek / An archival photo shows Kazakh women wearing kimesheks and a girl with her head uncovered Kazakh ethnic designer Tilek Sultan sparked debate after receiving a custom order for a kimeshek, a traditional head covering for married Kazakh women with children. While researching, Sultan noticed confusion between the kimeshek and the Islamic hijab . He raised the subject online, receiving swift, heated responses. A question that sparked confusion Sultan said a woman asked if he made kimesheks. When he asked if it was for a married woman, she said her daughter was a college student. She said her family wanted the girl to wear a «Kazakh hijab.» The designer told her that only women who have given birth wear a kimeshek. He added that her daughter did not need one yet, but he would make one when appropriate. The woman then asked if a kimeshek and hijab were the same. At the kimeshek exhibition in Astana / Photo: Nazerke Shynarbek That question, Sultan later explained, highlighted the underlying confusion between cultural and religious forms of dress — a confusion that is becoming more common and that he feels is important to address. What is a hijab? The word «hijab» comes from Arabic and means barrier or veil. Islamic teachings require girls who reach puberty to dress modestly around non-relatives. Guidance states that hijab clothing must cover the body, be loose and opaque, be modest in style, and be distinctly feminine. Kazakh blogger Aiym Altynbekova in hijab / Collage by Kursiv.media, photo editor: Serikzhan Kovlanbayev Sultan emphasized that the hijab is a religious practice tied to age and faith, not to marital or maternal status, drawing a distinction with the kimeshek. What is a kimeshek? By contrast, the kimeshek is rooted in Central Asian tradition rather than religious doctrine. Sultan explained that a Kazakh woman traditionally begins wearing a kimeshek only after childbirth — a simple rule with deep cultural meaning. Kimeshek / Photo: A screenshot from Tilek Sultan’s Instagram page Ethnographer Olga Sukhareva , an expert in Central Asian traditions, documented this. Unmarried girls wore headgear showing their hair. Women covered their hair. This pattern appeared in the cultures of Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, and Turkmen, each with its own variations. Sukhareva said this contrast symbolized a woman’s new life stage. Motherhood, not marriage, marked the change This nuance leads to another common misconception. The switch from a maiden’s headdress to a woman’s covering traditionally happened after motherhood, not marriage. Sukhareva noted this marked a woman’s new social status. Wimple / Photo: Howtobecome.com Women celebrated this transition quietly. The new mother received a kimeshek — a practical garment (designed to keep hair out of the way) for caring for a child and household. A tradition older than Islam Sultan highlighted that much of the steppe woman’s wardrobe predated Islam’s arrival in the region. The kimeshek is one such example. He argues that recognizing the difference between religious dress and cultural tradition is essential for preserving heritage and preventing the loss of meanings handed down through generations. Share Link copied
title: Don’t сall it a hijab: The history of the kimeshek, the white wimple of the steppe

body: Elena Rybakina during the 2026 U.S. Open semifinal / Photo: Usopen.org World No. 2 Elena Rybakina , who will officially become No. 1 on Monday, defeated American Coco Gauff (No. 4) 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 in the 2026 U.S. Open semifinal. The head-to-head score between 27-year-old Rybakina and 22-year-old Gauff was 1-1 before this semifinal, with both matches played on hard courts in Toronto. In 2022, the American won 6-4, 6-7 (8-10), 7-6 (7-3). In 2026, the Kazakhstani won 5-7, 6-2, 6-2. The match, which took place on Sept. 10 local time, also went the full three sets. Notably, Gauff again took the first set, continuing the pattern that had emerged between the two. Unlike Gauff, Rybakina was playing her first U.S. Open semifinal and looked tentative at Arthur Ashe Stadium in the opening set. She committed 18 unforced errors and hit just one ace, compared with Gauff’s four. After dropping her serve in the sixth game, Rybakina lost the next two games on Gauff’s serve to love. The set ended 3-6, with Rybakina unable to break back. In the second set, Rybakina managed to stabilize her game. She made fewer errors and grew in confidence. Breaking in the fourth game and holding her next service game, Rybakina took a 4-1 lead. But she then lost three games in a row, allowing Gauff to level at 4-4. Yet she still managed to seal the set, breaking in the 10th game, 6-4. The crowded stadium loudly supported Gauff, yet Rybakina held her nerve to secure the match 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 in 2 hours, 8 minutes. Rybakina led in aces, 5-4, committed two double faults to Gauff’s four and won 88 points to her opponent’s 82. In the final, Rybakina will face Aryna Sabalenka for the title. The Belarusian won here in both 2024 and 2025. Meanwhile, Kazakhstan’s Damir Zhalgasbay continues his U.S. Open Juniors doubles run with American Safir Azam and has reached the semifinals. Rybakina is the only Kazakhstani player left in the tournament’s main draw. The U.S. Open is an annual hard-court tournament and the last of the four Grand Slam events on the tennis calendar. The total prize pool for this year’s New York major is $108 million, the largest in Grand Slam history. body: Photo: youtube.com/@EuroNCAP_forsafercars, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova Three Chinese models – the Aion UT, Geely E2 and Leapmotor B05, the latter known in China as the Lafa 5 – received the maximum five-star rating under Euro NCAP’s new 2026 protocols. Another new model, the Cupra Raval, received five stars only when equipped with the optional Safety Pack, according to CarNewsChina . Chinese manufacturers are strengthening their positions According to Euro NCAP, Chinese manufacturers are increasingly eager to participate in European crash tests. Since 2021, the number of Chinese models submitted for testing has increased almost tenfold. Meanwhile, Chinese-made cars already have a significant presence in the European market. Euro NCAP data shows that cars made in China account for 7% of new car sales in the EU and almost 10% in the U.K. «Today’s results clearly demonstrate that Chinese carmakers are still working hard to match the high standards expected by European consumers,» Euro NCAP Program Director Aled Williams said. How the cars performed The Leapmotor B05 achieved the best crash protection score of the three Chinese models, at 92%. The model also scored 77% for crash avoidance and 89% for post-crash safety. In the side-impact tests, the B05 received the maximum scores for both barrier and side-pole impact tests. Photo: Leapmotor, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova The Geely E2 scored 86% for crash protection and 95% for post-crash safety. Euro NCAP experts particularly highlighted its use of physical controls and its standard child presence detection system. However, the automatic emergency braking system showed some inconsistencies. Photo: Geely, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova The Aion UT scored 91% for crash protection and 88% for post-crash safety. Testers pointed out the car’s heavy reliance on the central touchscreen for key driving controls and the relatively low accuracy of its speed-limit recognition system, which correctly identified speed limits in 68% of cases. Photo: GAC, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova What about the Cupra? The Cupra Raval received four stars in its standard configuration. With the optional Safety Pack, its rating increased to five stars. The package improves the performance of active safety systems, particularly at low speeds and when driving through intersections. As a result, the Raval with the optional equipment scored 72% for safe driving, compared with 58% for the standard version. Photo: Cupra, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova For Chinese manufacturers, these results are especially significant given their growing presence in Europe. The Aion UT, Geely E2 and Leapmotor B05 can now boast the maximum Euro NCAP rating under the new 2026 protocols. body: Photo: Shutterstock, photo editor: Dastan Shanay Representatives of the Fédération Internationale de l’Automobile (FIA) have arrived at the Sokol International Circuit in the Almaty region, where the FIA Central Asia Drifting Cup will be held from Sept. 25 to 27. The event will be the first official FIA regional drifting tournament in Central Asia. The track gears up for a historic tournament Inspectors are assessing the complex, the track and the readiness of its infrastructure. In addition, specialists are conducting technical inspections of the participants’ cars. Photo: Sokol International Circuit Particular attention is being paid to the safety of the cars and their compliance with FIA technical regulations. The federation published the official sporting and technical regulations for the tournament in July. The FIA Grade 2 Sokol International Circuit near Almaty is hosting the event — its first international drift stage. What awaits drivers The tournament program includes practice sessions, qualifying and tandem battles in an elimination format. During qualifying, judges will assess the drivers’ line, drift angle, speed and style. The best drivers will compete in tandem battles, with each participant taking turns as the lead and chase driver. Entries closed on Sept. 1, with no limit on entries. The individual and team winners will be determined based on the final results. The FIA previously noted that the new tournament should help develop drifting in Central Asia, raise sporting and organizational standards and attract new drivers to international competitions. Previously, Kursiv Cars reported that Kazakh mixed martial artist Shavkat Rakhmonov continued to master drifting. body: Photo: Threads.com/@sartaygoi, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova Four smart crosswalks have been deployed in the Almaty region. One of them was installed in Esik at the 5.3-kilometer mark on the Esik-Saymasay road, at the entrance to the Altynshy cottage community. The new system uses modern technology and artificial intelligence to alert drivers when pedestrians enter the roadway. How the new crosswalk works The crosswalk’s main feature is a system that detects pedestrians entering the roadway and alerts drivers. The technology is especially useful in the dark, when it is more difficult to spot a person on a conventional crosswalk. Smart crosswalks have been installed as part of a pilot project. Four such systems currently operate in the region. According to police, the project primarily aims to improve pedestrian safety, including that of children. «Another smart crosswalk is planned to be installed in the region before the end of the year. The introduction of modern road infrastructure facilities will help improve traffic safety, in particular by ensuring the safety of children and pedestrians,» the Almaty Region Police Department said. Drivers are urged to be more attentive around crosswalks and comply with safety requirements. body: Kazakhstan to produce Indian tractor brands in $120 million deal Published September 10, 2026 14:57 Svyatoslav Antonov Senior Journalist of the Business News department s.antonov@kursiv.media agriculture india kazakhstan Photo: Facebook.com/SonalikaInternational, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova Kazakhstani industrial company SP BKM signed an agreement with India-based International Tractors Limited to assemble and produce tractors. The agreement is worth $120 million. During the Kazakhstan-India Business, Trade and Investment Forum, SP BKM and Indian agricultural machinery manufacturer International Tractors Limited reached an agreement to assemble and locally produce Sonalika and Solis tractors in Kazakhstan. The arrangement includes supplies, assembly, a gradual increase in local content, sales and service of tractors and other agricultural machinery. SP BKM also signed an agreement with Indian defense startup Big Bang Boom Solutions Private Limited to cooperate on defense technologies, domestic security and dual-use solutions. The agreement aims to develop mutually beneficial projects. The business forum drew more than 110 participants from Kazakhstan, including around 65 companies from the engineering, agricultural, food and light manufacturing, pharmaceutical, construction, oil and gas, IT and logistics sectors. Kazakhstan plans to expand trade with India and increase exports. Some 95 commodity categories have been identified as having export potential worth $313 million, including products from the metallurgy, chemical, food, construction and engineering industries. Sonalika Tractors is India’s third-largest tractor manufacturer, with annual production of around 300,000 units. The group exports tractors and agricultural equipment to more than 150 countries, including 35 European nations. Big Bang Boom Solutions is an India-based defense-tech company headquartered in Chennai that develops counter-drone systems and electronic warfare equipment. SP BKM is owned by businessman Marat Yessimseitov , who runs businesses under the TransTechMash LTD umbrella. The group operates across the railway, defense, automotive and hospitality sectors, including Terra Motors and Holiday Inn Express Astana-Turan. Yessimseitov is also the founder of BESQARU, a company that produces wheeled and tracked armored vehicles. Share Link copied
title: Kazakhstan to produce Indian tractor brands in $120 million deal

body: How Kazakhstan is building data center industry from scratch Published September 8, 2026 19:00 Dariga Zaikinova Analyst at Kursiv Research data centers kazakhstan Photo: Unsplash, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova Driven by the global artificial intelligence boom, Kazakhstan’s government is spearheading an ambitious initiative to build a competitive data center industry almost from scratch, leveraging the country’s cheap coal-fired power generation. President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev designated 2026 as the Year of Digitalization and Artificial Intelligence, setting off a wave of sweeping legislative and infrastructure updates designed to attract high-tech foreign investments. A regulatory shield and energy incentives To signal its commitment to international investors, Kazakhstan recently enacted a comprehensive Digital Code , designating data centers as strategic state assets. This legislative shift replaces cumbersome construction permits with a streamlined notification-only system, while guaranteeing that national telecom operators will provide data centers with necessary network connectivity and traffic routing. Kazakhstan launched the region’s most powerful supercomputer. The official launch ceremony was attended by President Tokayev, July 2025 / Photo: Akorda.kz A critical component of this regulatory push is a novel 70/30 investment mechanism designed to upgrade the country’s aging power infrastructure . Under the new rules, modernized coal-fired thermal power plants can contract up to 70% of their newly generated capacity directly to data centers through long-term, fixed-price contracts. The remaining 30% is directed to the national grid, protecting tech facilities from rolling blackouts and power shortages. The Data Center Valley and global tech tie-ups The centerpiece of this digital expansion is the Data Center Valley project, located in the northern city of Ekibastuz near the GRES-1 power station. The government has expanded the project’s land allotment to 1,400 hectares, establishing a 300-megawatt substation with plans to scale capacity up to one gigawatt. The initiative has already captured the attention of major American tech players. Kazakh government recently finalized a strategic cooperation agreement with Firebird AI and chipmaker NVIDIA to establish an AI research laboratory and map out technical cooperation in the valley. Meanwhile, in the private sector, Akashi is constructing a 100-megawatt Tier IV facility in Astana, backed by a $90 million financing deal with the Eurasian Development Bank. Paper losses in the telecom sector While the digital infrastructure push gathers momentum, Kazakhstan’s domestic telecom sector recorded a seemingly paradoxical trend in the first half of 2026. Official state statistics registered a sudden loss of one million mobile internet subscribers in January. Photo: Shutterstock, photo editor: Dastan Shanay However, Kursiv Research notes that this drop was a purely administrative adjustment. A newly introduced state accounting methodology forced operators to separate mobile internet from general web services and purge dormant SIM cards that had not shown data traffic for over 90 days, revealing a healthier, more active subscriber base. title: How Kazakhstan is building data center industry from scratch

body: A comparison of Freedom Broker, Halyk Finance, BCC Invest and Alatau City Invest Published September 1, 2026 13:41 Altynbek Mukhamediyev brokers economy Deliya Aidaralieva, photo editor: Adelina Mamedova Retail investing in Kazakhstan is no longer a niche market. In the first quarter of 2026, the KASE Index gained 10.0% to 7,734.60 points, while retail investors accounted for 43.5% of equity trading volume. The market includes brokers licensed by the Agency for Regulation and Development of the Financial Market (ARDFM), AIFC companies licensed by the AFSA, and brokerage services available through banking apps. Terms and conditions vary significantly, from the range of exchanges and trading hours to commissions and cryptocurrency trading, so it is worth comparing them before opening an account. What criteria should be used when comparing brokers? Regulation and reliability. The country has two regulatory regimes: the national regime, with brokers licensed by the ARDFM, and the AIFC regime, which is governed by English law. Licenses should be checked against regulatory registries and exchange membership lists. Additional benchmarks include ratings and ownership structure. Available markets. KASE and AIX provide the basic market offering. Some brokers access international markets through a chain of foreign counterparties, while others use their own group’s infrastructure. Investment instruments. Stocks, bonds, ETFs, mutual fund units, IPOs, foreign exchange transactions, repos, derivatives and, starting in 2026, digital assets. Commissions. The broker’s commission is not the only cost to consider. Minimum transaction fees imposed by third parties, exchanges, depositories and custodians can significantly reduce returns on small investments. Service convenience. Online account opening, deposit and withdrawal speeds, and app quality. Analysis and support. Market reviews, investment ideas and training.
