body: Azerbaijan's Parliament warns of coordinated hybrid attacks against country 16 October 2026 10:45 (UTC+04:00) AzerNEWS Staff Read more Azerbaijan's emergence as a middle power under the leadership of President Ilham Aliyev, its assertive foreign policy, growing international standing, contribution to global energy security, strategic importance in regional transit corridors, and domestic political and economic stability have significantly increased the scale of hybrid attacks against the country by foreign actors. These assessments were included in a statement issued by the Azerbaijani parliament's Temporary Commission on Foreign Interference and Hybrid Threats in connection with hybrid attacks targeting Azerbaijan. The statement reads: “Against the backdrop of ongoing wars and tensions in our region, the Republic of Azerbaijan, widely regarded as an island of stability, has recently faced religious and ideological provocations, coordinated information operations, and cyberattacks on an unprecedented scale and in a synchronized manner. “Under the pretext of promoting various freedoms, our people's centuries-old national, spiritual, and multicultural values, as well as their religious beliefs, are being targeted. Harmful activities are being used to undermine society's understanding of truth and present foreign ideologies to our people as the right path. “Investigations conducted jointly with the relevant state authorities have established that influence operations, cyberattacks, and attempts to carry out terrorist acts and sabotage are aimed at manipulating public opinion, creating polarization within society, and undermining trust in state institutions. These activities are conducted through agents of influence and clandestine organizations operating both inside and outside the country. In the digital sphere, they involve hacker groups, foreign media outlets, genuine and fake accounts, and bots. “We must express our regret that forces hostile to Azerbaijan, operating in friendly and neighboring countries, are injecting disinformation into digital platforms through channels that appear independent. Their objective is to create divisions along ethnic, religious, and political lines within society. They seek to sow discord within the country, turn citizens with differing views against one another, incite violence, and weaken our state from within. “Actors behind hybrid threats use a method known as ‘computational propaganda’ to confuse public opinion and deepen social fragmentation. They encourage people to actively seek out false information that supports their existing views in the media and on social networks, believe it, and spread it among others. “Algorithm-driven content distribution creates ‘echo chambers,’ exposing users primarily to information that reinforces their existing beliefs, opinions, and worldviews. Through the algorithms used by digital platforms, posts designed to provoke emotional reactions among our citizens are disseminated to large audiences. “Furthermore, the mechanism known as ‘filter bubbles’ ensures that harmful content reaches audiences already susceptible to it and previously influenced in a particular direction. This increases the effectiveness of manipulation exponentially. “Within such an environment, these actors seek to use the infrastructure of digital platforms themselves, rather than resorting to conventional propaganda methods, to promote foreign values, undermine national stability, and divide our society from within. “Monitoring has also established that, despite the scale of malicious activities directed against Azerbaijan from certain centers, our Victorious People have demonstrated a resolute stance, refused to succumb to provocations, unequivocally supported the measures taken by the state, and continue to provide the necessary assistance in exposing divisive content and the individuals behind it. “We reiterate that the parliament's Commission on Foreign Interference and Hybrid Threats, the relevant parliamentary committees and structural divisions of the parliamentary administration, together with the relevant state institutions, are successfully countering these malicious hybrid attacks against our state and will continue to respond decisively to any future attempt. “Our commission also expresses its profound gratitude to citizens of friendly and neighboring countries who have condemned these anti-Azerbaijani activities and demonstrated a fair and principled position.” Tags: Azerbaijan Parliament war
title: Azerbaijan's Parliament warns of coordinated hybrid attacks against country

body: Armenia gives Russia three months to propose solutions for railway competitiveness 15 October 2026 17:29 (UTC+04:00) Akbar Novruz Read more Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan has announced that proposals aimed at improving the competitiveness of Armenia's railway system will be developed within three months, following discussions with Russian Railways chief Oleg Belozyorov. According to TASS, Pashinyan made the remarks during a briefing in Yerevan, stressing that Armenia does not fundamentally oppose the continued operation of its railway network under a Russian concession. "I have already stated that we have no fundamental objection to the Armenian railways being under a Russian concession. Our objective is to ensure that our railway system is competitive," he said. The Armenian prime minister explained that Yerevan's assessments suggest changing the existing concession management model, potentially by transferring railway management to a third party, could be a more effective approach. "As I noted during our conversation yesterday, our analyses indicate that, to achieve this goal, it would be more appropriate to alter the concession management model - specifically, by transferring management to a third party," Pashinyan stated. However, he emphasised that Armenia remains open to proposals from its Russian partners regarding the future of railway operations. "However, if our Russian partners claim to have a solution to this issue, let them present their proposals. At the conclusion of our discussions, I suggested: 'Very well, let us form a working group to find an answer—within three months—as to how the Armenian railway can be made competitive,'" he added. The remarks followed a meeting in Yerevan between Pashinyan and Belozyorov, Director General and Chairman of the Management Board of Russian Railways. During the meeting, the sides discussed potential reconstruction projects involving the Gyumri–Akhurik–Türkiye border railway section and the Arazdayan–Nakhchivan railway line. They also exchanged views on the opportunities that restoring these railway connections could create. Armenia's railway network is currently operated under a concession arrangement by South Caucasus Railway, a subsidiary of Russian Railways. body: Israeli President Herzog observes Knesset election voting in Azerbaijan 15 October 2026 15:13 (UTC+04:00) Ulviyya Poladova Read more Early voting for Israel’s Knesset elections, scheduled for October 27, has begun at Israeli diplomatic missions and representative offices abroad, Israeli Foreign Ministry’s press service reported. "Voting began today at Israeli embassies, consulates and diplomatic missions abroad ahead of the parliamentary elections to be held in Israel on October 27," the statement said. Under Israeli law, early voting at diplomatic missions abroad is open to Israeli citizens who are on long-term official assignments in the respective countries, as well as their family members. The Foreign Ministry noted that Israeli President Isaac Herzog, who is visiting Baku, observed the voting process at the Israeli Embassy in Azerbaijan. According to Israel’s Channel 12, Herzog said the elections were taking place after a difficult period for the country and described them as extremely important. He urged all citizens to exercise their right to vote. Herzog also stressed that elections are not a civil war but a genuine democratic process through which citizens can influence their lives and determine the direction in which their country is heading. It should be noted that the elections for the 26th Knesset are scheduled for Tuesday, October 27. Their outcome will determine the composition of the governing coalition and opposition, the next prime minister and the future of Israel’s 38th government. Image: Maayan Toaf/GPO Tags: Azerbaijan Israel Isaac Herzog
title: Israeli President Herzog observes Knesset election voting in Azerbaijan

body: Home Azerbaijan Chronicles of Victory: President Ilham Aliyev interviewed by Turkish A Haber TV channel on October 16, 2020 (PHOTO/VIDEO) Azerbaijan News 16 October 2026 07:00 (UTC +04:00) BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 16. The Azerbaijani Army launched a counter-offensive operation, later called the "Iron Fist", on September 27, 2020, in response to the large-scale provocation of the Armenian armed forces along the frontline. The 44-day second Karabakh war ended with the liberation of Azerbaijan’s territories from nearly 30-year Armenian occupation and the restoration of territorial integrity. President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev has been interviewed by Turkish A Haber TV channel on October 16, 2020. Trend presents the interview. - Greetings to all from A Haber. The eyes of the whole world are focused on the Karabakh region these days. Karabakh, which has been under Armenian occupation for 30 years, is experiencing a great tragedy, because despite the humanitarian ceasefire, Armenians continue to fire at civilians and the Azerbaijani army. Naturally, the Azerbaijani army does not leave these attacks unanswered and dealing heavy blows to the Armenian army. What is the latest situation in the region and what can be expected? We will learn the opinion of the President of Azerbaijan, Commander-in-Chief Mr. Ilham Aliyev. Mr. President, we express our deep gratitude to you, in particular, on behalf of A Haber. Thank you very much for receiving us. - Thank you. - Mr. President, of course, we will start our conversation with the situation in the region. Yesterday Armenia fired on civilians yet again. In Tartar, a cemetery was fired on and three of our Azerbaijani brothers became martyrs. What is your assessment of this attack? - This is yet another manifestation of Armenian fascism. Usually, whenever they are defeated on the battlefield, they fire on civilians. We saw this during the first Karabakh war. It was our loathsome neighbors who committed the Khojaly genocide. This time, seeing their helplessness in front of the Azerbaijani army on the battlefield and their inability to resist us in the occupied lands, they started targeting civilians again. Our citizens died as a result of this dastardly attack, both in Ganja and at the cemetery in Tartar yesterday... This is a place where people go for funerals, it is considered sacred to any person. But apparently there is nothing "sacred" for our loathsome neighbors. This is a crime against humanity, which once again demonstrates the predatory nature of Armenia. It also shows that such dastardly attacks cannot force us to deviate from our path, they cannot break the will of the Azerbaijani people. We will continue to restore our territorial integrity. - Of course, Azerbaijan acts very carefully and accurately in the issue of civilians. Until today, not a single civilian has been hurt among the Armenians. However, up to now 46 of our Azerbaijani brothers have become martyrs. Why does the West remain tight-lipped over these massacres? - Unfortunately, civilian casualties are continuing, there are already 47. A total of 222 civilians have been injured, about 2,000 houses have been either completely destroyed or seriously damaged. I have already said that we will avenge these people on the battlefield. We have never opened and are still not opening fire on civilians despite the fact that there have been attacks on Ganja and Tartar. Today, from 6 to 8 am – it is 9:10 now – more than 220 shells fell on Tartar, Aghdam, Goranboy and other districts. So these heinous attacks continue. Their main goal is to kill civilians, sow panic and fear among the population of Azerbaijan, stop us and achieve their dirty intentions. But they are seeing that this does not work out, and no matter how many shells fall, the citizens of Azerbaijan proudly live on their land and endure all these difficulties. They are united around one goal – to return Karabakh, to raise the flag of Azerbaijan in all the occupied lands and to restore our territorial integrity. As for your second question why the West is silent, we saw this during the first Karabakh war too. Armenia unleashed aggression against us, occupied our lands, committed genocide against our people, but sanctions were applied against Azerbaijan. At that time, in 1992 and 1993, the Western media formed such a perception that Azerbaijan was an occupier and aggressor, while Armenia was a victim of aggression. We are seeing this even today on a smaller scale, because it is no longer possible to deny and hide the truth. - Mr. President, at that time, in 1993, in particular, in November, a ceasefire was also announced. And it was also violated by Armenia, which massacred people. Today Armenia wants a ceasefire again. What is the purpose of the ceasefire – to stop the advance of the Azerbaijani army? - You know, this is their tactic. Armenia requested a ceasefire. Convinced that they could no longer defend the occupied lands on the battlefield, to hold on to them, they requested a ceasefire. We also received such an appeal – you know that Russia has undertaken this mission – and said that a ceasefire could be declared for humanitarian purposes, for the exchange of bodies and prisoners. However, at the same time, the Moscow statement indicated that it was necessary to resume negotiations on the substance of the issue. In addition, the format of the negotiations should remain unchanged. But apparently they wanted to take advantage of the ceasefire. Less than a day later this dastardly attack on Ganja was carried out. After that, they began to strike at our other cities and, in fact, grossly violated the ceasefire. So this is their tactic. Obviously, they needed a ceasefire in order to gather strength, take mobilization measures and launch new attacks on us, because after this ceasefire, they tried to occupy the settlement of Hadrut again and attacked it three times. And they were defeated all three times. Their intention is to return the lands they lost that do not belong to them and to continue their aggressive policy. - By the way, false propaganda is currently being conducted. They claim that Hadrut is still with them, they cannot accept it. - Yes, they are still engaged in this false propaganda. The Azerbaijani flag has been flying in Hadrut for several days now. The vast majority of the hills adjacent to Hadrut are under our control. If Hadrut had not been taken, it would have been impossible to take the villages of Khojavand district. We moved there only from the Hadrut direction. - Mr. President, since the announcement of the humanitarian ceasefire, transport planes have been constantly delivering missiles from Russia, in particular, to the Yerevan airport. This, in essence, is a crime. In particular, you talked about the closure of borders with Iranian President Rouhani and about the delivery of missiles with Russia. These weapons are provided free of charge. What would you like to say to Iran and Russia in this regard? - We do not have any information about the shipment of weapons from Iran to Armenia. On the contrary, I can say that Iran and Georgia have closed their airspace and land roads for the transportation of weapons to Armenia. In this regard, we would like to reiterate our gratitude to the Governments of Iran and Georgia. According to our information, weapons are being smuggled across Georgian territory by commercial and cargo planes. Armenia has recently purchased one plane. According to our information, it bought it for $30-40 million. It was purchased by wealthy Armenian businessmen living in Russia – Karapetyan, Abrahamyan and others. They are sending Armenians living in Russia to fight against us as mercenaries. body: Home Azerbaijan Society Azerbaijan adds AI principle to journalists’ code of ethical conduct Society News 16 October 2026 11:37 (UTC +04:00) Humay Aghajanova Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 16. A principle regarding the use of artificial intelligence (AI) has been added to the Code of Ethical Conduct for Azerbaijani Journalists, the Press Council member Mushfig Alasgarli said at the 9th Congress of Azerbaijani Journalists in Baku on Friday, Trend ’s correspondent reports from the event. He noted that, according to the proposal, media entities should adopt internal documents establishing rules for the use of AI systems within their newsrooms. "Under the new principles, the use of AI systems mustn't replace a journalist's initiative and judgment, editorial independence, or human oversight. Before publishing material produced with the aid of AI, a human journalist must verify its content, factual accuracy, and sources. The journalist and the editorial office bear personal responsibility for the published material. Furthermore, transparency must be ensured to keep the audience accurately informed. Any content, such as photos, audio, or video, generated by AI that could potentially mislead the audience must be appropriately labeled, and the public must be informed about its origin," he added. The 9th Congress of Azerbaijani Journalists is being held at the Rashid Behbudov Song Theatre. A total of 225 delegates have confirmed their participation in the congress. Candidates for membership on the Press Council’s Board of Directors have been determined based on nomination forms submitted by organizations that are members of the Press Council. Among the current members of the Board of Directors, Rashad Majid, Aflatun Amashov, Gulu Maharramli, Umud Rahimoghlu, Aydin Guliyev, Rauf Arifoghlu, Elchin Mirzabayli, Vusala Mahirgizi, Agil Alasgar, Jeyhun Musaoghlu, Algish Musayev, Akif Ashirli, and Yadigar Mammadli have requested not to include their names on the ballot. Consequently, changes are expected for 13 of the 23 seats on the Press Council’s Board of Directors. body: Home Azerbaijan Politics Azerbaijan's parliamentary commission warns of escalating hybrid attacks Politics Press release 16 October 2026 09:30 (UTC +04:00) Photo: wikipedia Alish Abdulla Parliamentary Correspondent Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 16. Azerbaijan’s Parliamentary Commission on Foreign Interference and Hybrid Threats issued a statement on the hybrid attacks directed at the country. According to the statement, the emergence of our state as a “middle power” under the wise leadership of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Ilham Aliyev, along with its resolute foreign policy, growing international standing, contributions to global energy security, strategic importance within regional transit corridors, and domestic political and economic stability, has led to a significant escalation in the scale of hybrid attacks launched against Azerbaijan by foreign actors. “Against the backdrop of ongoing wars and tensions in our region, Azerbaijan, often characterized as an ‘island of stability’, has recently been subjected to unprecedented and synchronized religious-ideological provocations, coordinated information operations, and cyberattacks. Under the guise of various freedoms, our nation’s centuries-old national-moral and multicultural values, as well as its religious beliefs, are being targeted. Furthermore, through malicious activities aimed at eroding the very concept of truth within society, they are being presented with ideologies alien to the Azerbaijani people as the correct path. Joint investigations with relevant state authorities have revealed that influence operations, aimed at manipulating public opinion, fostering societal polarization, and undermining trust in state institutions, as well as cyberattacks and acts of terror or sabotage, are being orchestrated by agents of influence and clandestine organizations both within and outside the country. In the digital sphere, these activities are carried out through hacker groups, foreign media outlets, real and fake accounts, and bots. Regrettably, hostile forces operating from the territories of friendly and neighboring countries are injecting disinformation into digital platforms via channels that appear independent, seeking to create rifts within society along ethnic, religious, or political lines. Their objective is to sow discord within the country, turn citizens with differing viewpoints against one another, incite violence, and undermine our state from within,” the statement noted. The statement added that actors behind these hybrid threats employ “computational propaganda” to confuse public opinion and deepen societal fragmentation. They encourage individuals, across media and social networks, to actively seek out, believe, and disseminate false information that aligns with their existing views. “Content distribution driven by algorithms creates an ‘echo chamber’ effect, ensuring that users encounter only information that reflects their own pre-existing beliefs, perspectives, and worldviews. Content designed to trigger emotional responses among our citizens is directed toward broad audiences through the algorithms embedded in digital platforms. Furthermore, through the mechanism of ‘filter bubbles,’ harmful content reaches only an audience already predisposed to receive it — those who have already fallen under a specific influence. This exponentially increases the effectiveness of such manipulation. In such an environment, the actors in question, without resorting to traditional propaganda methods, aim to promote alien values, undermine national stability, and fragment our society from within, all by leveraging the very infrastructure of these platforms. Monitoring efforts have also revealed that, despite the scale of the malicious activities directed against Azerbaijan from certain centers, our victorious people have maintained a firm stance; they have refused to be swayed by provocations, have unequivocally supported the measures taken by the state, and continue to provide essential assistance in exposing divisive content and the individuals behind it. We reiterate that the Parliamentary Commission on Foreign Interference and Hybrid Threats, along with relevant committees, the structural units of the Secretariat, and appropriate state institutions, are successfully countering these malicious hybrid attacks directed against our state; furthermore, we will ensure that no future hostile action goes unanswered. Our commission also expresses its profound gratitude to the citizens of friendly and neighboring countries who have condemned these anti-Azerbaijan activities and maintained a fair stance,” the statement emphasized. body: Home Azerbaijan Society Baku Network discusses foreign influence with students (PHOTO/VIDEO) Society News 15 October 2026 17:13 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Trend News Agency Firaya Nurizada Correspondent Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 15. The Baku Network Research and Analysis Public Union held a meeting with students from Baku State University as part of the project “Supporting increased vigilance against harmful foreign influences and fake news,” supported by the State Support Agency for Non-Governmental Organizations of Azerbaijan. In his speech, Deputy Director of Trend News Agency and a trainer for the project, Sahil Karimli, said that ideological threats in the modern world have become a reality faced by every country. According to him, Azerbaijan’s independent policy, based on the principles of statehood and national interests, is a source of concern for certain external circles. Azerbaijan does not yield to external pressure and does not align its policies with the interests of individual countries. “Especially after its victory in the Second Karabakh War, Azerbaijan has been developing even more actively. Pursuing a policy based on the principles of statehood and national interests naturally causes concern among many external forces. Therefore, we must remain vigilant in the face of ideological threats,” he stated. In addition, Karimli also drew attention to recent attempts to politicize the decision on a standardized school uniform. He noted that students, as representatives of the next generation, should approach such issues with particular sensitivity and remain vigilant in the face of various forms of influence. “We are seeing the decision on a school uniform become politicized. Young people must be vigilant about these issues and accurately assess what is happening,” he emphasized. Director of the “Baku Network” Expert Platform, Honored Journalist Elchin Alioghlu, noted in his speech that ideological threats and harmful influences are not abstract concepts. According to him, sowing doubt in people’s minds can make them more susceptible to external influences. In this regard, the impact of everyday social media platforms on people’s worldviews and choices should be taken into account. “The social media platforms you use every day are not just a form of entertainment. The videos you watch and the photos and videos you share provide information about who you are, what your interests are, and what you think. All of this is gathered in one place,” he noted. Elchin Alioghlu emphasized that young people are one of the primary targets of various influence mechanisms. He also noted the importance of exercising caution when using artificial intelligence tools and social media platforms. In his view, users should be aware that when they use technology, their behavior and choices may also be subject to analysis. In addition, Elchin Alioghlu addressed the danger that harmful external influence could lead to social division. He noted that the erosion of social unity has a negative impact on the formation of a unified national consciousness. “When society becomes divided, a unified national consciousness ceases to exist. Harmful ideology can originate from both the East and the West. Therefore, it is wrong to view this issue from only one perspective,” he emphasized. Speaking about Azerbaijan’s historical development, Elchin Alioghlu recalled that it was in Azerbaijan that women in the East were first granted the right to vote. He noted the importance of young people thoroughly studying national values and historical achievements, as well as adopting a critical approach to the information they receive. On October 15, President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev received Hakan Fidan, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye. This was reported by the Press Service of the President of Azerbaijan. During the meeting, the sides exchanged views on recent developments in Azerbaijan-Türkiye relations. The meeting was held on the sidelines of the 7th Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia (CICA) in Baku. The summit is being held under Azerbaijan's chairmanship. The meeting is reviewing progress since CICA launched its transformation in 2022, as well as the results of Azerbaijan's chairmanship, which has focused on strengthening the organization and advancing practical cooperation among member states. The event brings together heads of state and government, delegations from CICA member and observer states, observer organizations and partner institutions. The summit provides an opportunity to discuss ways to advance dialogue and strengthen trust among member states amid a complex international environment marked by growing interstate tensions, including in Asia, outbreaks of conflict and emerging hotspots of instability. The Baku Declaration is expected to be the summit's main political document. It will highlight Azerbaijan's role as CICA chair and reflect the initiatives launched and activities carried out across various areas over the past two years. body: Home Azerbaijan Politics Azerbaijan, Belarus discuss strategic partnership, interparliamentary ties Politics Press release 15 October 2026 15:23 (UTC +04:00) Photo: National Assembly of the Republic of Azerbaijan Alish Abdulla Parliamentary Correspondent Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 15. Issues concerning the strategic partnership between Azerbaijan and Belarus, including the expansion of interparliamentary relations, were discussed at a meeting between the Speaker of the Parliament of Azerbaijan, Sahiba Gafarova, and the Speaker of the House of Representatives of the National Assembly of the Republic of Belarus, Igor Sergeyenko. According to the Press and Public Relations Department of the Azerbaijani Parliament, the meeting took place on October 15 as part of Igor Sergeyenko’s visit to Baku. During the meeting, the parties highlighted Azerbaijan’s successful hosting of the 7th Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia (CICA) at a high level, as well as the country’s successful chairmanship of the organization. The meeting emphasized that relations between Azerbaijan and Belarus continue to develop steadily across all areas, based on sincere friendship, constructive dialogue, mutual trust and support, and are characterized by a strategic partnership. The parties particularly underlined the importance of friendly relations between the two countries’ heads of state, reciprocal visits and high-level meetings in bringing bilateral relations to their current level of development. Moreover, it was also noted that Azerbaijan and Belarus maintain successful cooperation within international organizations and provide mutual support to each other on several issues discussed at international forums. The parties expressed satisfaction that interparliamentary relations are likewise developing in line with the current level of bilateral relations. Sahiba Gafarova recalled her official visit to Belarus in June 2024, as well as the meetings held during that visit. She also referred to the visits to Azerbaijan by Natalia Kochanova, Chairwoman of the Council of the Republic of the National Assembly of the Republic of Belarus, and Igor Sergeyenko, Speaker of the House of Representatives of the National Assembly of the Republic of Belarus. The Speaker of the Azerbaijani Parliament noted that visits and meetings conducted at the level of parliamentary leaders demonstrate the current level of relations between the legislative bodies of the two countries and reflect the consistent development of interparliamentary cooperation. It was further noted that parliamentary friendship groups operating within the legislative bodies of both countries maintain regular contacts, while Azerbaijani and Belarusian lawmakers participate in events organized in each other’s countries. These exchanges contribute to maintaining ongoing communication and strengthening ties between the two parliaments. The meeting also highlighted cooperation between the legislative bodies of Azerbaijan and Belarus within international parliamentary organizations, including the Inter-Parliamentary Union, the CIS Parliamentary Assembly and the Asian Parliamentary Assembly. The parties emphasized the importance of continuing their activities and cooperation within these international platforms. At the conclusion of the meeting, the parties exchanged views on other issues of mutual interest. body: Home Central Asia Kazakhstan Kazakhstan, Russia test electronic waybills on Astana-Moscow freight route Kazakhstan News 15 October 2026 15:06 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Ministry of Transport of Kazakhstan Alyona Pavlenko Journalist, International Desk Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 15. Kazakhstan and Russia have launched their first pilot freight shipment using an electronic consignment note (e-CMR) along the Astana-Moscow route as part of Transport Week in Astana, the Kazakh Ministry of Transport reported. The shipment is being carried out within a pilot project of the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU). According to the ministry, the launch marks a practical step toward the digitalization of international road freight transport and closer cooperation among EAEU member states. "The use of e-CMR will reduce document processing costs, speed up information exchange among participants in the transportation process, provide real-time access to cargo status and reduce reliance on paper-based documentation," the ministry said. The ministry noted that Kazakhstan attaches particular importance to digitalizing the transport sector and developing transport and logistics infrastructure. Joint initiatives with EAEU partners are aimed at unlocking the country's transit potential, improving the efficiency of international freight transport and strengthening transport connectivity across Eurasia. The pilot project will test the use of electronic consignment notes on the Kazakhstan-Russia route and lay the groundwork for expanding digital cooperation in international transport. According to the ministry, transit cargo volumes passing through Kazakhstan increased by 13.1% in the first nine months of 2026. body: Then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro looks on as he addresses the media at Miraflores Palace, in Caracas, Venezuela August 2, 2024. (Leonardo Fernandez Viloria via Reuters Connect) NEW YORK—Today, in a federal courthouse in Manhattan, Judge Alvin Hellerstein formally presented a charge of conspiracy to commit torture against Nicolás Maduro, the former dictator of Venezuela, and his wife Cilia Flores. The charge, to which both pled not guilty, has been added to the existing charges of narcoterrorism, drug trafficking, and weapons offenses against the defendants, whose trial is scheduled to begin in June 2027. The torture allegations include the use of state repression against political opponents and perceived dissidents in Venezuela, including at least three Americans, and form part of the charges in a superseding indictment unsealed by the US Department of Justice on October 8. The conspiracy to commit torture charge is significant for several reasons. Torture has a widely recognized definition , which is accepted by almost all United Nations (UN) member states. Torture is prohibited under international law, including by the UN Convention Against Torture , to which the United States and Venezuela are parties. Unlike the previous charges against Maduro, which center on alleged international drug trafficking and related weapons offenses, the new charge directly addresses the alleged use of state repression to quash political dissent in Venezuela—which international institutions have been documenting and reporting on for more than a decade, but with little prospect for redress. Because US federal law expressly provides for extraterritorial jurisdiction over torture committed abroad when the alleged offender is present in the United States, the new charge creates a potential and rare avenue for criminal accountability for acts of torture allegedly committed in Venezuela. What has happened in the case so far While efforts to hold Maduro accountable have come to a head only this year, the case against him has been long in the making. The indictment against Maduro and members of his inner circle was unsealed in 2020 . It alleged a wide-ranging drug trafficking operation aided by guerrilla groups and spanning multiple countries, dating back to 1999. In recent years, various co-conspirators pled guilty after extradition or surrender . As for Flores, she was first charged with drug trafficking and weapons offenses in December 2025. To date, the core allegations revolve around Maduro and Flores weaponizing parts of Venezuela’s law enforcement, the military, and the judiciary to protect a system of repression and corruption that allowed the couple and their inner circle to profit from drug trafficking and the theft of public funds. Following the US military capture of Maduro and Flores in January of this year, a superseding indictment was unsealed. The physical presence of Maduro and Flores in a US federal courtroom, which had initially seemed improbable, is now a reality. The prosecution can therefore proceed with the defendants in the dock. New York City police officers stand outside the Daniel Patrick Moynihan United States Courthouse where ousted Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores faced a new indictment accusing them of torturing political opponents and US citizens to retain their grip on power, in New York City, US, October 15, 2026. (Eduardo Munoz via Reuters Connect) Torture charges are added In the superseding indictment unsealed by the Department of Justice on October 8, a count alleging “conspiracy to commit torture” was added to the charges against Maduro and Flores. This new count was brought under the US extraterritorial federal torture statute, Section 2340A of Title 18 of the United States Code. The indictment notes that in an effort “[t]o undermine Venezuelan democracy and entrench themselves in power,” Maduro and Flores “presided over a system of repression that relied on violence against political opposition, arbitrary detention, and the torture of detainees, including United States citizens.” The indictment also details the types of torture allegedly used during their rule, including “electric shock, asphyxiation, rape, forced nudity, prolonged isolation, starvation, punishment cells,” as well as psychological torture “such as threats to harm and kill victims’ families, including children.” In one grim example, prosecutors allege that Maduro caused the death of a Venezuelan opposition figure. In 2018, the now-deceased dissident had returned to Venezuela after attending the UN General Assembly in New York. Maduro’s forces arrested him and transferred him to the headquarters of Venezuela’s intelligence agency, where he was ordered to be tortured. Just three days after his arrest, Venezuelan authorities reported that the man had jumped to his death from the tenth floor of the facility. The indictment also alleges that Maduro and Flores tortured three unnamed US citizens. Dozens of Americans were wrongly detained during Maduro’s time in office. Upon release, many have recounted the torture they faced behind bars in media interviews and in civil lawsuits for damages. One potentially important figure in the case is former Venezuelan general Hugo Carvajal, who was arrested in Spain in 2021, extradited to the United States, and then pled guilty last year to drug trafficking charges. He led Venezuela’s military intelligence agency, previously known as the Dirección de Inteligencia Militar (DIM), for close to a decade under the rule of Hugo Chávez, Maduro’s predecessor. The revised indictment repeatedly mentions the involvement of the successor organization to the DIM, the Dirección General de Contrainteligencia Militar (DGCIM), in alleged acts of torture. While the testimony of victims is critical in establishing the responsibility of perpetrators in criminal trials, prosecutors often rely on insider witnesses to establish the chain of command or speak to the structures and networks that substantiate a conspiracy charge. If Carvajal testifies against Maduro , his statement could be key. Closing the impunity gap for Venezuelans The torture charges represent an important step forward in securing accountability for Venezuelans, for whom justice pathways so far have been quite limited. Since 2014, Venezuelan state forces led by Maduro have carried out waves of repression and violence against civilians. Following its establishment by the UN Human Rights Council in 2019, the Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela (FFM) has published multiple reports detailing how Maduro-led forces committed crimes against humanity in Venezuela, including extrajudicial killings, enforced disappearances, arbitrary detentions, and torture. Key to this repression is the role of the colectivos —pro-regime armed civilian groups tasked with repressing protests and political dissent and notorious for their brutality. Maduro’s human rights violations and atrocity crimes have received widespread condemnation by the UN , regional bodies in Latin America and Europe , countries around the world, and leading civil society organizations. Much of this is recounted in the unsealed indictment containing the torture charge. Despite the extensive documentation of the Maduro regime’s crimes, justice efforts have been halting. The International Criminal Court launched a preliminary examination into Maduro’s crimes in February 2018 and an investigation in November 2021, but this process has not yet resulted in any arrest warrants for Maduro or his regime officials. Argentina took the bold step of issuing arrest warrants in September 2024 for Maduro and other regime officials for crimes against humanity, but he remained at large. With Maduro and Flores now in US custody, and co-conspirators in the indictment potentially cooperating with US authorities, prosecutors may have a chance to hold Maduro and Flores to account

body: President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Meets with Wang Yi_Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China IPC Visas English EN 简体中文 Français Español Русский عربي HOME THE MINISTRY Main Responsibilities The Minister Principal Officials Departments Related Agencies NEWS Top Stories Speeches Diplomatic Schedule New Ambassadors MFA News Spokesperson’s Remarks News from Overseas Missions RESOURCES Communiqués Foreign Policies In Focus Diplomatic History Diplomatic Figures Protocol Affairs Map of China OVERSEAS MISSIONS Chinese Embassies Chinese Consulates General Chinese Missions to International Organizations and Representative Offices Abroad COUNTRIES AND REGIONS Asia Africa Europe North America South America Oceania ABOUT CHINA Home Minister’s Activities President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan Meets with Wang Yi Updated: October 14, 2026 23:40 On October 14, 2026 local time, President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan met in Baku with Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi. Ilham Aliyev asked Wang Yi to convey his warm greetings and best wishes to President Xi Jinping, and expressed gratitude to President Xi Jinping for sending a special representative to attend the CICA Summit in Azerbaijan. Ilham Aliyev noted that China and Azerbaijan enjoy deep political mutual trust and mutually beneficial economic cooperation, and the Azerbaijan-China comprehensive strategic partnership is flourishing. The consensus he reached with President Xi Jinping during his visit to China last year has been effectively implemented, ushering the bilateral relations into a new stage. Azerbaijan appreciates China’s long-standing strong support for Azerbaijan’s economic and social development and the safeguarding of its national interests. It regards China as a leading force in the rise of the Global South, and believes Chinese modernization has set an example for developing countries including Azerbaijan. Azerbaijan is one of the first countries to support and participate in the Belt and Road Initiative. A series of cooperation projects between the two countries have yielded fruitful results. Azerbaijan is ready to strengthen strategic alignment with China and continue to expand cooperation in energy, connectivity and other fields. Azerbaijan welcomes more Chinese enterprises to invest and do business in the country. The two countries should make good use of the mutual visa exemption to further promote their people‐to‐people exchanges. Azerbaijan firmly adheres to the one‐China principle, fully supports the series of global initiatives put forward by President Xi Jinping, appreciates China’s consistent commitment to upholding international fairness and justice and multilateralism, and is ready to strengthen coordination and cooperation with China in international and regional affairs. Wang Yi conveyed President Xi Jinping’s sincere greetings to President Ilham Aliyev, and said that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, China and Azerbaijan have enhanced mutual understanding, mutual trust and mutual support, and the bilateral relations have maintained a strong development momentum with broad prospects. China congratulates Azerbaijan on its thriving national development under the leadership of President Ilham Aliyev, supports Azerbaijan in following a development path suited to its national conditions, and is ready to strengthen cooperation with Azerbaijan and other relevant parties on the Middle Corridor (Trans-Caspian International Transport Route), and continue to serve as a reliable long‐term strategic partner in Azerbaijan’s development. China appreciates Azerbaijan’s long-standing strong support on issues concerning China’s core interests, and supports Azerbaijan in safeguarding its independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity. China’s development represents the increasing force of the Global South and the growing strength of developing countries. China is ready to maintain close coordination and cooperation with Azerbaijan to jointly safeguard the common interests of Global South countries. China supports Azerbaijan in playing an important role in multilateral platforms such as CICA and in international affairs, and making greater contributions to peace and stability of the region and the world. During the visit, Wang Yi also held talks with Azerbaijani Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov.

body: اظهارات تازه دونالد ترامپ درباره شکست سریع ایران، ادامه فشارهای تحریمی واشنگتن و نگرانی از امنیت کشتیرانی در منطقه، بار دیگر تنش میان تهران و واشنگتن را در کانون توجه قرار داده است. همزمان، نوسانات قیمت نفت و افزایش هزینه حملونقل دریایی نشان میدهد که پیامدهای این تقابل به عرصه نظامی و سیاسی محدود نمانده و بازارهای جهانی انرژی را نیز تحت تأثیر قرار داده است. پ ، پـ تبلیغات تبلیغات جنگ ایران و آمریکا؛ روز دویست و بیست و یکم ؛ آنچه باید بدانید حریمهای تازه آمریکا علیه ایران: وزارت خزانهداری آمریکا روز پنجشنبه از تحریمهای جدید مرتبط با ایران خبر داد. این اقدام در ادامه سیاست فشار اقتصادی دولت دونالد ترامپ علیه تهران انجام شده است. آتشگرفتن نفتکش در محدوده دریای عمان: ارتش ایران از آتشگرفتن یک نفتکش متخلف در محدوده دریای عمان خبر داد. این حادثه در شرایطی رخ داده که امنیت تردد کشتیها در اطراف تنگه هرمز به یکی از محورهای اصلی تنش میان ایران و آمریکا تبدیل شده است. بررسی گزینه استفاده از «مادر همه بمبها» علیه ایران: گزارشی منتسب به سیانان درباره بررسی گزینه استفاده از بمب سنگین آمریکایی GBU-43/B، معروف به «مادر همه بمبها»، در طرحهای احتمالی حمله به ایران منتشر شده است. با این حال، تا زمانی که گزارش و جزئیات آن مستقلاً تأیید نشود، نباید بررسی احتمالی این گزینه را به معنای تصمیم قطعی واشنگتن برای حمله دانست. ترامپ: نمیدانم آمریکا با چه کسانی در ایران مذاکره میکند: دونالد ترامپ در اظهاراتی درباره مذاکرات با ایران ابراز تردید کرد که طرف آمریکایی دقیقاً با چه افرادی در تهران در حال گفتوگو است. احتمال کاهش محدودیتها علیه ناوگان سایه نفتکشها: گزارشی از بررسی امکان کاهش برخی محدودیتهای آمریکا علیه نفتکشهای موسوم به ناوگان سایه منتشر شده است. این اقدام احتمالی میتواند بر حملونقل نفت کشورهای تحت تحریم، از جمله ایران، اثر بگذارد؛ اما به معنای لغو عمومی تحریمهای نفتی ایران نیست. افزایش هزینه حمل نفت در مسیرهای بینالمللی: رویترز گزارش داده است هزینه حمل نفتکشها در برخی مسیرهای بینالمللی بهشدت افزایش یافته است. خطر حمله به کشتیها، افزایش هزینه بیمه و تغییر مسیر شناورها از عوامل این وضعیت هستند و تنشهای خاورمیانه نیز در افزایش ریسک کشتیرانی نقش دارند. ترامپ: ایران را خیلی سریع شکست میدهیم: دونالد ترامپ در اظهاراتی تازه درباره ایران مدعی شد آمریکا میتواند این کشور را در صورت ازسرگیری جنگ، «خیلی سریع» شکست دهد. او همچنین بر جلوگیری از دستیابی ایران به سلاح هستهای تأکید کرد. این اظهارات لحن تهدیدآمیز واشنگتن را در شرایط تداوم تنشها برجسته میکند. نشست امنیتی کابینه نتانیاهو درباره ایران: بنیامین نتانیاهو و فرماندهان ارشد دستگاه امنیتی اسرائیل، امشب نشستی محدود برای بررسی مسائل امنیتی برگزار خواهند کرد. در این نشست، با توجه به وضعیت آمادهباش در برابر ایران، تمامی جبههها و احتمال تشدید تنش در جبهههای حساس بررسی خواهد شد. تبلیغات ۱۳:۳۲:۳۳ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ عراقچی: درباره حضور آمریکا در منطقه پیرامونی ایران حساسیت داریم عراقچی در گفتوگو با خبرگزاری آرمنپرس درباره حضور نیروهای آمریکایی در منطقه و پروژه «مسیر ترامپ برای صلح و رفاه بینالمللی» (TRIPP) گفت: «درباره هرگونه حضور آمریکا در منطقه پیرامونی خود نگرانی و حساسیت داریم.» عراقچی با اشاره به رایزنیهای تهران و ایروان افزود: با دوستان ارمنی خود مستقیماً در تماس هستیم و میدانیم که هیچ اقدامی علیه امنیت ایران انجام نخواهند داد. وزیر امور خارجه تأکید کرد رایزنیها با مقامهای ارمنستان ادامه خواهد یافت. او همچنین به سفر آرارات میرزویان، وزیر خارجه ارمنستان، به تهران و دیدار مسعود پزشکیان با نخستوزیر ارمنستان اشاره کرد. ۱۳:۱۶:۳۹ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ منابع خبری از حمله موشکی انصار الله یمن به بندر ینبع در عربستان سعودی خبر میدهند ۱۲:۴۷:۵۱ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ دیدار پزشکیان با نخست وزیر گرجستان رئیسجمهور در حاشیه حضور خود در ارمنستان با «ایراکلی کوباخیدزه» دیدار و گفتوگو کرد. ۱۲:۰۱:۰۴ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ سخنگوی ارتش: طرحهای جدیدی برای عقب راندن ناوهای آمریکایی در روزهای آینده اجرا میشود امیر سرتیپ اکرمی نیا: ترامپ تنگه هرمز را به نام خود کرده اما نیروهایش جرات نزدیک شدن به آن را ندارند. ناوهای آمریکایی بیشتر از 500 کیلومتر از سواحل ما فاصله دارند. طرحهای عملیاتی جدید در دستور کار داریم که شناورهای دشمن آمریکایی را مجبور به فرار به بیش از این نیز خواهد کرد. نیروی دریایی ارتش اشراف کامل عملیاتی بر دریای عمان دارد. ۱۱:۴۸:۰۴ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ وزیر خارجه روسیه به ایران میآید وزارت خارجه روسیه اعلام کرد لاوروف روز ۱۹ اکتبر (۲۷ مهر) سفری به تهران خواهد داشت و با وزیر خارجه ایران دیدار و گفتگو خواهد کرد. ۱۱:۲۴:۳۷ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ کارمندان موسسات مالی جهانی در عربستان دورکار شدند سه منبع آگاه به رویترز: موسسات مالی جهانی، از جمله جیپیمورگان چیس و دویچه بانک، پس از تشدید نگرانیهای امنیتی در عربستان به کارمندان خود مستقر در عربستان اجازه دادهاند تا از خانه کار کنند. سرمایهگذاری آمریکایی فرانکلین تمپلتون بهطور موقت دفتر ریاض خود را تعطیل کرده. ۱۱:۰۷:۰۳ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ پزشکیان: آثار زیستمحیطی جنگ در ایران باید با جدیت بیشتری مورد توجه جامعه جهانی قرار گیرد رئیسجمهور در اجلاس سران هفدهمین کنفرانس اعضای کنوانسیون تنوع زیستی: در منطقه ما از جمله در ایران آثار زیستمحیطی درگیریهای نظامی باید با جدیت بیشتری مورد توجه جامعه جهانی قرار گیرد. جنگ و جنگ تجاوزکارانه که ایالات متحده و اسرائیل در منطقه ما به راه انداختند و آسیب به تاسیسات صنعتی و انرژی، آتشسوزیها، انتشار آلایندهها و آلودگی خاک و آب موجب تهدید اکوسیستمهای طبیعی و از بین رفتن زیرساختهای حفاظتی شده است که طی سالها تلاش برای حفاظت از تنوع زیستی فراهم شده بود. این امر تنها مسئله داخلی یا محدود به مرزهای سیاسی این کشور نیست، طبیعت مرز سیاسی نمیشناسد. گسترش آلودگیهای آب، خاک و هوا نیز در پشت مرزها متوقف نمیشود؛ از این رو آسیبهای ناشی از جنگ نیز مسائلی با ماهیت جهانی هستند و به راهحلهای بینالمللی نیاز دارند. ۱۰:۵۴:۰۸ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ اشاره مبهم ترامپ درباره وضعیت جسمانیش ترامپ: اگر مواد مصرف نکنی یا سیگار نکشی مشکلی نیست. ولی من مشکلات جدی دیگری دارم. من چند مشکل بسیار جدی دارم، اوه، احتمالاً با این حرف، خودم را به دردسر انداختم. ۱۰:۵۲:۰۵ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ جنگ ایران کرایه نفتکشها را ۵ برابر کرد آژانس بینالمللی انرژی: هزینه حمل نفتکشهای بزرگ از خلیج فارس به آسیا به ۳۶ دلار در هر بشکه رسید؛ بیش از ۵ برابر قبل از جنگ. حاشیه سود پالایشگاههای آسیایی نیز در سپتامبر منفی شد. ۱۰:۱۱:۴۷ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ منابع عربی از شنیدهشدن صدای انفجار در شهر الدمام عربستان و توقع فعالیت در فرودگاه ملکفهد این شهر خبر میدهند ۱۰:۱۰:۳۳ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ فؤاد حسین: در جریان جنگ اخیر امریکا و ایران، عراق حدود ۶۰ میلیارد دلار خسارت دید وزیر خارجه عراق در دیدار با همتای ایتالیایی خود با اشاره به پیامدهای اقتصادی تداوم درگیری میان امریکا و ایران، اعلام کرد که عراق در جریان جنگ اخیر میان امریکا و ایران، متحمل خسارتهایی در حدود ۶۰ میلیارد دلار شده است. ۰۹:۵۰:۴۰ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ دیدار پزشکیان با دبیرکل سازمان ملل و نخستوزیر ارمنستان ۰۹:۴۹:۵۰ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ دیدار محرمانه سفیر آمریکا با رقیب اصلی نتانیاهو شبکه آمریکایی اماسناو گزارش داد سفیر آمریکا در اسرائیل طی روزهای اخیر دیداری محرمانه با گادی آیزنکوت، از رقبای اصلی بنیامین نتانیاهو داشته است. جزئیاتی درباره محتوای این دیدار و محورهای گفتوگوی دو طرف منتشر نشده است. ۰۹:۰۲:۰۳ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ والاستریت ژورنال: خسارت هواپیماهای آسیبدیده در ریاض ۳۷۵ میلیون دلار است براساس گزارش داخلی یک شرکت بیمه، خسارت بیمهای ناشی از آسیب به ۶ فروند هواپیما در ریاض حدود ۳۷۵ میلیون دلار برآورد شده است. یک فروند از این هواپیماها بهطور کامل از رده خارج شده و پنج فروند دیگر آسیبهای جزئی دیدهاند. ۰۸:۰۵:۱۲ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ اختلال در فعالیت فرودگاههای امارات منابع عربی از اختلال و تعلیق پروازها در چندین فرودگاه امارات گزارش میدهند. ۰۸:۰۴:۴۴ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ هشدار رئیس پیشین ارتش آمریکا درباره کمبود موشکهای پاتریوت و تاد تا سال ۲۰۳۰ شبکه سیبیاس به نقل از چند مقام آمریکایی گزارش داد رندی جورج، رئیس پیشین ستاد ارتش آمریکا، در دسامبر ۲۰۲۵ هشدار داده بود ذخایر موشکهای پدافند هوایی پاتریوت و تاد به سطحی بحرانی رسیده و دستکم تا سال ۲۰۳۰ پاسخگوی نیازها نخواهد بود. کمبود این موشکها پیش از آغاز جنگ نیز وجود داشت و انتقال تسلیحات به اوکراین، عملیات پدافند هوایی برای حمایت از اسرائیل و ظرفیت محدود تولید تسلیحات در آمریکا از عوامل اصلی آن بود. جنگ با ایران نیز روند کاهش ذخایر موشکهای رهگیر آمریکا را سرعت بخشید. ۰۸:۰۳:۵۱ ۲۴ مهر ۱۴۰۵ حملات ایران به زیرساختهای کشورهای خلیج فارس، برنامههای جنگی آمریکا را مختل کرد رویترز: ایران از آغاز جنگ آمریکا و اسرائیل در ۲۸ فوریه، دستکم ۱۳۵ حمله موشکی و پهپادی به ۸۴ مرکز زیرساختی در کشورهای حاشیه خلیج فارس انجام داده است. این حملات، بخشهای حساس تأسیسات نفتی، پالایشگاهها، فرودگاهها، نیروگاهها و مجتمعهای صنعتی را هدف قرار داده و میلیاردها دلار خسارت به بار آورده است. رویترز با استناد به تصاویر ماهوارهای، دادههای عملیاتی و مصاحبه با ۳۶ منبع گزارش داده است که ایران ممکن است از اطلاعات روسی
title: آخرین تحولات تنش ایران و آمریکا؛ از تحریمهای جدید واشنگتن تا نشست امنیتی کابینه نتانیاهو درباره ایران

body: وام دو میلیارد و ۴۰۰ میلیون تومانی خرید مسکن و جعاله برای زوجهای تهرانی حدود ۲۳ درصد از متوسط قیمت یک آپارتمان ۵۰ متری در تهران را پوشش میدهد پ ، پـ تبلیغات تبلیغات فرارو- سقف وام خرید مسکن در تهران برای زوجین دو میلیارد تومان است که با احتساب وام جعاله به 400 میلیون تومان میرسد. به گزارش فرارو؛ متوسط قیمت یک آپارتمان 50 متری در محلههای مختلف تهران از پنج میلیارد و 500 میلیون تومان آغاز میشود و تا 16 میلیارد تومان میرسد. مبلغی که وام 2.4 میلیاردی خرید مسکن و جعاله تنها میتواند 23 درصد از هزینه خرید آن را پوشش دهد. وام خرید مسکن در تهران چقدر است؟ مبلغ وام خرید مسکن در تهران برای متقاضیان انفرادی یک میلیارد تومان و برای زوجین دو میلیارد تومان است. دریافت این تسهیلات به خرید اوراق تسه از فرابورس نیاز دارد. زوجین برای دریافت دو میلیارد تومان وام خرید مسکن باید چهار هزار برگه اوراق تسه بخرند. قیمت این اوراق روزانه در فرابورس تعیین میشود و با احتساب آخرین قیمت یعنی 119 هزار تومان برای هر برگه هزینه خرید به 476 میلیون تومان میرسد. نرخ سود وام خرید مسکن 22.5 درصد است و متقاضیان در روش بازپرداخت ساده باید تسهیلات را در مدت 12 سال تسویه کنند. اقساط ماهانه وام دو میلیارد تومانی زوجین به بیش از 40 میلیون تومان میرسد که رقم قابل توجهی از درآمد یک خانوار است. علاوه بر وام خرید مسکن امکان دریافت تسهیلات جعاله برای تعمیر و تکمیل واحدهای مسکونی نیز وجود دارد. سقف این وام 400 میلیون تومان است و زوجین میتوانند همراه با وام خرید مسکن این تسهیلات را نیز دریافت کنند. دریافت وام جعاله نیز به خرید 800 برگه اوراق تسه نیاز دارد که با در نظر گرفتن قیمت 119 هزار تومانی هر برگه هزینه کل آن به بیش از 95 میلیون تومان میرسد. نرخ سود وام جعاله نیز 22.5 درصد با بازپرداخت پنج ساله است. رقم اقساط ماهانه آن به بیش از 11 میلیون تومان میرسد. اما باید دید دریافت دو میلیارد و 400 میلیون تومان تسهیلات میتواند برای خرید یک آپارتمان نقلی در تهران کافی باشد. در این گزارش سراغ خانههای 50 متری در محلههای مختلف تهران رفتهایم تا ببینیم با دو میلیارد و 400 میلیون تومان میتوان خانهای خرید یا خیر. قیمت آپارتمان 50 متری در تهران چقدر است؟ نگاهی به قیمت آپارتمانهای 50 متری در محلههای مختلف تهران نشان میدهد متوسط قیمت این واحدهای مسکونی متری 202 میلیون تومان است. یعنی برای خرید آپارتمان 50 متری در تهران باید دستکم 10 میلیارد تومان بودجه داشته باشید. رقمی که در مقایسه وام 2.4 میلیاردی هفت میلیارد و 600 میلیون تومان بیشتر است. برای نمونه یک آپارتمان 50 متری در جیحون که سال ساخت آن 1386 است هفت میلیارد و 700 میلیون تومان قیمت خورده است. آپارتمان 50 متری دیگری در نارمک با عمر بنای 15 سال با قیمت 16 میلیارد تومان در بازار مسکن خریدوفروش میشود. مبلغی فاصله زیادی در مقایسه با وام 2.4 میلیاردی خرید مسکن دارد. با بودجه هشت تا 10 میلیارد تومان میتوان سراغ واحدهای مسکونی در محلههایی همچون پیروزی، مجیدیه، بریانک و نازیآباد رفت که این آپارتمانهای 50 متری از نظر سال ساخت قدیمی هستند و امکانات کاملی هم ندارند. ارزانترین خانه 50 متری نیز در محله مولوی تهران است که پنج میلیارد و 500 میلیون تومان قیمت خورده است. محله سال ساخت قیمت کل آپارتمان قیمت هر متر امکانات چیتگر 1405 12 میلیارد و 500 میلیون تومان 250 میلیون تومان آسانسور، پارکینگ و انباری استاد معین 1388 9 میلیارد و 500 میلیون
