body: A citizen of Kyrgyzstan accused of fraud involving more than 15 million soms has been extradited from Moldova to Kyrgyzstan. The man had been placed on an international wanted list, the Prosecutor General's Office reported. According to investigators, the suspect, identified as A. R., allegedly gained people's trust under the pretext of arranging car purchase and sale deals and fraudulently obtained their money. The total financial damage caused to the victims exceeded 15 million soms. The suspect was returned to Kyrgyzstan through cooperation between the Prosecutor General's Office and law enforcement agencies in Moldova. Upon arrival in the country, he was placed in a pretrial detention center. The Prosecutor General's Office said it continues efforts to locate and extradite citizens who flee abroad to evade investigation and trial. The number of victims, the circumstances of the suspect's arrest in Moldova and how long he had been on the international wanted list have not been disclosed.

body: kaktus.media Кыргызстан продлевает запрет на ввоз кузовов автомобилей Экономика 386 21 октября 2026 12:30 Kaktus Все самое интересное в Telegram Кабинет министров КР предлагает продлить временный запрет на импорт кузовов легковых автомобилей на шесть месяцев. Мера направлена против "конструкторов" - машин, которые собирают из ввезенных частей без нормального таможенного оформления и потом легализуют. Проект документа опубликован для общественного обсуждения. Что предлагается? Во исполнение указа президента о легализации автотранспорта от 31 декабря 2024 года был введен временный запрет на ввоз кузовов автомобилей, который регулярно продлевали. Очередной был продлен в апреле и действует до конца октября. Предлагается продлить эту меру еще на полгода. Запрет касается кузовов легковых автомобилей категории M1. Сейчас кузовную сборку ведут несколько предприятий, в том числе "ДТ Техник", "Шумкар", "Кыргыз Унаа Курулуш", "Меридиан Голд" и "Белес Групп". Для них предлагается сделать исключение. Для чего это делается? Основная цель - остановить практику сборки так называемых конструкторов. Такие машины собирают на территории Кыргызстана из ввезенных кузовов, агрегатов и запчастей, часто без полного таможенного оформления. При регистрации нередко используют поддельные или отсутствующие документы. Это позволяет уклоняться от уплаты пошлин и налогов, создает недобросовестную конкуренцию и увеличивает теневой оборот. Отдельная проблема - замена кузова с внесением изменений в регистрационные данные. На практике при такой замене часто предоставляют поддельные документы о происхождении кузова или не предоставляют их вовсе. В итоге фактически легализуются автомобили, которые изначально не проходили таможенную очистку. По данным Кыргызского центра аккредитации, в рамках легализации на технический осмотр обратились владельцы 30 730 автомобилей. Из них 466 единиц (сборные, сваренные или не соответствующие техрегламентам) осмотр не прошли. Успешно прошли 30 264 машины. Государственную регистрацию с уплатой легализационного платежа и присвоением номера региона "10" прошли 30 086 автомобилей. Еще 178 машин, прошедших техосмотр, процедуру не завершили. Общая сумма легализационных платежей составила 1 млрд 811 млн 850 тыс. сомов. "Продление запрета должно сократить возможности для незаконной сборки и легализации автомобилей, повысить собираемость таможенных платежей, уменьшить теневой оборот и допустить к эксплуатации только машины, прошедшие полноценное таможенное и техническое оформление. Мера вводится в рамках права государств - членов ЕАЭС на временные односторонние нетарифные ограничения сроком до шести месяцев", - указано в справке-обосновании. Мнение МВФ Экономика 2607 21 октября 2026 09:53 Kaktus Все самое интересное в Telegram "Рост цен на импортируемые энергоносители и продовольствие вновь усилил инфляционное давление в регионе Кавказа и Центральной Азии, причем степень этого влияния существенно различается по странам", - заявил сегодня, 15 октября, во время пресс-брифинга директор департамента Ближнего Востока и Центральной Азии МВФ Джихад Азур. Читайте также: Плата за электроэнергию. Сравниваем наши счета с другими странами (и с доходами) Он отметил, что война на Ближнем Востоке наносит региону крайне неравномерный экономический удар. Экономики, непосредственно затронутые конфликтом, находятся под сильным давлением, в то время как другие экономики стран Ближнего Востока, Северной Африки, Афганистана и Пакистана (MENAP), а также большая часть стран Кавказа и Центральной Азии (CCA) продемонстрировали большую устойчивость. Перспективы критически зависят от того, насколько быстро нормализуются производство энергоносителей и торговля, а также от способности стран сохранять макроэкономическую стабильность. директор департамента Ближнего Востока и Центральной Азии МВФ Джихад Азур Джихад Азур напомнил, что добыча нефти почти у всех непосредственно пострадавших экспортеров резко сократилась, а сбои в судоходстве и переработке привели к резкому росту цен на топливо. Тем не менее воздействие оказалось более сдержанным, чем предполагалось изначально. Довоенные излишки, добыча нефти производителями, не входящими в страны Персидского залива, альтернативные транспортные маршруты, корректировка спроса и существенное сокращение запасов - все это помогло смягчить удар. "Эти резервы дали время, но они конечны. Запасы ниже, резервные мощности ограничены, а возобновление сбоев может привести к гораздо большей корректировке цен", - считает он. Чего ждать Кавказу и Центральной Азии В МВФ подчеркивают, что регион Кавказа и Центральной Азии относительно успешно справился с потрясением благодаря значительному объему денежных переводов и высокой инвестиционной активности. Ожидается, что темпы роста замедлятся с 6,2% в 2025 году до более устойчивого уровня в 5,2% в 2026 году и 5,0% в 2027 году. Ожидается, что инфляция продолжит снижаться с высоких уровней, хотя и разными темпами в разных странах региона, в зависимости в том числе от проводимой ими экономической политики. Этот прогноз сопряжен с исключительно высокой степенью неопределенности. директор департамента Ближнего Востока и Центральной Азии МВФ Джихад Азур Наиболее серьезным риском является затягивание конфликта на Ближнем Востоке. Дальнейшие перебои в добыче энергоносителей, работе транспортных маршрутов или функционировании критически важной инфраструктуры ослабят экономическую активность в странах Персидского залива - экспортерах нефти, а также усилят инфляционное давление и создадут дополнительную нагрузку на бюджетную и внешнеэкономическую сферы стран региона. Кроме того, ужесточение глобальных финансовых условий может привести к ослаблению спроса, росту стоимости заимствований, усилению давления на валютные курсы и усугублению уязвимости экономик, нуждающихся в значительных объемах государственного финансирования или зависящих от внешних источников средств. Читайте также: Кыргызстану предрекли роль лидера по росту цен в Центральной Азии. Прогноз МВФ "Особо уязвимыми остаются страны с низким уровнем дохода и нестабильные экономики. Высокая зависимость от импорта продовольствия и ограниченные возможности бюджетного маневра на фоне сокращения официальной помощи в целях развития лишают многие из этих стран достаточного запаса прочности для преодоления потрясений", - считает директор департамента Ближнего Востока и Центральной Азии МВФ. Напомним, по прогнозу МВФ, Кыргызстан будет лидером не только по росту экономики, но и по инфляции . Ожидается, что по итогам 2026 года рост цен в нашей стране составит 12,7%, а в 2027 году он ускорится до 14,3%. При этом в среднем по региону Кавказа и Центральной Азии инфляция ожидается на уровне 13% и 10,2%. "Полный текст доклада "Региональные экономические перспективы" будет опубликован 22 октября в Дубае. В нем мы представим более подробную оценку экономических событий и приоритетных направлений политики в масштабах всего региона", - сказал Джихад Азур. Как органам власти следует реагировать на вызовы Джихад Азур отметил, что рекомендации МВФ сосредоточены на трех ключевых направлениях. В первую очередь, приоритетом для органов власти должно оставаться обеспечение ценовой стабильности при одновременном поддержании бюджетной устойчивости. Читайте также: ЕФСР улучшил прогноз по росту ВВП КР в 2026 году. Но предупредил о замедлении экономики "В случае возникновения инфляционного давления первой линией защиты должна служить денежно-кредитная политика. Меры по ужесточению денежно-кредитной политики и ограничению ликвидности необходимо подкреплять взвешенной бюджетной политикой, особенно в странах с ограниченными возможностями бюджетного маневра", - сказал представитель МВФ. Он также отметил, что создание резервов бюджета остается крайне важной задачей для всего региона, учитывая сохраняющиеся риски ухудшения экономической ситуации. Возможные меры политики могут включать более эффективную мобилизацию внутренних доходов, рационализацию расходов и укрепление основ бюджетной политики. Читайте также: Доходы кыргызстанцев не успевают за ценами. Цифры Органам власти следует воздерживаться от введения субсидий широкого охвата и вместо этого сосредоточиться на поддержке наиболее уязвимых групп населения посредством адресных, временных и бюджетно-нейтральных денежных выплат. директор департамента Ближнего Востока и Центральной Азии МВФ Джихад Азур В-третьих, странам необходимо продолжать наращивать потенциал для противодействия будущим потрясениям . Подчеркивается, что недавний опыт подтверждает важность надежных основ экономической политики. Страны с сильными институтами, заслуживающими доверия механизмами денежно-кредитной политики (обеспечиваемыми независимостью центральных банков) и достаточным пространством для бюджетного маневра, как правило, лучше подготовлены к преодолению потрясений. Читайте также: Скоро зима. Каким будет отопительный сезон (неутешительные прогнозы) "Диверсификация торговли, углубление региональной интеграции и расширение возможностей для внедрения новых технологий, включая искусственный интеллект, могут способствовать росту производительности и долгосрочному экономическому развитию. Это особенно актуально, когда данные меры подкрепляются реформами, направленными на повышение конкурентоспособности", - отметил Джихад Азур. Читайте также: В Налоговый кодекс вносят очередные изменения. Рассказываем о самых главных Директор департамента Ближнего Востока и Центральной Азии МВФ также обратил внимание на то, что потенциал Среднего коридора и расширение торговли с Китаем, Европой и Ближним Востоком открывают перед странами Кавказа и Центральной Азии широкие возможности для углубления интеграции в мировую экономику. Он напомнил, что страны региона уже активно инвестируют в развитие инфраструктуры, хотя этот процесс требует времени. ВВП аналитика прогноз МВФ Есть новость или проблема? body: Jogorku Kenesh Bishkek, Oct. 21, 2026 /Kabar/. On October 20, Elvira Surabaldieva, Chair of the Committee on International Affairs, Defense, Security, and Migration of the Jogorku Kenesh (Parliament of Kyrgyzstan) met with a delegation from the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region (XUAR), led by Director Zhang Huazhong. Cholpon Esenamanova, Deputy Chair of the Committee, also participated in the meeting. The parties discussed current issues regarding Kyrgyz-Chinese cooperation, with a particular focus on developing inter-parliamentary ties, as well as trade, economic, cultural, and humanitarian engagement. Elvira Surabaldieva emphasized that Kyrgyzstan attaches great importance to strengthening friendly relations with China and developing a comprehensive strategic partnership. She noted that agreements reached at the highest level provide a foundation for further deepening bilateral cooperation and implementing joint projects. The Committee Chair highlighted the importance of intensifying dialogue between the Jogorku Kenesh and the CPPCC of the XUAR, exchanging delegations and expertise, and strengthening interaction between relevant specialized bodies. Special attention was also given to prospects for expanding trade and economic ties and attracting investment. In this context, Elvira Surabaldieva emphasized the strategic importance of constructing the China–Kyrgyzstan–Uzbekistan railway, developing road transport links along the Barskoon–Bedel route, and ensuring the efficient operation of border crossing points on the Kyrgyz–Chinese border. Furthermore, the parties explored the possibilities of increasing the number of direct flights between Kyrgyzstan and China, including the launch of a Kashgar–Bishkek route, as well as establishing logistics centers and developing e-commerce. For his part, Zhang Huazhong reaffirmed a commitment to further developing mutually beneficial cooperation and strengthening ties between Kyrgyzstan and the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region (XUAR) of the PRC. He expressed confidence that constructive dialogue and joint efforts would facilitate the implementation of the agreements reached and further strengthen the Kyrgyz–Chinese partnership. Print

Marlen Mamataliev noted that Uzbekistan is a close neighbor and strategic partner of Kyrgyzstan, emphasizing the importance of parliamentary diplomacy in the development of bilateral relations. He stated that the Jogorku Kenesh maintains engagement with both chambers of the Uzbek parliament through friendship groups and relevant committees. Tanzila Narbaeva, in turn, highlighted the high level of cooperation between the two countries. She also spoke positively about the digitalization efforts within the Jogorku Kenesh and expressed interest in exchanging experience in this area. The Chairperson of the Uzbek Senate shared her impressions from her frequent visits to Kyrgyzstan, noting the changes taking place in the country and the development of the tourism sector. At the conclusion of the meeting, Tanzila Narbaeva invited Marlen Mamataliev to pay an official visit to Uzbekistan. Print

body: Share Payrav Chorshanbiev , asia+ Categories Society Tajikistan Format News Published 21.10.2026 09:36 Tajikistan received more than 8,901 tons of humanitarian aid worth $25.3 million from 38 countries in January–September 2026, down $21.8 million, or 46.3%, from the same period last year, according to the Customs Service under the Government of Tajikistan. Russia accounted for the largest share of humanitarian aid during the first nine months of 2026, providing 29.2% of the total value. The United States ranked second with 20.3%, followed by China with 10.8%, the Netherlands with 8.2%, India with 8.1%, South Korea with 6.4%, Belgium with 5.1%, Iran with 2.5% and Japan with 1.6%. Other donor countries included Germany, Türkiye, Denmark, Finland, Belarus, the United Arab Emirates, Italy, the United Kingdom, Australia, Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan. The donor structure has changed significantly over the past year. In January–September 2025, China was Tajikistan’s largest humanitarian aid donor, accounting for 33.7% of the total, followed by the United States at 24%. Russia contributed just 6.5%. Russia’s share has since increased more than fourfold, from 6.5% to 29.2%, while China’s share has fallen from 33.7% to 10.8%. In monetary terms, humanitarian aid from China declined from approximately $15.9 million in the first nine months of 2025 to $2.7 million in the same period this year. Meanwhile, aid from Russia rose from $3.1 million to $7.4 million. Aid deliveries fluctuate throughout the year Monthly figures published by the Agency on Statistics show that humanitarian aid deliveries varied considerably during the first nine months of 2026. In January, aid worth approximately $435,400 entered the country. Deliveries increased sharply in February, reaching around $5 million, followed by a further $2.9 million in March. Inflows were comparatively modest in April and May, with May’s total amounting to approximately $290,000. The highest monthly figure was recorded in July, when humanitarian aid worth $5.5 million arrived in Tajikistan. Deliveries remained substantial in August, at around $3 million, and September, at $4.3 million. February, July and September together accounted for more than half of the total value of humanitarian aid received during the nine-month period. Who receives the humanitarian aid? Humanitarian cargo can include food, medicines, medical equipment and other goods intended to support the population and social institutions. One example is Russian assistance intended to provide schoolchildren with hot meals. However, publicly available official statistics do not provide a comprehensive picture of how humanitarian aid entering Tajikistan is distributed or who ultimately receives it. The Agency for Statistics publishes data on the total value and weight of humanitarian cargo and identifies donor countries. However, its publicly available reports do not detail the types of goods received or their distribution among regions, institutions and population groups. Government bodies, including the Agency for State Material Reserves, do not provide media outlets with comprehensive information on the distribution of incoming humanitarian cargo. Information about recipients is therefore mainly available through individual reports announcing the handover of aid. While official figures make it possible to assess the overall scale of deliveries and the contributions of individual donor countries, they do not reveal the full picture of who benefits from the assistance or in what quantities. The statistical publications also do not explain the reasons for the 46.3% decline in the value of humanitarian aid recorded in January–September 2026 compared with the same period last year. The figures reflect the value and weight of humanitarian cargo recorded by the Customs Service. They do not cover all forms of international assistance to Tajikistan, including financial support, grants and technical assistance. Join us on social media! Як масъули тарҳ, ки номаш ба далели амниятӣ навишта намешавад, рӯзи 20-уми октябр дар нишасти онлайн бо хабарнигорон гуфт, ин оморест, ки онҳо ба даст овардаанд ва шояд теъдоди воқеӣ аз ин ҳам бештар бошад. “Мо тоҷикон ва узбеконеро, ки шаҳрванди Русия ҳастанд, ҳисоб накардем. Ин омори касонест, ки танҳо шаҳрвандии ин кишварҳоро доранд,” -- гуфт ӯ. Тоҷикистон ва Русия низоми душаҳрвандӣ доранд ва дар даҳ соли охир зиёда аз 800 ҳазор тоҷикистонӣ ҳамзамон шиносномаи Русияро соҳиб шудаанд. Нишасти онлайн дар бораи ҷалби шаҳрвандони кишварҳои Осиёи Марказӣ ба ҷанги Русия алайҳи Украина бо ҳимояти Иттиҳоди Аврупо баргузор шуд. Бар асоси гуфтаи масъули тарҳи “Зистан мехоҳам” дар ин нишаст, аз соли 2022 то кунун ҷалби зиёда аз 5 ҳазор шаҳрванди Тоҷикистон ба артиши Русия барои ширкат дар ҷанги Украина маълум шудааст. Дар умум дар тақрибан панҷ соли охир беш аз 20 ҳазор шаҳрванди Осиёи Марказӣ ба ин ҷанг бурда шудаанд ва аз рӯйи теъдод, Тоҷикистон пас аз Узбекистон дар ин феҳраст дар ҷойи дуюм қарор дорад. Ин рақам дар моҳи аперли имсол 16 ҳазор нафар ҳисоб шуда буд. Русия моҳи феврали соли 2022 ба хоки Украина таҷовуз кард ва садҳо муҳоҷири одӣ ва зиндониёну боздоштшудаҳои тоҷикро ба ин ҷанг бурд. То кунун хабари кушта шудани беш аз сад тоҷик дар ҷанги Русия бар зидди Украина ва дафни пайкар ё ҷасади онҳо дар Тоҷикистон расонаӣ гаштааст. Мақомоти Тоҷикистон дар ин бора изҳори бехабарӣ мекунанд. Вазири корҳои дохилӣ Рамазон Раҳимзода моҳи июл дар нишасти хабарӣ дар Душанбе гуфт , "ин ки чӣ қадар аз шаҳрвандони мо дар ҷанги Украина ҷанг карда истодаанд ё наистодаанд, мо ягон ҳисобот намебарем ва дар ин масъала ягон уҳдадорӣ ҳам надорем." Моддаи “401 ба иловаи як" дар Кодекси ҷиноии Тоҷикистон барои ҷалб ва ширкати шаҳрвандони Тоҷикистон дар низоъҳои мусаллаҳона ба нафъи кишварҳои дигар аз дувоздаҳ то бист сол зиндон ҷазо муқаррар кардааст. То кунун ягон кас барои иштирок дар ҷанги Украина ба ҷавобгарии ҷиноӣ кашида нашудааст. Инро ҳам бинед: "Гуфт, модар нигарон набош, аммо дигар занг назад." Олимҷон куҷо шуд? Масъули тарҳи “Зистан мехоҳам” дар нишасти онлайни рӯзи 20-уми октябр омори асирони ҷангиро дар Украина ҳам нишон дод ва тибқи он Тоҷикистон дар қатори ҳафт кишварест, ки аз ҳама бештар шаҳрвандонаш дар дасти низомиёни Украина ҳастанд. Вай теъдоди дақиқи асиронро фош накард, аммо бар асоси нақли онҳо се роҳи асосии ҷалби шаҳрвандони Тоҷикистон ва кишварҳои ҳамсояашро ба ҷанг дар Украина ном бурд. Ваъдаи аз 2 то 3 ҳазор доллар маош дар моҳ ва тақдими шаҳрвандии Русия яке аз роҳҳои ҷалби хориҷиён ба ҷанг будааст. Гурӯҳи дигарро бо ваъдаи кор бо маоши баланд, посбонӣ дар анбор ва ронандагӣ ҷалб карда, пас аз як тамрини кӯтоҳ фавран ба ҷанг мефиристодаанд. Гурӯҳи сеюм онҳое будаанд, ки бо тарси зиндонӣ кардан ё аз Русия ихроҷ шудан ба ҷанг ҷалб шудаанд. Ба гуфтаи масъули тарҳи “Зистан мехоҳам” дар Украина, беш аз сӣ дар сади асирон аз Осиёи Марказӣ далели пайвастанашонро ба ҷанги зидди Украина дарёфти шаҳрвандии Русия номида, танҳо 12 дарсад гуфтаанд, ки ихтиёрӣ қарордод имзо карданд. Қисме дигар гуфтаанд, фиреб хӯрданд ва ё барои раҳоӣ аз маҳбасу ҷавобгарии ҷиноӣ ва дарёфти кумакпулӣ ба ин кор розӣ шуданд. body: Ҷомeа Мақомот ҷузъиёти кӯдакдуздӣ дар Душанберо шарҳ доданд 3 соат пеш Мақомот ҷузъиёти кӯдакдуздӣ дар Душанберо шарҳ доданд Ба дигарон фиристед Линкро нусхабардорӣ кунед Facebook X (Twitter) Email Ба дигарон фиристед Ба дигарон фиристед Линкро нусхабардорӣ кунед Facebook X (Twitter) Email Ба дигарон фиристед Бидуни филтршикан Ин пайванд (линк) дар минтақаҳое, ки вебсайти мо бастааст, кор мекунад Мо дар Google Мақомоти Тоҷикистон пас аз тақрибан як ҳафта сукут бо нашри гузорише ҷузъиёти чӣ гуна рабуда шудани тифли навзод ро аз як таваллудхона дар маркази Душанбе шарҳ доданд. Тифли навзодро нимашаби 11-уми октябри имсол аз зойишгоҳи Пажӯҳишгоҳи модару кӯдак, муҳимтарин муассисаи тиббии ташхис ва муолиҷаи модарону кӯдакон дар Тоҷикистон рабуданд. Ҳодисае, ки мояи нигаронии мардуми зиёде дар кишвар шуд ва суолҳои зиёдеро дар бораи амнияти таваллудхонаҳо дар Тоҷикистон ба миён овард. Раёсати умури дохилии Душанбе рӯзи 15-уми октябр аз пайдо кардани тифли навзод хабар дод, вале гуфт, ки ҷузъиётро дертар нашр мекунанд. Ин ниҳод рӯзи 21-уми октябр гуфт, Зарина Саймуддинова, сокини 26-солаи ноҳияи Абдураҳмонии Ҷомии вилояти Хатлонро бо гумони дуздии кӯдак боздошт кардааст. Дар сурати исботи иттиҳом ба ин зан аз панҷ то бист сол зиндон таҳдид мекунад. Зарина Саймуддинова Зарина Саймуддинова дар навори бисёр таҳриршудаи мақомот мегӯяд, ки шаш сол боз фарзанд надошт ва барои ҳамин дар фикри дуздидани кӯдак шудааст. Вай дар ин видео, ки маълум нест таҳти чӣ шароит сабт шудааст, гуфт, шаби 11-уми октябр бо либоси тамизкории хушдоманаш, ки дар шаҳри Душанбе кору зиндагӣ мекунад, вориди таваллудхона шуда, навзодро бо худ бурд. "Сипас дар болотари таваллудхона ба таксӣ савор шуда, ба хонаи хушдоманам рафтам. Субҳ ба як таксӣ 250 сомонӣ додем то хонаамон дар ноҳияи Абдураҳмони Ҷомӣ расонд," – афзуд ӯ. Дар навори дурбинҳои назоратӣ, ки Радиои Озодӣ дастрас карда буд, як зани ниқобпӯше дар либоси сабзи тамизкорони таваллудхона кӯдаки навзоде ба даст аз назди зойишгоҳ башитоб дур мешавад. Мақомот дар гузориши худ баъзе аз ҷанбаҳои қазияро норавшан мондаанд. Аз ҷумла, гуфта нашудааст, ки зан махсус барои дуздии кӯдак аз ноҳияи Абдураҳмони Ҷомӣ ба Душанбе омадааст? Чаро маҳз таваллудхонаи рақами яки пойтахтро интихоб кард? Чӣ гуна вориди утоқи зоишгоҳ шуд ва оё касе ӯро надид? Ва хушдомани ӯ кист ва дар куҷо кор мекунад? Зан феълан дар боздоштгоҳ аст. Хабарнигорони Радиои Озодӣ талош доранд, ки пайвандони ӯро пайдо ва асли қазияро аз онҳо бипурсанд. Тифли навзоди Мавзуна Акрамоваи 19-сола ва сокини ноҳияи Нуробод нимашаби 11-уми октябр аз зоишгоҳи Пажӯҳишгоҳи модару кӯдак, муҳимтарин маркази ташхиси тиббӣ ва муолиҷаи модарон ва навзодон дар Тоҷикистон, гум шуд. Ин дар ҳолест, ки вуруд ба ҳуҷраи беморон ё аёдати онҳо дар нимашабӣ дар шифохонаҳои Тоҷикистон мамнуъ аст. Яке аз пайвандони модари тифл ба Радиои Озодӣ гуфт, зане, ки ба кӯдакрабоӣ гумонбар мешавад, ҳамдеҳаи Мавзуна Акрамова аст. Дар Тоҷикистон нопадид шудани навзод аз таваллудхона бисёр кам иттифоқ афтодааст, вале соли 2023 як зани 45-сола аз ноҳияи Хуросонро бо гуноҳи дуздидани тифли дурӯза аз зоишгоҳи ноҳияи Абдураҳмони Ҷомӣ ба 8 сол зиндон маҳкум карданд. Муфаттишон баъд аз як ҳафтаи ҷустуҷӯ тифли навзодро пайдо карданд ва зан ба мақомот гуфтааст, аз тарси онки шавҳараш барои дигар фарзанд наовардан аз ӯ ҷудо мешавад, тифлро дуздид ва ба шавҳари муҳоҷираш ҳамчун фарзанди хеш нишон додааст. body: Тоҷикистон “Ихроҷи мухолифини тоҷик аз Аврупо ҳадя ба режими Раҳмон аст” Октябр 20, 2026 “Ихроҷи мухолифини тоҷик аз Аврупо ҳадя ба режими Раҳмон аст” Ба дигарон фиристед Линкро нусхабардорӣ кунед Facebook X (Twitter) Email Ба дигарон фиристед Ба дигарон фиристед Линкро нусхабардорӣ кунед Facebook X (Twitter) Email Ба дигарон фиристед Бидуни филтршикан Ин пайванд (линк) дар минтақаҳое, ки вебсайти мо бастааст, кор мекунад Мо дар Google Асадулло Бобоев аз соли 2017 дар хориҷ аз Тоҷикистон мезист Як созмони байнулмилалӣ ҳукми зиндони Асадулло Бобоев , узви Ҷунбиши мухолифи ислоҳот ва рушди Тоҷикистонро дар Душанбе ба шиддат танқид кардааст. Рӯзи 19-уми октябр маълум шуд, ки Додгоҳи ноҳияи Исмоили Сомонии пойтахт моҳи сентябр Бобоевро 17 сол аз озодӣ маҳрум намудааст. Ӯ тобистони имсол бар рағми ҳушдору нигарониҳо аз Олмон ихроҷ шуда буд. "Ӯро ба ҷое фиристоданд, ки зиндону шиканҷа мунтазираш буд" Созмони Freedom For Eurasia, қароргоҳаш дар Вена, рӯзи 19-уми октябр дар баёнияе аз мақомоти Тоҷикистон хостааст, Асадулло Бобоевро фавран озод карда, дастрасияшро ба вакили мустақил, мулоқот бо аъзои хонавода ва ёрии пизишкӣ таъмин кунанд ва ҷузъиёти парвандаро бармало созанд. Лайло Нозгул Саидбек Лайло Нозгул Саидбек, раҳбари созмон, гуфт, “ҳукми содиршуда нисбат ба Асадулло Бобоев натиҷаи мустақими қарори Олмон аст. Вайро ба кишваре фиристоданд, ки зиндону шиканҷа дар мунтазираш буд.” Ин ҳомии ҳуқуқ афзуд, “кишварҳои аврупоӣ наметавонанд бо баҳонаи мушкилоти ҳуҷҷатгузории иқомат аз масъулият шона холӣ кунанд, вақте гап дар бораи мунтақиди як режими диктотурӣ меравад. Ихроҷи чунин афрод ҳадя ба режими Раҳмон аст.” Ҳукми ҳабси Асадулло Бобоев, узви Ҷунбиши ислоҳот ва рушди Тоҷикистон, эътирози баъзе аз мухолифони ҳукуматро дар хориҷа низ ба миён овард. Муҳаммадсобири Абдуқаҳҳор, яке аз фаъолони мухолифин, 20-уми октябр ҳукми додгоҳро ноодилона ва зидди қонунҳои кишвар хонд. Ӯ гуфт: “Ҳукмҳое, ки мақомоти Тоҷикистон имрӯз нисбат ба дигарандешон, муборизин ва мухолифин содир мекунанд, танҳо барои тарс додан ва барои огоҳӣ додан ба шахсони дигар аст, ки бояд камбудиҳо, ноадолатиҳо ва худкомагии ҳукуматро ошкор накунанд. Ҳукумати оилавӣ, ҳукумате, ки қуввати таъмини мардумро бо кору нерӯи барқ надорад.” Кӯшиши мо барои тамос бо намояндагони додгоҳ то ин дам бенатиҷа буд. Ду манбаи огоҳ, ки ному ҷойи корашон ба далели амниятӣ фош намешавад, ба Радиои Озодӣ гуфтанд, Асадулло Бобоев бар асоси се банди Кодекси ҷиноии Тоҷикистон, аз ҷумла "тундгароӣ ба воситаи интернет", аз озодӣ маҳрум карда шудааст. Маълум нест, худи ӯ дар додгоҳ чӣ гуфтааст ва оё барои бознигарии ҳукм муроҷиат кардааст ё не. Аммо қаблан дар суҳбат бо Радиои Озодӣ гуфта буд , ки фақат барои танқиди амалкардҳои ҳукумат дар шабакаҳои иҷтимоӣ ва расонаҳои мухолифони давлат ва суҳбат дар бораи поймол шудани ҳуқуқи мардум дар кишвар ба зидди ӯ парвандаи ҷиноӣ боз кардаанд. Муҳаммадсобири Абдуқаҳҳор мегӯяд, дар чанде аз ин ихроҷҳо худи афрод ва ҳам нотифоқии мухолифон сабаб мешавад: “Бисёр аз онҳо то вақте қазияашон барои истирдод баррасӣ намешавад, ба ҳеч созмони ҳуқуқи инсон ва ба мо муроҷиат намекунанд. Вақте як нафар мушкилӣ дорад, бояд ба созмонҳо муроҷиат кунад, будубоши худро қонунӣ кунад, то сабаби истирдодаш нашавад. Онҳоро дар Тоҷикистон ҳукмҳои ноодилона ва муҳлати тӯлонии зиндон интизор аст.” Хадамоти муҳоҷирати Олмон Асадулло Бобоев ва писари 19-солааш Муҳаммадро барои мушкил дар санади иқомат ва ба поён расидани муҳлати зист боздошт карда, сипас ба Душанбе фиристодаанд. Мақомоти Тоҷикистон писари Бобоевро баъди расиданаш ба Душанбе ба модарбузургаш супоридаанд. Ҳамсар ва як духтари ӯ дар Аврупо ҳастанд. body: Баъд аз гузориши Озодӣ Вокуниши донишгоҳ ва шарҳи ҳуқуқдон ба ронда шудани 5 донишҷӯ Октябр 20, 2026 Вокуниши донишгоҳ ва шарҳи ҳуқуқдон ба ронда шудани 5 донишҷӯ Ба дигарон фиристед Линкро нусхабардорӣ кунед Facebook X (Twitter) Email Ба дигарон фиристед Ба дигарон фиристед Линкро нусхабардорӣ кунед Facebook X (Twitter) Email Ба дигарон фиристед Бидуни филтршикан Ин пайванд (линк) дар минтақаҳое, ки вебсайти мо бастааст, кор мекунад Мо дар Google Донишгоҳи давлатии омӯзгории Тоҷикистон. Акс аз бойгонӣ Донишгоҳи омӯзгории Тоҷикистон хабари Радиои Озоди ро дар бораи ихроҷи панҷ донишҷӯяш барои сарпечӣ аз ширкат дар раҳпаймоҳои ҷашнӣ тасдиқ кард, аммо гуфт, ба се рондашуда баъди эътирофи камбудӣ иҷоза додааст, ба таҳсил баргарданд. Дар баёнияи донишгоҳ, ки 20-уми октябр дар Фейсбук нашр шуд, омадааст, “дар ҳақиқат, панҷ донишҷӯ бо сабаби риоя накардани қоидаҳои тартиботи дохилидонишгоҳӣ, аз ҷумла иштирок накардан дар корҳои ҷамъиятии донишгоҳ, аз сафи донишҷӯён хориҷ гардида буданд.” Баъди ин, ба гуфтаи раҳбарияти донишгоҳ, “бо мақсади ҳифзи ҳуқуқи донишҷӯён ва фароҳам овардани шароити мусоид барои идомаи таҳсили онҳо”, се нафар ба сафи донишҷӯён барқарор карда шуданд. Рӯзе пештар аз ин баёния, Радиои Озодӣ бо такя ба фармони раҳбарияти донишгоҳ гузориш дод, ки панҷ донишҷӯро барои иштирок накардан дар роҳпаймоӣ ё маршировка и бахшида ба ҷашни 35-солагии истиқлоли Тоҷикистон дар тобистону тирамоҳи имсол аз донишгоҳ хориҷ кардаанд . ИНЧУНИН, БИХОНЕД: "Ба маршировка наомад." Ихроҷи 5 донишҷӯ аз як донишгоҳи Тоҷикистон Ҷашни мазкур рӯзи 9-уми сентябр сурат гирифт. Вазорати маориф гуфта буд, ки ширкат дар чунин маросим маҷбурӣ нест. Хуршед Мавлонов, сухангӯи вазорат, рӯзи 20-уми октябр бори дигар тасдиқ кард, ки ширкати донишҷӯён дар раҳпаймоӣ ихтиёрист. Ҳуқуқшиноси тоҷик Бахтиёр Насруллоев дар шарҳи кӯтоҳе ба Радиои Озодӣ гуфт: "Агар донишҷӯ дар дарсҳо мунтазам иштирок накунад, имтиҳонҳоро супурда натавонад ва ё ба амалҳои ғайриқонунӣ ё ҷинояте даст занад, раҳбарияти донишгоҳ метавонад ӯро хориҷ кунад. Дигар чизҳо, ба мисли иштирок накардан дар корҳои ҷамъиятӣ ё маршировка, асос барои аз донишгоҳ хориҷ кардан намешавад." Ҷалби ҳазорон нафар бавижа хонандагону донишҷӯён дар барномаи ҷашнии 35-умин солгарди истиқлол дар Душанбе сабаби танқидҳои зиёд дар шабакаҳои иҷтимоӣ шуд. Корбарон дар Фейсбук ва Инстаграм мегуфтанд, ки донишгоҳҳо ба ҷойи дарс додан ба донишҷӯён, онҳоро барои рақсу бозӣ мефиристанд. Мунтақидони маршировка бовар доранд, ки чунин маъракаҳо дар Тоҷикистон аз даврони шӯравии собиқ ба мерос мондаанд ва бояд ҳарчи зудтар аз он даст кашид. Маъракаҳое, ки ба гуфтаи онҳо даврони шахспарастӣ, саркӯб ва поймоли ҳуқуқу озодиҳои бунёдии мардумро ба ёд меоваранд. Донишгоҳи омӯзгории Тоҷикистон гуфтааст, ихроҷи панҷ донишҷӯ “хусусияти ислоҳӣ дошта, ҳадафи асосии он ҷалби таваҷҷуҳи донишҷӯён ба масъулиятшиносӣ, ислоҳи камбудиҳо ва риояи талаботи тартиботи донишгоҳ буд.” Ҳарчанд донишгоҳ гуфтааст, ки барои ширкаткунандагони раҳпаймоии идона 10 рӯз рухсатӣ дод, намояндаи Вазорати маориф ва илми Тоҷикистон мегӯяд, барои ин қишри донишҷӯён ҳеч гуна таътили иловагӣ эълон накардааст. body: Сарбозонро дар Туркманистон ба пахтачинӣ бурдаанд Пайвандҳои дастрасӣ Ҷаҳиш ба мояи аслӣ Ҷаҳиш ба феҳристи аслӣ Ҷаҳиш ба ҷустор Баъдӣ Пӯшонед Пешӣ Баъдӣ Тасвир саҳнаҳое дорад, ки шояд барои дигарон нофорам бошанд. Пардабардорӣ Пайванд нусхабардорӣ шуд ТАРҲҲО Русский Пайгирӣ кунед Ҳамаи сомонаҳои RFE/RL Ҷустуҷӯ РУС TV TV Ҷустуҷӯ Пешӣ Баъдӣ Хабари нав Дар чанд ҷумла Октябр 20, 2026 Сарбозонро дар Туркманистон ба пахтачинӣ бурдаанд Сарбозон ҳангоми ҷамъоварии пахта дар Марв, Туркманистон Мақомоти Туркманистон, ки пайваста ба нақзи ҳуқуқи одамон танқид мешаванд, дар вилояти Дашоғуз сарбозону афсаронро бо либоси якхелаи сиёҳ ба ҷамъоварии пахта ҷалб кардаанд. Дар вилояти Ахал низ аз сарбозон талаб шудааст, ки барои иштироки “ихтиёрӣ” дар ҷамъоварии ҳосил ба таври хатӣ ризоят диҳанд. Ҳар сол кормандони идораҳои давлатӣ, аз ҷумла омӯзгорону пизишконро ба ҷамъоварии пахта дар Туркманистон маҷбур мекунанд. Бо вуҷуди танқидҳои батакрор ва даъват ба ислоҳот, дар Тоҷикистон ҳам пахта асосан бо ёрии хонандагону омӯзгорон ва кормандони идораҳои давтаӣ чида мешавад. Созишномаҳои ҳамкорӣ навсозии бахши саноат, нақлиёт, зербунёдҳои энержӣ, коркарди маъдан, хадамоти молӣ, фанновариҳои рақамӣ, кишоварзӣ, тандурустӣ ва маорифро дар бар мегиранд. Дар бахши молӣ бо ширкатҳои Franklin Templeton, Oppenheimer & Co., Citigroup ва BlackRock созишномаҳое имзо шудаанд, ки роҳи ширкатҳои узбекистониро ба бозорҳои байнулмилалӣ ҳамвор мекунад. Бо ширкатҳои ReElement Technologies, Traxys ва Trafigura кор дар бахши маъдан ва захираҳои табиӣ пешбинӣ мешавад. Today, 09:00 2 min read 653 views 0 comments 0 Source: Presidential Press Service President Shavkat Mirziyoyev received Khalilur Rahman, Foreign Minister of Bangladesh and President-elect of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, during his visit to Uzbekistan. Rahman arrived in the country to participate in the World Summit titled "Investing in Child Well-being: A Path Toward Sustainable and Equitable Development for Future Generations," scheduled to take place in Samarkand on October 21–22. At the beginning of the meeting, Mirziyoyev congratulated Rahman on his election as President of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly. The president noted that Uzbekistan was the first country Rahman had visited in his capacity as President-elect of the General Assembly. Source: Presidential Press Service Source: Presidential Press ServiceRahman conveyed greetings from UN Secretary-General António Guterres to the President of Uzbekistan. During the meeting, the parties exchanged views on expanding and strengthening cooperation between Uzbekistan and the United Nations and its specialized agencies. Foto: Prezident matbuot xizmati The meeting addressed Uzbekistan's cooperation with the United Nations. In recent years, the UN General Assembly has adopted 15 resolutions initiated by Uzbekistan, including two approved in 2026. Uzbekistan also participates in the activities of the UN's principal organs and specialized agencies. Source: Presidential Press Service The country has put forward its candidacy for a non-permanent seat on the United Nations Security Council for the 2035–2036 term. The parties confirmed their mutual interest in further cooperation on achieving the Sustainable Development Goals. Other areas discussed included strengthening regional cooperation in Central Asia, addressing the consequences of climate change, promoting a culture of peace and developing interreligious dialogue. The meeting also addressed bilateral relations between Uzbekistan and Bangladesh. Both sides expressed readiness to further expand their partnership across various areas. body: Uzbekistan Number of Uzbek citizens going to Russia for work falls 13.2% The number of Uzbek citizens going to Russia for work fell 13.2% year-on-year to 1.179mn in the first half of 2026, while labor migration to the European Union, Türkiye and South Korea continued to grow and remittances from Russia increased by 8.8%. Yesterday, 16:00 1 min read 3 716 views 0 comments 0 Source: “Daryo” / Farrux Aliyev The number of Uzbek citizens who went to Russia for work fell by 13.2% year-on-year in January-June 2026, reaching 1.179mn, according to the Central Bank of Uzbekistan’s Labor Market Review . The figure compares with 1.358mn in the first half of 2025. For comparison, the report recorded 1.495mn Uzbek citizens working in Russia under a patent in 2025. Meanwhile, Uzbekistan’s external labor migration is increasingly extending to other destinations. In 2025, the number of Uzbek migrant workers in the European Union rose by 13.2%, while the number in Türkiye increased by 10.7%, the Central Bank reported. As of July 1, 2026, the number of Uzbek citizens in Türkiye reached 70,000, up 9.3% year-on-year. South Korea registered 102,200 Uzbek citizens, an annual increase of 3.3%. Despite the decline in the number of Uzbek citizens going to Russia for work, remittance inflows from the country continued to grow. Transfers from Russia to Uzbekistan increased by 8.8% year-on-year in the first half of 2026. The Central Bank warned that declining labor migration to some destinations could negatively affect future remittance inflows, household incomes and consumer demand. The report also highlighted a weakening domestic labor market. The number of job vacancies announced in the second quarter of 2026 fell by 9.8%, while job-seeker activity remained high and competition for available positions intensified, as previously reported by Daryo. # Domestic Labor Market # central bank of uzbekistan # labor migration # remittances # russia # uzbekistan Telegram channel @daryo_eng Subscribe What do you think? body: Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and China Coordinate Logistics Along The Middle Corridor Tuesday, 20 October 2026 Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and China Coordinate Logistics Along The Middle Corridor Featured Published in Analytical Articles font size decrease font size increase font size Print Email By: Vusal Guliyev Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, and China increasingly seek to strengthen the Middle Corridor as a trans-Eurasian trade and logistics route. China’s proposal to extend Lianyungang Port’s existing logistics chain to Baku, alongside expanding container capacity at Aktau and new multimodal transport agreements, reflects a shift toward integrating previously separate infrastructure projects. Building on the existing Lianyungang–Khorgos–Aktau “Three Nodes” logistics chain, the proposed extension to Baku could further integrate transport networks across China, Central Asia, and the South Caucasus, strengthening freight connectivity with European markets. It could also create opportunities for Japan and South Korea to diversify their trade and energy routes amid disruptions to traditional supply chains. However, its long-term viability will depend on whether the participating countries can coordinate railway services, port operations, customs procedures, and digital systems to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and commercially competitive freight services. BACKGROUND: On September 9, 2026, Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev’s interview with Xinhua highlighted the growing importance of the Azerbaijan–Kazakhstan-China logistics connection. The same day in Baku, at the CICA Conference of Port Authorities, Jiang Wei, Vice President for External Relations of Lianyungang Port, proposed incorporating Baku into the existing Lianyungang–Khorgos–Aktau “Three Nodes” logistics chain. At the sidelines of the conference, Rovshan Rustamov, Chairman of Azerbaijan Railways (ADY), met with representatives of China’s Shanghai International Port Group (SIPG), NIZE Tech, and Lianyungang Port. Discussions focused on developing the Lianyungang–Baku route, expanding regular container and block-train services, attracting additional Chinese cargo bound for Europe, and introducing smart-port technologies and digital solutions. The participants also highlighted the importance of exchanging information on cargo forecasts, train schedules, and logistical requirements to improve coordination between railway and port operations and strengthen the Middle Corridor’s competitiveness. On September 8, Tahir Budagov, Deputy Chairman of Azerbaijan’s ruling New Azerbaijan Party (YAP), met with a Chinese delegation led by Liu Haixing, Minister of the International Department of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee. Their discussions focused on trade, transportation, the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), the Zangezur Corridor, and Beijing’s support for Azerbaijan’s deeper engagement with the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO). These developments build on a growing network of infrastructure investments and bilateral agreements established in previous years, supported by sustained high-level engagement among the participating governments. On July 3, 2024, Azerbaijan and China adopted a Joint Declaration on the Establishment of a Strategic Partnership in Astana. The declaration committed both countries to strengthening cooperation on the Middle Corridor and accelerating the development of China–Europe freight-train services. That same day, KTZ Express, Aktau International Commercial Sea Port, and Lianyungang Port Group reached an agreement on the key terms for establishing a joint venture to develop a container hub at Aktau Port. The US$ 96 million project envisaged the construction, management, and operation of a new container terminal with a planned annual capacity of 500,000 TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent unit). In September 2024, Lianyungang Port Group Co., Ltd., Kazakhstan Express Rail Company, and Aktau International Commercial Sea Port signed agreements to implement the Aktau Port Container Hub project. The facility officially began operations on June 9, 2025, strengthening Kazakhstan’s transit capacity along the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route. Meanwhile, in November 2024, during COP29 in Baku, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, and China’s Xi’an Free Trade Port Construction and Operation Co., Ltd. agreed to establish a joint venture to develop an intermodal cargo terminal on an initial 40-hectare site at the Port of Baku in Alat. In April 2025, the transport ministers of Azerbaijan and China inked the Agreement on International Multimodal Transportation in Beijing. In July 2025, Azerbaijan Railways (ADY) concluded separate agreements with China State Railway Group and Xi’an Free Trade Port to strengthen the Baku–Tbilisi–Kars railway, expand rail transit, and establish a container yard at Xi’an with an annual handling capacity of 20,000 TEUs. These joint initiatives establish the foundations for a logistics network connecting Chinese inland and coastal transport hubs with Kazakhstan’s railways and Caspian ports, Azerbaijan’s transport infrastructure, and onward routes to Europe. IMPLICATIONS: The proposed extension of the Lianyungang–Khorgos–Aktau chain to Baku represents a shift from developing individual transport projects toward coordinating a broader logistics network. The initiative seeks to connect existing facilities through more integrated freight services and information systems. Azerbaijan’s greater integration into the trans-Eurasian maritime network could strengthen China’s connectivity with markets west of the Caspian Sea and improve links between its inland logistics centers and European destinations. With an annual cargo throughput of 367 million tons and 7.1598 million TEUs, Lianyungang Port serves as a key transit gateway connecting China’s maritime trade routes with its inland transport networks, while Khorgos facilitates cross-border rail connectivity between China and the wider Caspian–Central Asia region. Aktau provides access to the Caspian Sea, while Baku serves as a gateway to the South Caucasus and onward transport routes through Georgia and Türkiye. With a planned annual cargo-handling capacity of 25 million tons, the Port of Baku is positioned to play a vital role in strengthening Eurasian connectivity. Closer integration with the Lianyungang–Khorgos–Aktau network could reinforce Azerbaijan’s strategic importance in the trans-Caspian trade and logistics ecosystem. Closer coordination with Baku is also enabling Astana to better leverage its Caspian logistics infrastructure and reinforce its position along westbound trade routes. To expand the Middle Corridor’s capacity, Kazakhstan plans to increase the combined cargo-handling capacity of the Aktau and Kuryk ports from 21 million to 30 million tons through modernization efforts. Authorities in Azerbaijan and Kazakhstan have been working to improve trans-Caspian freight transport along the Baku–Aktau route. As part of these efforts, an electronic data exchange system was introduced between the two ports in April 2025 to enhance inter-port coordination, streamline cargo operations, and improve freight efficiency across the Caspian basin. Moreover, given the proximity of Lianyungang Port to major maritime hubs in Japan and South Korea, the Lianyungang–Khorgos–Aktau–Baku logistics chain could provide both countries with an additional trade route into the wider Caspian-Central Asian region. Amid escalating geopolitical tensions, sanctions-related constraints, and disruptions linked to the war in Ukraine and the ongoing conflict in the Persian Gulf, the Middle Corridor is gaining prominence as a potentially more resilient supply channel for both countries. Tokyo and Seoul have already expanded their engagement with Central Asia through multilateral cooperation frameworks that strongly support their involvement in the Middle Corridor’s development. body: Russia-led bloc says Armenia would pay steep price for EU pivot 21 October 2026 14:31 (UTC+04:00) Akbar Novruz Read more A report prepared by four members of the Russia-led Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) has warned that Armenia could face severe economic consequences if it leaves the bloc to pursue European Union membership, while the impact on the remaining member states would be minimal. Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan have presented a report exceeding 70 pages examining the potential consequences of Armenia's withdrawal from the EAEU and its possible accession to the European Union. According to the report, Armenia would experience substantial economic losses from abandoning the Eurasian integration framework, whereas the economic consequences for the other four members would be comparatively insignificant. The assessment comes amid growing disagreements between Yerevan and its EAEU partners over Armenia's efforts to deepen political and economic relations with the European Union. The four member states have also requested an additional report, to be prepared by December, examining the potential implications of suspending Armenia's participation in the organisation. Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan, however, has rejected suggestions that his government has breached its commitments to the EAEU. He maintained that Armenia continues to fulfil its obligations under the bloc's agreements and has not taken a decision to withdraw from the organisation. Armenia joined the EAEU in 2015, becoming part of the economic integration framework alongside Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan. However, relations between Yerevan and its traditional partners have become increasingly complicated as Armenia seeks closer integration with European institutions. In 2025, the Armenian Parliament adopted legislation initiating the country's EU accession process, marking a significant step in Yerevan's efforts to strengthen ties with Brussels. The move drew criticism from Moscow and Minsk, which argue that full membership in the European Union is incompatible with continued participation in the EAEU because of conflicting customs and trade obligations. Despite the legislation, Armenia has not formally withdrawn from the Eurasian Economic Union, and the adoption of the law does not itself constitute EU membership or the formal opening of accession negotiations. The latest report highlights the widening disagreement between Armenia and its EAEU partners over the country's future economic alignment. While the four member states portray a potential Armenian withdrawal as economically damaging primarily to Yerevan, the Armenian government maintains that it has not made a final decision to leave the bloc. body: Home Azerbaijan Turkmenbashi needs container terminal for China transit - U.F.E. Shipping Azerbaijan News 21 October 2026 13:51 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Trend News Agency Aytaj Shiraliyeva Economics Journalist Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 21. A terminal should be built in Turkmenbashi to facilitate container transit from China through Turkmenistan, the Deputy Chairman of the Association of Freight Forwarders of Azerbaijan and General Director of U.F.E. Shipping, Elmir Poladov, said at the EU-Azerbaijan Business Forum in Baku on Wednesday, Trend ’s correspondent reports from the event. According to him, the falling level of the Caspian Sea requires more comprehensive measures than port dredging, as dredging works will have to be carried out regularly if the water level continues to decline. He noted that the level of the Caspian Sea largely depends on the volume of water flowing into it from the Volga River, which is decreasing. "The seabed can be deepened by several meters or even five meters every year, but the water level will fall again the following year, requiring dredging works to be carried out repeatedly," he explained. Poladov also highlighted Turkmenistan's potential for developing transportation along the Middle Corridor. According to him, the country has a sufficiently large and well-equipped port. However, several issues need to be resolved to organize container transportation from China to Azerbaijan through Turkmenistan. In particular, he pointed to the need to build a container terminal at the port of Turkmenbashi and establish a feeder shipping connection between Turkmenbashi and Alat. Poladov expressed hope that the implementation of existing projects would enable container cargo to be transported from China to Azerbaijan through Turkmenistan. Meanwhile, the EU-Azerbaijan Business Forum is taking place in Baku, marking the 30th anniversary of the partnership between the European Union and Azerbaijan, as well as the 10th anniversary of the forum. This year's event is being held under the theme "Bridging Corridors: Connectivity & Infrastructure." The main focus is on developing transport connectivity and infrastructure, strengthening economic cooperation between the EU and Azerbaijan, and expanding regional trade and investment. The forum's program includes high-level discussions, thematic sessions, and business meetings involving representatives from the public and private sectors. As reported, President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev was interviewed by Japan’s Nikkei newspaper on October 21, 2020. Trend presents the interview. - About the Karabakh conflict. Now foreign ministers from both Azerbaijan and Armenia are to visit Washington DC on Friday. What do you expect from that meeting. Are you ready for trilateral talk with some conditions? -Actually, as you know, the United States, Russia and France are three co-chairs of the OSCE Minsk Group which has a mandate to facilitate, to find a solution to the conflict between Armenia and Azerbaijan. Therefore, it’s natural that our ministers meet in these three capitals. These kind of meetings happened before, many times. And you know that there have been a visit to Moscow and meeting in Moscow. So, it is a continuation of the discussions on the peaceful settlement of the conflict. Of course, now situation on the ground have changed. The status quo no longer exists, the line of contact does not exist either. Therefore, of course, I think that now Armenian leadership must be more reasonable, and to commit itself to liberation of the occupied territories. So, our main objective at these discussions will be to find out whether the Armenian leadership is ready to liberate our territories or not, and if ready, then when? -Are you also invited to Moscow by President Putin? -No. -If invited are you ready to go? -I have been many times invited by President Putin. And I visited Moscow many times some years even several times a year. Therefore, it is obvious, between partner countries and neighbors these high level contacts are common. And President Putin also visited Azerbaijan many times. -If there is any progress on Friday between the ministers, is it possible to have a trilateral meeting in Moscow with Armenian prime minister also joining? -Well, of course it is possible. Because this kind of meetings happened before. It depends on what will be the agenda if this kind of meeting is going to take place. Because with this Armenian government unfortunately, the prospects for peaceful settlement are very remote. Because very counter-productive and provocative statements and actions on behalf of Armenian leadership made actual negotiations senseless. Because the main topic on negotiation table always has been liberation of the occupied territories of Azerbaijan, in accordance with the UN Security Council resolutions. And when Armenian prime minister declares that "Karabakh is Armenia", when he declares that "Azerbaijan must negotiate with Nagorno-Karabakh’s so-called authorities", and when he orders ballistic missile strike on a peaceful city of Ganja and daily attacks on other cities of Azerbaijan, there is not much room for negotiations. Therefore, we had to prove Armenian government that they cannot afford any longer to make these aggressive steps without any punishment. We are punishing them on the ground. We are liberating our territories. Every day almost I announce new cities and villages which have been liberated from Armenian occupation. Armenia is suffering very bitter defeat on the battlefield. Therefore, of course, they must be more reasonable, and definitely, the matter of liberation of the territories is happening. We wanted to achieve it through peaceful talks. But due to Armenian unconstructive position and provocative steps it was not possible. Therefore, we are now liberating our territories on the battlefield. -Would you say the second ceasefire has already failed or ended? Would you say the battles are still going on? -Second attempts to achieve ceasefire failed because two minutes after the time when ceasefire had to be efficient they violated the ceasefire. They again, attacked our peaceful cities, this morning from 6 am until 8 am they launched more than 100 times their shells on peaceful city of Tartar which suffered mostly and they attack our military position. They wanted to regain the territories which have already been liberated. As you know, after the first attempt of ceasefire in less than 24 hours, they attacked from the territory of Armenia with ballistic missile, second largest city of Azerbaijan – Ganja, which is a war crime. And the Armenian government will be responsible for that. So, they violate the ceasefire. I always say that ceasefire cannot be achieved unilaterally. If we are attacked, we must not only defend ourselves, but also launch a counter-attack. And I can tell you after they violated ceasefire second time, we liberated the city of Zangilan, and many villages. So, the more time passes on the battlefield, the more territories we liberate. Therefore, Armenian government should think seriously about their behavior and make a strong commitment if they want the ceasefire to be efficient. First, not to violate it, second, not to attempt to regain the territories which we already liberated, and make a commitment about liberation of occupied territories of Azerbaijan. -The ceasefires so far had been for humanitarian purposes, including exchange of captives and bodies. So, do you think that means ceasefire, maybe there will be another one, but it will be over once exchange of captives are done? Is there a substantial ceasefire that will hold or is it just a temporary one, if there is any? -It was announced on humanitarian grounds, and also as you know in Moscow declaration there was a reference to substantive negotiations. And the fact that the format of negotiations is unchanged, which means that there will be no more attempts from Armenian side to try to integrate the so-called "Nagorno-Karabakh authorities" on negotiation table. This was rejected by us, and by the Minsk Group. Therefore, of course, if Armenia commits to negotiations and with a strong commitment to liberate the territories which they so far did not announce then, this ceasefire will be a long-termed. Because we want to resolve this problem peacefully. But if, they will try to use ceasefire in order to mobilize their resources, in order to get additional foreign military assistance and to launch a new attack on us, of course, this ceasefire will not last long. It depends on them. -So, in order to get on the table of negotiations would you demand Armenia to agree to withdraw at least some of maybe the seven regions in advance, before any negotiation? -They must make a strong commitment that they will liberate these territories. Because, this is the part of the basic principles which have been agreed between two countries with the facilitation of the Minsk Group. Basic principles say that the occupied territories must be returned to Azerbaijan and our refugees and internally displaced persons must return to all the occupied territories, including territory of Nagorno-Karabakh, and including territory of ancient Azerbaijani city of Shusha. Therefore, the Armenian government must clearly declare that they are committed to this principles, they will liberate these territories, and then of course, negotiations will start. We do not put a pre-condition now that territories must be liberated first and then negotiations started. body: Home Azerbaijan Society Azerbaijan’s Press Council warns of fake journalist WhatsApp accounts Society Press release 21 October 2026 12:35 (UTC +04:00) Alish Abdulla Parliamentary Correspondent Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 21. The creation of fake WhatsApp accounts in the names of journalists and the subsequent sending of messages in Azerbaijan are matters of concern. This was reflected in a report published by the Press Council of Azerbaijan. According to the report, in recent days, information has been received regarding the creation of fake WhatsApp accounts in the names of well-known journalists, which are then used to send messages containing various types of content. "Statements from law enforcement agencies indicate that such activities are carried out by organized cybercriminal networks operating from outside Azerbaijan. By utilizing artificial intelligence algorithms and specialized software, these groups target civil servants, employees of various enterprises and organizations, as well as journalists and other citizens. Despite numerous awareness-raising initiatives, some citizens still fall victim to such fraudulent schemes," the council emphasized. Noting that these occurrences are not limited to isolated incidents and could potentially evolve into a concerning trend, the Press Council has urged journalists and media professionals in general to exercise caution. "It’s crucial not to trust, respond to, or share the content of suspicious messages, even if they appear to come from people they know, without first verifying their authenticity. It’s especially important to check the source and veracity of information concerning socio-political matters. It should be remembered that messages sent via fake accounts are intended to create false impressions about individuals, damage their reputations, and mislead public opinion," the statement noted. The Press Council recommended those who encounter such situations take the following steps: “- Call the Ministry of Internal Affairs' '102' service to notify law enforcement authorities. You may also contact the police station in your local area. - Reach out to the National Cybersecurity Agency. Report the incident via email at [email protected] or contact the Agency’s hotline at 1654. - Inform the public. Use your own social media accounts to make it publicly known that a fake account is operating in your name. People should know that the messages sent from that account do not come from you, and they shouldn’t accept their content as the truth. - Report the fake account to the WhatsApp platform. To do this, use the available complaint function by logging into the account profile. Keep screenshots of messages sent from the fake account, phone number, and other relevant information as evidence. In order to block the fake account, other victims can be called to file a complaint accordingly. Complaining by a minimum of 15 people is more effective. - Verify the authenticity of messages by alternative means. If you receive a suspicious message from someone you know, verify the authenticity of the information by contacting them via phone call or other known means of communication,” the report said. The report added that when journalists and other media representatives encounter such situations, they can also inform the Azerbaijan Press Council and apply to the Council for appropriate support. The Press Council called on journalists and the public to be vigilant in the digital environment, to check information sources, and not to create conditions for the spread of possible provocations carried out through fake accounts. Uzbekistan’s state-owned oil and gas company Uzbekneftegaz and China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) have discussed expanding cooperation in oil and gas exploration, drilling, production efficiency and fuel supplies during a meeting in Tashkent on October 20. This was reflected in the statement by the Uzbekneftegaz, following a meeting between Uzbekneftegaz Chairman Abdugani Sanginov and a CNPC delegation led by company President Zhou Xinhuai to review ongoing projects, accelerate joint initiatives and explore new areas of cooperation. The sides reviewed joint work in drilling, geological exploration, seismic surveys, improving gas recovery rates at fields, digitalization, engineering and the supply of modern equipment. Projects involving CNPC subsidiaries Xibu, BGP, CCDC and CNLC were highlighted as contributing to the development of Uzbekistan’s technological capabilities in the oil and gas sector. In addition, the meeting focused on efforts to address the consequences of an accident at the M-25 field. The project includes plans to drill rescue wells as part of the response, according to the statement. The sides also discussed diversifying sources of petroleum product supplies to ensure stable fuel availability in Uzbekistan’s domestic market. They expressed readiness to develop long-term supply mechanisms and improve coordination between the relevant companies. As cooperation expands, the parties considered establishing a permanent CNPC representative office in Tashkent and developing administrative infrastructure to coordinate joint projects. Moreover, they discussed opportunities to support social initiatives. The talks included support for the Tashkent branch of Gubkin Russian State University of Oil and Gas, with a focus on training qualified engineering and technical specialists to meet the needs of Uzbekistan’s oil and gas industry and future projects. The sides reaffirmed their commitment to deepening the partnership, introducing new technological solutions and advancing joint initiatives toward practical implementation. President Serdar Berdimuhamedov has highlighted plans to expand gas exports and advance the Turkmenistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan-India (TAPI) pipeline project in a congratulatory message to participants and guests of the 31st International Conference and Exhibition “Oil and Gas of Turkmenistan - 2026” (OGT 2026), which opens in Ashgabat on Wednesday, Trend 's special correspondent reports. In his message, the president said the annual forum would provide an opportunity to exchange views on priorities for developing the country’s fuel and energy sector, prospects for mutually beneficial partnerships and modern approaches to industry modernization. The accompanying exhibition, he added, would showcase innovations, advanced technologies and new projects. Berdimuhamedov highlighted the Galkynysh gas field, one of the world’s largest in terms of reserves, describing it as a key resource base for expanding Turkmenistan’s gas exports. Development of the field is proceeding in stages, with the fourth phase of industrial development launched in April 2026. The president described the launch as a historically significant step toward substantially increasing exports of natural gas. He also highlighted the TAPI gas pipeline project, which is intended to strengthen energy security and promote prosperity across the region. Development of offshore license blocks in Turkmenistan’s sector of the Caspian Sea is also continuing, building on three decades of cooperation with leading international oil and gas companies. “We will continue implementing such projects,” Berdimuhamedov said. The president also emphasized the importance of economic diversification. Turkmenistan’s National Strategy for Industrial Development for 2030-2045 is focused on hydrocarbon processing and the production of high-quality, environmentally friendly products, he noted. Berdimuhamedov stressed that neutral Turkmenistan remains open to equal and mutually beneficial partnerships, adding that foreign investors would be provided with the necessary conditions to participate in major promising projects. He expressed confidence that OGT 2026 would serve as a platform for exchanging expertise between Turkmen specialists and international partners and help lay the groundwork for future cooperation. The 31st International Conference and Exhibition “Oil and Gas of Turkmenistan - OGT 2026” is being held on 21-23 October 2026 in Ashgabat under the motto “Energy. Partnership. Progress.” Organised by the State Concerns Turkmengaz and Turkmennebit, the State Corporation Turkmengeology, and the Turkmen Energy Forum, it is Turkmenistan’s flagship energy event and one of the leading oil and gas forums in Eurasia. Registration closed with more than 1,700 delegates from 75 countries representing around 450 companies; the accompanying exhibition is expected to attract over 10,000 visitors and features more than 100 companies. Key themes include further development of the Galkynysh gas field (with Phase IV launched in April 2026), progress on the TAPI pipeline, Caspian offshore projects, gas processing and petrochemicals, digitalisation, methane emissions reduction, and investment opportunities. Notable partners and sponsors include SOCAR (lead/premier partner), Dragon Oil (diamond sponsor), CNPC (platinum), and Baker Hughes (silver), with Malaysia presenting its first national pavilion. body: Home Central Asia Kazakhstan Tokayev, CNMC chairman discuss Kazakhstan-China copper smelter project Kazakhstan News 20 October 2026 18:04 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Akorda Alyona Pavlenko Journalist, International Desk Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 20. Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev met with China Nonferrous Metal Mining Group (CNMC) Chairman Wen Gang after launching construction of the Aktogay copper smelter in the Abai region via video link, according to the Kazakh presidential press service. Tokayev highlighted CNMC's international experience in mining and metallurgy and its contribution to developing Kazakhstan's industrial capacity. He said the project would give additional impetus to economic development in the Abai region and Kazakhstan's manufacturing industry. Wen Gang thanked Tokayev for his trust in CNMC to implement the project and for taking part in the construction launch ceremony. He assured the president that the company would carry out construction using advanced technologies and within the established timeframe, with particular attention to industrial and environmental safety. Wen Gang said the project would also expand cooperation in local workforce training and the exchange of expertise. The two sides noted that the project would serve as an example of industrial cooperation between Kazakhstan and China and provide a basis for further joint work in metallurgy and deeper processing. Earlier today, Tokayev launched construction of the Aktogay copper smelter via video link. The plant, being developed by KAZ Minerals Group with China's NFC as the engineering partner, will have an annual capacity of 300,000 tons of cathode copper. The first copper cathode is scheduled to be produced in 2030, and the project is expected to create more than 1,000 jobs. body: Home Azerbaijan Azerbaijan completes Horadiz-Aghband highway, railway work ongoing Azerbaijan News 20 October 2026 15:12 (UTC +04:00) Photo: State Agency of Azerbaijan Motorways Aytaj Shiraliyeva Economics Journalist Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 20. The construction of the Horadiz-Aghband highway in Azerbaijan has been completed, while work on the railway line, part of the development of the Zangezur Corridor, is still underway. This was reflected in a statement by the Ministry of Digital Development and Transport of Azerbaijan. According to the information, efforts are also being made to modernize the railway infrastructure in Nakhchivan. "The development of the Zangezur Corridor is of particular importance for expanding Azerbaijan's transit potential and diversifying international transport routes. The development of this corridor is expected to create additional capacity for the transport of up to 15 million tons of cargo per year and strengthen regional transport links," the statement said. On August 8, 2025, following a trilateral meeting in Washington involving U.S. President Donald Trump, Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev and Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan signed a joint declaration on ensuring peace between Baku and Yerevan, as well as on establishing transportation links between the main part of Azerbaijan and the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic. This project has been named the “Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity” (TRIPP). The Horadiz–Jabrayil–Zangilan–Agbhband highway is part of the Hajigabul–Horadiz–Aghband highway and the Zangezur Corridor. The total length of the project is 149.9 kilometers, of which 123.6 kilometers comprise the main section of the road. The road is built to technical category 1B standards with four to six lanes. The project includes the construction of three tunnels with a total length of 12,032 meters, 28 bridges, eight interchanges, as well as underpasses and culverts. The development of the Zangezur Corridor is aimed at expanding Azerbaijan’s transportation links with the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic and increasing the country’s transit capacity. body: IN BRIEF: Kremlin Spokesman’s key statements on Ukraine, China, Armenia It is impossible to achieve a full settlement of the Ukrainian conflict without Kiev’s participation, Dmitry Peskov said Russian Presidential Spokesman Dmitry Peskov © Artyom Geodakyan/TASS MOSCOW, October 21. /TASS/. Russia’s position on a potential "energy ceasefire" with Ukraine remains unchanged, as Moscow seeks peace rather than a truce, Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters. He also noted that the Kremlin has not yet reviewed a report by the Eurasian Intergovernmental Council on the potential consequences of Armenia suspending its membership in the EAEU. TASS has compiled the key remarks made by the Kremlin spokesperson. President’s schedule Russian President Vladimir Putin is scheduled to hold talks with Premier of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China Li Qiang in St. Petersburg today. Ukraine settlement Russia’s position on a potential "energy ceasefire" with Ukraine remains unchanged. Moscow seeks peace, not a truce: "Nothing has changed. We need peace, not a truce." It is impossible to achieve a full settlement of the Ukrainian conflict without Kiev’s participation. "Naturally, it is impossible to fully resolve the Ukrainian issue without a representative from Kiev being present. Therefore, someone in Kiev must make a responsible decision. That is essential." Finnish President Alexander Stubb simply repeating the general European stance on Ukraine is unlikely to contribute constructively to a resolution. "We shall see what kind of constructive contribution Mr. Stubb might be able to make. If he can make a constructive contribution, that would be viewed positively. If not – if he can only repeat the shared European position – then it is unlikely to help constructively." Report on consequences of Armenia suspending EAEU membership The Kremlin has not yet examined the report by the Eurasian Intergovernmental Council on the potential consequences of Armenia suspending its membership in the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU): "No, we have not reviewed it. We have not reviewed it yet." Важное Путин провел переговоры со спецпосланником президента США Уиткоффом. Главное

body: США и Украина во вторник, 20 октября, завершили переговоры в Осло с участием представителей Евросоюза и НАТО. После них спецпосланник Белого дома Стивен Уиткофф отправился в Санкт-Петербург на встречу с президентом РФ Владимиром Путиным. Он должен передать новый план мирного урегулирования, выработанный в Норвегии. Что пишут СМИ о перспективах переговорного процесса — в дайджесте «Известий». Axios: Уиткофф представит Путину мирное предложение после переговоров с Зеленским По словам американского чиновника, специальный посланник Белого дома Стивен Уиткофф встретится с президентом России Владимиром Путиным в Санкт-Петербурге 21 октября и представит ему обновленное предложение по прекращению конфликта на Украине. Зять и советник президента США Дональда Трампа, Джаред Кушнер, примет участие во встрече в режиме онлайн. Axios Уиткофф прибудет в Россию после дня переговоров в Осло с президентом Украины Владимиром Зеленским, а также лидерами Норвегии и Финляндии и представителями Франции, Великобритании, Германии, Польши, ЕС и НАТО. Обсуждения в Осло были сосредоточены на разработке единого предложения по «рамочному соглашению» о прекращении конфликта. Американский чиновник заявил, что Украина «выдвинула новые идеи и предложения, которые были подробно обсуждены». Он добавил, что стороны добились «значительного прогресса» и теперь имеют «твердое согласие на рабочем уровне» относительно дальнейших шагов. Reuters: Трамп подталкивает Киев к урегулированию По словам представителя США, Украина представила на переговорах в Осло, в которых участвовали лидеры Норвегии и Финляндии, а также представители Европы и НАТО, новые идеи и предложения. Участники достигли «значительного прогресса» в выработке согласованного подхода к взаимодействию с Россией. Чиновник сообщил, что в ходе переговоров обсуждались «ключевые элементы комплексной мирной структуры», включая гарантии безопасности для Украины, план дальнейшего экономического восстановления и более широкую архитектуру европейской безопасности. Reuters Зеленский прибыл в Осло, стремясь наладить отношения с Вашингтоном, которые опустились до рекордно низкого уровня на фоне попыток Трампа сблизиться с Москвой. Киев выражал недовольство тем, что Вашингтон удерживает критически важную военную помощь и разведывательные данные. После переговоров Зеленский заявил, что Киев рассчитывает обсудить ключевые вопросы завершения конфликта в ходе трехсторонней встречи лидеров Украины, России и США. Премьер-министр Норвегии Йонас Гар Стёре заявил на пресс-конференции, что встреча в Осло прошла хорошо и конструктивно, а президент Финляндии Александр Стубб добавил: «Думаю, мирный процесс снова на верном пути». Трамп и Зеленский продолжают публично ссориться. Что это означает Associated Press: Зеленский заявил о получении разведданных от США Зеленский заявил в Осло, что Киев вновь получает предупреждения от своих партнеров о приближающихся ракетах. По меньшей мере неделю назад украинский лидер заявлял, что его страна не получала данных о баллистических ракетах, нацеленных на столицу. По его словам, такая информация спасает жизни, позволяя оповестить население и давая воинским частям время попытаться перехватить ракеты. Associated Press Зеленский заявил, что изменения произошли после переговоров с его американскими коллегами, включая телефонный разговор с госсекретарем США Марко Рубио. По словам Зеленского, у Украины почти закончились американские зенитные ракеты Patriot, необходимые для перехвата баллистических ракет, и он призвал Вашингтон направить больше таких боеприпасов. Он отметил, что Пентагон задерживает поставку ракет, закупленных для Украины другими странами. Украинский лидер также заявил, что в его стране по-прежнему действуют ограничения скорости при использовании Starshield, военной версии спутникового интернет-сервиса Starlink. Bloomberg: Украина не смогла бы существовать без поддержки США, заявил Рубио Госсекретарь США Марко Рубио выступил в защиту поддержки Украины со стороны администрации Трампа, заявив, что страна «не существовала бы» без поддержки США. Он заявил об этом, отвечая на вопросы о том, что генеральный директор SpaceX Илон Маск якобы распорядился замедлить работу спутниковой системы Starshield, которая помогает Украине отражать воздушные атаки. Bloomberg «Если бы не помощь Соединенных Штатов, в том числе при администрации Трампа, Украины сейчас бы не существовало, — заявил Рубио журналистам [21 октября] во время визита в Индию. — Украина как суверенное государство не существовала бы». Рубио заявил, что ему ничего не было известно о каком-либо предварительном уведомлении об отключении Starshield со стороны Трампа, и сказал, что США в любом случае не могут контролировать, что частная компания делает со своей продукцией. Госсекретарь также отметил, что сейчас ведутся «очень сложные переговоры» с целью урегулирования конфликта. По его словам, сейчас они сосредоточены на судьбе Донбасса, и были предложены некоторые «креативные идеи» для преодоления разногласий. Почему обострился конфликт между Зеленским и Трампом? Ответы на главные вопросы BBC News: Трамп и Зеленский, похоже, находятся в конфронтации Объятия, которыми Уиткофф встретил Зеленского перед переговорами в Осло, вряд ли развеяли опасения украинского лидера по поводу нынешнего курса политики США в отношении его страны. Зеленский опубликовал видео этого момента в социальных сетях, но, учитывая всё, что произошло в октябре, считает ли он Трампа по-прежнему своим партнером? Эти двое политиков никогда не были близки — это очевидно, — но не поссорились ли они теперь окончательно? BBC News Личные нападки типичны для жесткого подхода Трампа к дипломатии.
