Ташкенттің стратегиясы теміржол қатынасы географиясын кеңейтуді көздейді: оларды оңтүстікке – Ауғанстанмен шекараға дейін, сондай-ақ батысқа – Нөкіске дейін жеткізу жоспарланған. Орталық Азияда жолаушы таситын жүрдек пойыз қатынасын және соған сәйкес инфрақұрылымды дамытып жатқан жалғыз елден көршілерінің үйренері бар ма? "Шапшаң, жайлы әрі таңғаларлықтай оңай" – үндістандық тревел-блогер Barnali Biswas өзбекстандық "Афрасиаб" пойызын осылай сипаттаған . Оның әріптесі, тағы бір блогер Shailab Vlogs 7 Өзбекстанға жасаған сапары жайлы: "Премиум бизнес-классқа жататын орындықтарына, заманауи интерьеріне және қызмет деңгейіне көңіл толады" деп пікір қосқан . Ресейліктер де "Әмір Темірдің ұрпақтары жылдамдық жағынан РЖД-мен Ресейдің теміржол компаниясы бәсекеге түсіп жатыр" деп қызғаныш аралас көңіл-күймен атап өткен . Ал Өзбекстан болса Орталық Азия өңіріндегі теміржол қатынасының көшбасшысы мәртебесін одан ары нығайтып жатыр. Алғашқы "Афрасиаб" және кейін жаңғырған көлік желісі Өзбекстанда кейінгі он бес жылда жолаушы пойыздарын дамыту шын мәнінде серпін алды. "Афрасиаб" брендімен шығатын испаниялық Talgo 250 пойызының алғашқы жолаушы рейсі елді Ислам Каримов басқарып тұрған кезде, яғни 2011 жылы іске қосылған. Ол Ташкент пен Самарқанды байланыстырып, жолға кететін уақыт бұрынғы төрт сағаттан екі сағатқа дейін қысқарқан. Жылдар өте, Шавкат Мирзияев билікке келгесін және туристерге шекара ашылғаннан кейін "Афрасиаб" Өзбекстанның бетке ұстар брендіне айналды: елге шеттен келетін қонақтар легі еселеп көбейіп, мемлекет астанасы мен ортағасырлық көрікті тарихи орындарға бай Самарқанның арасына қатынайтын жүрдек пойызға сұраныс тіптен артты. 2016 жылдың қыркүйегінде "Афрасиаб" бағыты Ұлы Жібек жолында ғасырлар бойы маңызды сауда торабы қызметін атқарған және бірегей сәулет ескерткіштерін сақтап қалған тағы бір көне қала – Бұхараға дейін жетті . Қазір "Афрасиаб" Ташкенттен Самарқан, Бұхара, Қаршы және Науаи қалаларына қатынайды. "Афрасиаб" жүрдек пойызының жолсерігі Өзбекстан билігі мұнымен тоқтап қалмақ емес. Ташкент осы тәжірибені ары қарай кеңейтіп жатыр. Үкімет батыс пен оңтүстікке қарай тарайтын теміржол желісін электрге қосуды бастады . Оңтүстікте Ауғанстанмен шекараға жақын жатқан Термез қаласына (Ташкенттен шамамен 650 шақырым) пойыз қатынасын жолға қою жоспарда бар. Мұндағы мақсат – турист тарту ғана емес, Орталық Азиядағы халқы ең көп елдің түкпір-түкпірін жүрдек пойыз қатынасымен қамтамасыз ету екені анық. Биыл мамыр айында Өзбекстанда ортағасырлық Хорезмшахтар мемлекетінің соңғы билеушісінің құрметіне аталған "Жәлеләддин Мәңгіберді" атты жүйрік жаңа электр пойызы іске қосылды . Оңтүстіккореялық Hyundai Rotem компаниясы жасап шығарған пойыз Ташкент – Самарқан – Бұхара – Хиуа бағыты бойынша қатынайды. Ташкент пен шалғайдағы тарихи орталық – Хиуа арасында (шамамен 1000 шақырым) жол жүруге кететін уақыт екі есеге жуық қысқарып, 14 сағаттан жеті жарым сағатқа түсті. "Жәлеләддин Мәңгіберді" сағатына 250 шақырымға дейін жылдамдықпен жүйтки алады және Өзбекстан климатына бейімделген: +50 °C-қа дейінгі аптап ыстыққа, −40 °C-қа дейінгі аязға төзімді әрі Қызылқұмның шөл дала шаңынан қорғалған деп сипаттайды тасымалдаушы компания. Қыркүйектің ортасында президент Мирзияевтің Оңтүстік Кореяға сапары барысында Ташкент қазір іске асырылып жатқан келісімшарттарға қосымша тағы сегіз жүрдек электр пойызын сатып алу жөнінде Hyundai Rotem компаниясымен шартқа отырды . Олар өзге бағыттарға қоса, Ташкенттен елдің шығысындағы Әндіжанға дейінгі стратегиялық маңызы бар әрі техникалық тұрғыдан күрделі, тау арқылы өтетін бағытқа қатынайтын болады деп жоспарланған. Оңтүстік Корея басылымдарының хабарлауынша , бұл пойыздар Өзбекстан жағдайына бейімделіп жобаланған – олардың негізгі тораптары ыстықтан және құмнан сенімді қорғалған. Пойыздың доңғалақ жұбы кореялық стандарт өлшемнен (1435 мм) өзгеше – 1520 мм рельс табанына шақтап жасалған. Кореялық жаңа пойыз жобада көзделген жылдамдығымен жүйтки алуы үшін Өзбекстанда теміржол рельстері, автоматика жүйелері мен электр желілері жаңғыртылып жатыр деп хабарлады елдің көлік министрлігі. Үкімет ел астанасы мен өзге қалалар арасында ғана рейс ашып қоймай, шалғай облыстарды да өзара байланыстырып жатыр. 2026 жылдың тамыз және қыркүйек айларында Өзбекстанда қытайлық CRRC Dalian компаниясы жасап шығарған, ең жоғарғы жылдамдығы сағатына 160 шақырымға дейін жететін қазіргі заманғы CR200J электр пойыздары іске қосылды – олар Хиуа мен Бұхара арасына қатынайды. 10 қыркүйектен бастап CR200J электр пойызы Ташкенттен Әндіжанға да қатынай бастады . 2027 жылдың наурыз айында Өзбекстан билігі Ташкент пен Қарақалпақстан астанасы Нөкіс арасына қатынайтын жүрдек пойызды іске қосуды жоспарлап отыр. Жол жүру уақыты 16 сағаттан 7 сағатқа дейін қысқарады дейді жобаны таныстырғандар. Көршілер үйренер нәрсе бар ма? Өзбекстан 2017 – 2019 жылдары шекарасын ашып, ондаған елдің азаматтары үшін визасыз режим енгізгеннен кейін "Афрасиаб" пойызы әлемдік басылымдардың басты тақырыбы болды. CNN мен National Geographic Орталық Азиядағы елдің теміржол көлігін дамытудағы тәжірибесі жайлы жазды. "Уақыт үнемдеу үшін "Афрасиаб" жүрдек пойызын пайдалана аласыз: олар Ташкентті Самарқанмен (жол шамамен 2,5 сағат алады), ал Самарқанды Бұхарамен (1,5-тен 2 сағатқа дейін) жалғайды. Эконом-класс вагондарында Wi-Fi мен кондиционер бар, ал вагон-рестораннан қапталған жеңіл тағам мен палау сатып алуға болады. Әдеттегі жолаушы пойызына қарағанда "Афрасиабқа" билет тез сатылып кетеді", – деді Өзбекстан туралы "Әлемдегі алғашқы супермагистральмен Жібек жолы бойына таңғажайып саяхат" атты репортажында америкалық жазушы әрі National Geographic журналисі Гари Штейнгарт. ОҚИ ОТЫРЫҢЫЗ Украинадағы бейбітшілік, Орталық Азиядағы әріптестік. Самарқанда жүрген Марко Рубио не деді? Жүйрік пойыздың артықшылығын Өзбекстанға саяхаттап барған көрші елдердің адамдары да байқап жүр. Қырғызстанның көлемі жағынан екінші қаласы – Оштың тұрғыны Сәруар биыл жазда Әндіжанда тұратын туыстарына Ташкенттен CRRC Dalian электр пойызымен барған. Ол автобуспен немесе өзге автокөлікпен жүргеннен гөрі жүрдек пойызбен әлдеқайда жылдам әрі ыңғайлы баруға болатынын айтты. "Маған ең ұнағаны – вагондары кең, орындықтары ыңғайлы екен. Мысалы, әжетханаға бару үшін орныңнан тұратын болсаң қасыңда отырған адамдарды мазаламайсың, – деді ол. – Пойыздағы қызмет көрсету деңгейі көңілімнен шықты: жолсеріктер сәнді киінген, өте сыпайы. Сапар барысында бізге екі рет шай, үш рет су ұсынды, ал кенеттен кондиционер сөніп қалғанда, қолайсыздықты жуып-шаю үшін тегін балмұздақ таратты. Мені тағы бір таңғалдырғаны – пойыз дәл уақытында жүретіні. Билетімде пойыз сағат 14:14-те келеді деп жазылған. Мен іштей: "Қой, мүмкін емес" деп тіпті күліп те алғам. Ал жеткен соң пойыздан түсіп, сағатыма қарасам – уақыт 14:14 болыпты. Пойыз сол көрсетілген сағат-минутында келді". Астана қаласының тұрғыны Петр "Азаттық Азияға" Өзбекстанда "Афрасиаб" қызметін екі рет – 2019 және 2023 жылдары пайдаланғанын айтты. Екі жолы да Ташкенттен Самарқанға барып, одан кері қайтқан. body: География торговли кондитерскими изделиями и шоколадом за восемь месяцев 2026 года заметно изменилась: за счет сильного августовского рывка Россия вернула себе первое место среди поставщиков, опередив Казахстан. На экспортном направлении главным рынком сбыта остается Таджикистан, говорится в данных Национального статистического комитета. На экспортном направлении Таджикистан окончательно утвердился в качестве главного покупателя кыргызстанских сладостей, обеспечив свыше 65 процентов всей выручки отечественных кондитеров. При этом поставки в Узбекистан продемонстрировали заметное ускорение: доля соседней страны в структуре кыргызского экспорта кондитерских изделий выросла до 16,87 процента. Сладкий экспорт Поставки кондитерской продукции и шоколада из Кыргызстана в январе — августе 2026 года составили 11,5 миллиона долларов при объеме 1 тысяча 979,9 тонны. В деньгах зарубежная выручка отечественных фабрик увеличилась за год на 5,22 процента. На экспортном направлении Таджикистан окончательно утвердился в качестве главного покупателя кыргызстанских сладостей, обеспечив свыше 65 процентов всей выручки отечественных кондитеров. Одновременно заметно ускорились поставки в Узбекистан: доля соседней страны выросла до 16,87 процента. В основном, мы продаем шоколад и продукты с содержанием какао — 1 тысяча 816 тонн на 11 миллионов долларов (рост на 6,22 процента по стоимости). Главный покупатель — Таджикистан. Кондитерские изделия из сахара (включая белый шоколад) уходят в Таджикистан и Казахстан. За восемь месяцев отгрузили 158,9 тонны на 446,6 тысячи. Падение стоимости на 15,82 процента. Топ-5 стран-покупателей сладостей Таджикистан — доля рынка 65,23 процента (7,5 миллиона долларов). Узбекистан — 16,87 процента (1,9 миллиона долларов). Монголия — 8,92 процента (1 миллион долларов). Туркменистан — 4,98 процента (572,9 тысячи долларов). Казахстан — 2,47 процента (284,5 тысячи долларов). Кто наполняет наш рынок сладостями Импорт кондитерской продукции и сырья в Кыргызстан за восемь месяцев достиг 85,8 миллиона долларов при объеме 22 тысячи 571,9 тонны. В деньгах закупки выросли на 9,32 процента. Читайте по теме Кыргызстан вошел в десятку крупных импортеров шоколада из России Лидерами по поставкам шоколада и продуктов с какао являются Россия и Казахстан. Всего поставили 13 тысяч 594,9 тонны на 63,5 миллиона долларов (рост на 10,67 процента). Кондитерские изделия из сахара импортируют, в основном, из России и Украины. Кыргызстан закупил 8 тысяч 714,4 тонны продукции на 20,6 миллиона долларов (рост на 8,09 процента). А вот какао-порошок без сахара мы закупаем в Германии и Малайзии. Его поставили 252,9 тонны на 1,6 миллиона долларов (падение на 11,11 процента). Топ импортеров сладостей Россия — доля рынка 37,78 процента (32,4 миллиона долларов). Казахстан — 35,16 процента (30,2 миллиона долларов). Украина — 5,76 процента (4,9 миллиона долларов). Германия — 4,69 процента (4 миллиона долларов). Узбекистан — 4,21 процента (3,6 миллиона долларов). Сладкий минус в торговле За восемь месяцев дефицит торгового баланса Кыргызстана по кондитерским изделиям и шоколаду достигло 74,3 миллиона долларов. В августе он увеличился еще на 9,7 миллиона долларов США. Преобладание импортного шоколада и конфет из России и Казахстана продолжает определять динамику внутреннего рынка КР, компенсируя экспортные успехи кыргызских фабрик в Таджикистане и Узбекистане.

body: По итогам января — августа 2026 года объемы импортных закупок превзошли экспорт Кыргызстана в 1,98 раза. Основным фактором такого разрыва стал масштабный ввоз зарубежных сыров, творога и сухого молока. Об этом говорится в данных Национального статистического комитета. Только в августе КР закупила зарубежной молочной продукции на 6,1 миллиона долларов, что привело к увеличению торговой дыры еще на 3,8 миллиона долларов. По деньгам поступления снизились на 45,31 процента по сравнению с прошлым годом. Пахта, йогурт, кефир — главная позиция молочного экспорта. Вывезли 7 тысяч 620,4 тонны на 6,7 миллиона долларов. body: Kyrgyzstan’s Ministry of Justice has completed the creation of a new register of mass media. The public database contains information on 2,959 media outlets, the ministry said. The register is open to all users and allows them to check whether a particular media outlet’s name is already registered before submitting an application. The Ministry of Justice has also updated the procedure for state registration of media outlets. Registration certificates are now issued electronically and can be downloaded from the ministry’s website. Under the new rules, media outlets are required to re-register only if their founder or name changes. Any other changes to registration details must be reported to the Ministry of Justice within 30 calendar days. The time required to provide services has also been reduced. Entering information into the register now takes three working days instead of seven, while extracts from the register are issued within seven working days. The new register was established as part of the implementation of Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 241, dated April 10, 2026. The resolution approved regulations governing the state registration and re-registration of media outlets, as well as the grounds for refusing registration. Links to the register and the updated registration rules have been published on the Ministry of Justice’s official Telegram channel.

body: The city of Manas in Jalal-Abad region will be granted special status as the country’s second economic center, President Sadyr Japarov said at a national meeting «Strategic Tasks for the Next Five-Year Period.» According to Japarov, Manas will become a key transport and logistics hub, as well as a business center in southern Kyrgyzstan. body: Bakyt Sydykov, the President's Special Representative for Special Assignments (on sanctions policy and the minimization of sanctions risks), met with heads of foreign diplomatic missions in Kyrgyzstan. According to the Ministry of Economy and Commerce, international partners were briefed on measures being taken to prevent and minimize sanctions risks. The special representative said that 52 legal entities had ceased operations, compulsory liquidation procedures had been initiated against another 57, and 25 companies were under investigation. "State-owned banks have decided to terminate services for more than 240 accounts. In addition, international consulting firm Kroll has been engaged to independently assess sanctions compliance systems,” the Ministry of Economy said. The ministry also noted that measures have been introduced to improve export controls, strengthen the regulation of virtual assets, and preempt potential sanctions-related risks. The briefing also covered future cooperation with international partners, including information sharing, expert consultations, and the development of joint approaches to preventing sanctions risks. Related news Sanctions: Kyrgyzstan announces liquidation of state-backed USDKG stablecoin Due to suspicions of circumventing restrictions imposed on Russia, companies in third countries have increasingly become targets of international sanctions. For instance, the European Union’s 21st package of anti-Russian sanctions included three firms from the Kyrgyz Republic, as well as EcoIslamicBank. Additionally, the European Union has imposed restrictions on the Bishkek-registered cryptocurrency platform TengriCoin, as well as on Keremet Bank and Capital Bank. A total ban has also been placed on the supply of computer numerical control (CNC) metal-cutting machine tools and advanced communications equipment to the republic. Between 2024 and 2025, several commercial entities in Kyrgyzstan became subject to various restrictive measures imposed by the United States, the United Kingdom, the European Union, and Canada. These include Capital Bank of Central Asia, Tolubay Bank, Eurasian Savings Bank, the payment platform A7, and the cryptocurrency exchanges Grinex and Meer. The first sanctions against private companies in the republic were applied in June 2024.

body: Jogorku Kenesh Bishkek, Oct. 22, 2026 /Kabar/. On October 22, the Speaker of Jogorku Kenesh, Marlen Mamataliev met with Pierre-André Page, President of the National Council of the Federal Assembly of Switzerland. The parties discussed expanding political, economic, and cultural-humanitarian ties, as well as strengthening inter-parliamentary cooperation. Marlen Mamataliev noted that this visit by Pierre-André Page, his third to Kyrgyzstan is particularly significant. He spoke highly of the parade and concert performed in Bishkek by the "Landwehr" orchestra, which is led by Page. Highlighting the active development of bilateral relations, the speaker noted that a cooperation program between Kyrgyzstan and Switzerland for 2026–2029 has been adopted. Furthermore, Mamataliev expressed Kyrgyzstan’s interest in collaborating with Switzerland in sectors such as hydropower, healthcare, education, tourism, urban infrastructure, and finance, and he also touched upon ongoing joint investment projects. "We place special emphasis on creating a favorable environment for foreign investors; effective measures are being taken to liberalize the economy, improve investment legislation, and establish free economic zones. In this regard, we invite our Swiss partners to invest in major projects within the country," he said. Additionally, noting that 32 agreements have been signed between the two nations to date, Mamataliev emphasized the need to increase this number and to foster closer collaboration in specific priority areas. For his part, Pierre-André Page emphasized that Switzerland attaches great importance to its established cooperation with Kyrgyzstan. He provided a brief overview of the activities of his country’s legislative body. Furthermore, in discussing priority areas for expanding ties, Pierre-André Page highlighted the need for collaboration in the development of alternative energy sources and the prevention of emergency situations. He noted that in Switzerland, children are taught entrepreneurial skills starting from their school years, and he proposed an exchange of experience in this area. Swiss business representatives present at the meeting also shared their perspectives on cooperation in the realms of business and investment. Subsequently, Marlen Mamataliev briefed his counterpart on the work of the Jogorku Kenesh (Parliament of Kyrgyzstan) and demonstrated the digital capabilities available in the assembly hall. He also extended an invitation to Pierre-André Page to pay an official visit to Kyrgyzstan next year. Pierre-André Page spoke highly of the reforms being implemented by the Kyrgyz parliament in the areas of digitalization and electronic document management. The meeting was also attended by Jogorku Kenesh deputies Elvira Surabaldieva, Talaybek Masabirov, Gulya Kozhokulova, and Ismanali Zhoroev. Print

body: Kabar Agency Bishkek, Oct. 22, 2026. /Kabar/. The 6th “China – Central Asia” Think Tank Forum, themed “High-Quality Development and Joint Modernization,” is taking place in Bishkek. Nearly 100 representatives from China and Central Asian countries are gathered to discuss issues such as the development of regional cooperation, economic integration, digitalization, and the development of human capital. The forum was organized by the Institute of Strategic National Initiatives under the President and the Institute of Russian, Eastern European and Central Asian Studies of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences. Representatives from analytical and research centers in Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan are also participating in the event. The objective of the event is to strengthen sustainable cooperation among think tanks, facilitate the exchange of experience, and develop practical recommendations on pressing issues related to regional development. The forum’s agenda covers four key areas: high-quality development and joint modernization; sustainable regional integration and the circular economy; innovation and artificial intelligence; as well as human capital development and humanitarian cooperation. Participants will discuss the development of transport and logistics corridors, the expansion of industrial cooperation, the removal of trade barriers, the digitalization of public administration, the application of artificial intelligence, and collaboration in the fields of education and healthcare. The forum is being held as part of an ongoing expert dialogue between think tanks from China and Central Asia, which has been active since 2021. This format was included among the outcomes of the first summit between China and the Central Asian states in 2023. The forum is expected to result in the identification of promising areas for expert cooperation, the expansion of professional ties, and the preparation of recommendations aimed at further developing cooperation between China and the countries of Central Asia. body: Ministry of Emergency Situations Bishkek, Oct. 22, 2026 /Kabar/. On October 20, the Minister of Emergency Situations of Kyrgyzstan, Kanatbek Chynybaev participated in regional forum, meeting of the heads of emergency agencies from Central Asian countries held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. During the forum, participants discussed strengthening regional cooperation in the prevention and response to emergency situations, disaster risk reduction, the improvement of early warning systems, and joint responses to transboundary emergencies. In his remarks, Kanatbek Chynybaev emphasized the importance of the practical implementation of joint initiatives. He placed particular focus on the prevention of transboundary mudflows and floods, the development of monitoring and forecasting systems, and the strengthening of coordination among the emergency agencies of Central Asian countries. On the sidelines of the forum, the minister held a bilateral meeting with Sergey Makarov, head of the regional program "Climate Risk Management in Central Asia," implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ). The parties discussed the outcomes of ongoing cooperation and prospects for its further development, including the enhancement of early warning systems, the introduction of modern monitoring and forecasting technologies, and the strengthening of the technical and human resource capacity of Kyrgyzstan’s Ministry of Emergency Situations. Following the meeting, both sides reaffirmed their mutual interest in continuing their partnership and implementing joint projects aimed at reducing disaster risks and improving public safety. Print

body: Kabar Agency Bishkek, Oct. 22, 2026. /Kabar/. During a national meeting dedicated to discussing strategic objectives for the next five years, President Sadyr Zhaparov stated that tourism in the country must be transformed into a year-round industry. According to the head of state, achieving this requires ensuring high-quality service, modern infrastructure, and the safety of tourists. Currently, projects such as "Ala-Too Resort," "Chatkal Resort," and "Baitik Resort" are being implemented toward this goal. "Furthermore, hosting international events in Bishkek, Osh, and Manas cities, as well as along the shores of Issyk-Kul lake, contributes to the development of business tourism," the head of state said. The president encouraged aspiring entrepreneurs to develop small businesses in mountainous regions, emphasizing the importance of focusing on high-quality service, national cuisine, horseback riding, and the organization of mountain excursions. body: Сиёсат Ҳамсояҳои Путин. Зиндагӣ дар як маҳалла, аммо дар ду дунёи комилан дигар 2 соат пеш Ҳамсояҳои Путин. Акс аз 1-уми октябри 2026 Владимир Путин, раисҷумҳури Русия, дар соҳили кӯли Валдай дар паси девору чораҳои сахти амниятӣ зиндагӣ мекунад. Ҳамагӣ чанд километр дуртар ҳамсояҳои ӯ дар дунёи комилан дигаре ба сар мебаранд. Анна Шапкина мудири китобхона дар Рошчино аст. Шаҳраке, ки дар ибтидо барои истироҳати раҳбарони шӯравии собиқ сохта буданд ва ҳоло ба яке аз қароргоҳҳои расмии Владимир Путин табдил ёфтааст. Шапкина мегӯяд, "атрофи кӯлро маҳкам карда, дар ҳама ҷо панҷара ва дурбинҳои назоратӣ гузоштаанд. Аз мо тақрибан якуним-ду километр фосила дорад. Президент гуё дар паҳлӯи ман аст, вале мо дар ду ҷаҳони комилан аз ҳам ҷудо зиндагӣ мекунем." ИНЧУНИН, БИХОНЕД: "Дар хона ҳастанд ва зери ҳимояти ФСO." Таҳқиқот дар бораи писарони Путину Кабаева Сокинони маҳаллӣ мегӯянд, ҷойҳое, ки як замон барои шинову қаиқронӣ ва сайругашт истифода мешуданд, ҳоло дастнорас шудаанд. "Мо дигар наметавонем барои шино кардан ба он тарафи кӯл равем. Дар он ҷо посбонҳо ҳастанд. Дарҳол шуморо меронанд ва сарзаниш ҳам мекунанд," – гуфт омӯзгор Даря Дмитриева. Таҳқиқоти Маркази "Досйе" нишон додааст, ки чӣ гуна маҷмааи президентиро дар Валдай ба як истеҳкоми қавӣ табдил додаанд. Иля Рождественский, рӯзноманигори Маркази "Досйе", мегӯяд, "аз нигоҳи ҳуқуқӣ, ин заминҳо ба номи ниҳодҳои вобаста аз Хадамоти федеролии муҳофизат (ФСО) ва ширкатҳои марбут ба Юрий Ковалчук сабтином шудаанд." Юрий Ковалчук яке аз ҳампаймонҳои Владимир Путин ба шумор меравад. Бар асоси таҳқиқоти Маркази "Досйе", Путин аз варзишгари собиқи олимпӣ Алина Кабаева, ки шарики зиндагии эҳтимолии ӯ гуфта мешавад, ду писар дорад. Кремл ҳеч гоҳ ин гузоришҳоро ба таври ошкор тасдиқ накардааст. Дар таҳқиқот гуфта мешавад, писарони Путин дар қароргоҳи Валдай асосан дар инзиво, дар иҳотаи кормандону посбонҳо зиндагӣ мекунанд. "Дар он ҷо майдони ҳоккей ҳаст, ки Владимир Путин ҳамроҳи писаронаш дар муқобили посбонҳои Хадамоти федеролии муҳофизат (ФСО) бозӣ мекунад," – гуфт Иля Рождественский. Инро ҳам бинед: Аз "Кохи Миллат" то "Оғузхон". Коху қароргоҳҳои азими раҳбарони худкома Рӯзноманигорони таҳқиқотгар мегӯянд, бинокорӣ дар қароргоҳ дар 15 соли гузашта авҷ гирифтааст. Ин ҳамон даврае буд, ки ба қавли Иля Рождественский, "Владимир Путин фаҳмид, дигар аслан ҷое барои шарм кардан надорад." Дар паси панҷараҳо, дар шаҳраки наздики Валдай, тафовути бузурге намудор аст. Сохтмонҳои нав симои баъзе аз маҳаллаҳои шаҳракро дигаргун кардаанд. Анна Шапкина мегӯяд, "он ҷое, ки имрӯз қароргоҳи Путин ҳаст, пештар ҷангали коҷ ва соҳили як кӯли зебое буд. Аввал як гӯшаашро девор кашиданд, сипас гӯшаи дигарашро. Ҳоло навбат ба ин ҷо ҳам расид. Баъзе аз сокинон мегӯянд, атрофи моро ҳам панҷарапеч хоҳанд кард. Дигарон мегӯянд, моро тамоман аз инҷо мекӯчонанд." Ҷанги васеъмиқёси Русия ба зидди Украина, ки аз соли 2022 идома дорад, низомҳои дифои ҳавоӣ ва чораҳои зидди дронҳоро низ ба инҷо кашондааст. Даря, омӯзгори маҳаллӣ, ба яке аз падофанди ҳавоии "Пантсир" ишора кард, ки дар наздикии қароргоҳи Путин дар Валдай ҷойгир аст. Ӯ гуфт: "Агар чарх мезанад, пас, дар болои сари мо ягон хатаре нест. Аммо агар бозистад, маънои онро дорад, ки чизе дар болои сари мо парвоз дорад. Бори аввал, ҳангоме ки онро фаъол карданд, тирезаҳои хона ба ларза даромаданд." Бино ба таҳқиқоти Радиои Озодӣ, то моҳи апрел дар атрофи қароргоҳи Путин дар Валдай ба камияш 27 нуқтаи дифои ҳавоӣ муайян шудааст. ИНЧУНИН, БИХОНЕД: Путин дар куҷост? Кремл чӣ гуна ҷойи воқеии ӯро пинҳон медорад? Ҷанги Русия дар Украина ба сокинони деҳаҳои атроф низ таъсири худро гузоштааст. Аз тақрибан 1000 ҳамдеҳаи Даря Дмитриева наздик ба 50 кас ба хати пеши ҷанг фиристода шуда, аз он ҷо фақат панҷ нафар ва он ҳам маҷруҳ баргаштанд. “Солҳои зиёд бо як гурӯҳи ҷустуҷӯӣ кор мекунам. Мо ҳанӯз пайкари сарбозонеро, ки дар Ҷанги Дуюми Ҷаҳонӣ кушта шудаанд, пайдо мекунем. Акнун оё маҷбур мешавем, ки 10 ё 15 соли дигар ба Украина рафта, боз ҷасад ҷустуҷӯ кунем? Аз худ мепурсем, ки чаро?” – суол гузошт Даря Дмитриева. Гузориши видеоиро ба зудӣ дар ҳамин ҷо мегузорем, бозгашт ба саҳифаро фаромӯш накунед Ҳамсояҳои Путин. body: Озодии як шаҳрванди Амрико аз зиндони Русия Пайвандҳои дастрасӣ Ҷаҳиш ба мояи аслӣ Ҷаҳиш ба феҳристи аслӣ Ҷаҳиш ба ҷустор Баъдӣ Пӯшонед Пешӣ Баъдӣ Тасвир саҳнаҳое дорад, ки шояд барои дигарон нофорам бошанд. Пардабардорӣ Пайванд нусхабардорӣ шуд ТАРҲҲО Русский Пайгирӣ кунед Ҳамаи сомонаҳои RFE/RL Ҷустуҷӯ РУС TV TV Ҷустуҷӯ Пешӣ Баъдӣ Хабари нав Дар чанд ҷумла Октябр 21, 2026 Озодии як шаҳрванди Амрико аз зиндони Русия Стивен Ҳаббард. Акс аз бойгонӣ Стивен Ҳаббарди 74-сола аз аёлати Мичигани Амрико рӯзи 21-уми октябр аз зиндоне дар Русия озод шудааст. Додгоҳи шаҳри Маскав ӯро соли 2024 ба зархаридӣ ба фоидаи Украина гунаҳкор дониста, шаш солу даҳ моҳ аз озодӣ маҳрум намуд, аммо хонаводааш бепоя донистанд. Владимир Путин, раисҷумҳури Русия, рӯзи чоршанбе дар музокирот бо Стив Виткофф, намояндаи вижаи президенти Амрико Доналд Трамп озодии Ҳаббардро эълом кард. Дертар Трамп низ озодии Ҳаббардро тасдиқ кард ва гуфт, ӯ ба зудӣ ба аъзои хонаводааш мепайвандад. “Ба ватан хуш омадӣ, Стивен. Бисёр хушҳолам, ки ту боз бо мо ҳастӣ,” – навишт раисҷумҳури Амрико дар шабакаи “Truth Social”. Оҷонси давлатии “Интерфакс”-и Русия навишт, Путин дар мулоқот бо Виткофф аз ӯ хостааст, натиҷаҳои музокироти Норвегияро дар мавриди поён додан ба ҷанги Маскав дар Украина ошкор кунад. Виткофф як рӯз пеш бо Владимир Зеленский, раисҷумҳури Украина, дар Осло, пойтахти Норвегия гуфтугӯ дошт. Зеленский рӯзи чоршанбе дар як изҳорот гуфт, Киев омода аст, даргириро бо Русия дар дарозои хати ҳозираи ҷабҳа боздорад ва музокироти дипломатиро барои поён додан ба даргириҳо оғоз кунад. Ӯ дар айни замон вогузории минтақаи Донбассро ба Русия рад кард. Изҳороти камсобиқаи Саидмукаррам Абдулқодирзода рӯзи 20-уми октябр ҳангоми мулоқот бо сарбозони як маркази Нерӯҳои марзбонии Тоҷикистон дар Душанбе садо додааст. Муфтӣ гуфтааст, “на ин ки озор бидиҳед, баръакс, дасти ҳамдигар бигиред.” Шӯрои уламои Маркази исломӣ бо нашри навор гуфт, Абдулқодирзода ба сарбозон тавсия додааст, ки “интизом, эҳтироми якдигар, сабру таҳаммул ва ахлоқи ҳамидаро” риоя кунанд. Ҳарчанд дар навор ошкоро вожаҳое ба мисли меҳтарсолорӣ ё “дедовшина” ва хушунат дар артиш баён нашудааст, ба назар мерасад, ҳадафи насиҳатҳои муфтии Тоҷикистон ҳамин мушкил аст. ИНЧУНИН, БИХОНЕД: Чаро баъзе аз ҷавонон аз хидмат дар артиши Тоҷикистон "мегурезанд"? Шикоят аз бадрафторӣ дар миёни низомиён дар артиши Тоҷикистон, ки гоҳе бо марги сарбозон меанҷомад, як масъалаи ҷиддии артиш дониста мешавад. Бино ба гузориши созмони иҷтимоии "Дафтари озодиҳои шаҳрвандӣ" ва Эътилофи созмонҳои зидди шиканҷа дар Тоҷикистон, агар дар солҳои 2014-2016 дар умум 59 мавриди шиканҷаи сарбозон сабт шуда, 11 нафар ҷон бохтаанд, соли 2025 аз тақрибан ҳафтод мавриди шикоят аз меҳтарсолорӣ хабар дода шудааст. Ҳукумати Тоҷикистон дар гузориши худ ба Созмони Милали Муттаҳид аз зиёда сад мавриди марги низомиён дар солҳои 2019-2021 хабар дода буд. Акс аз бойгонӣ Донишгоҳи омӯзгории Тоҷикистон хабари Радиои Озоди ро дар бораи ихроҷи панҷ донишҷӯяш барои сарпечӣ аз ширкат дар раҳпаймоҳои ҷашнӣ тасдиқ кард, аммо гуфт, ба се рондашуда баъди эътирофи камбудӣ иҷоза додааст, ба таҳсил баргарданд. Дар баёнияи донишгоҳ, ки 20-уми октябр дар Фейсбук нашр шуд, омадааст, “дар ҳақиқат, панҷ донишҷӯ бо сабаби риоя накардани қоидаҳои тартиботи дохилидонишгоҳӣ, аз ҷумла иштирок накардан дар корҳои ҷамъиятии донишгоҳ, аз сафи донишҷӯён хориҷ гардида буданд.” Баъди ин, ба гуфтаи раҳбарияти донишгоҳ, “бо мақсади ҳифзи ҳуқуқи донишҷӯён ва фароҳам овардани шароити мусоид барои идомаи таҳсили онҳо”, се нафар ба сафи донишҷӯён барқарор карда шуданд. Рӯзе пештар аз ин баёния, Радиои Озодӣ бо такя ба фармони раҳбарияти донишгоҳ гузориш дод, ки панҷ донишҷӯро барои иштирок накардан дар роҳпаймоӣ ё маршировка и бахшида ба ҷашни 35-солагии истиқлоли Тоҷикистон дар тобистону тирамоҳи имсол аз донишгоҳ хориҷ кардаанд . ИНЧУНИН, БИХОНЕД: "Ба маршировка наомад." Ихроҷи 5 донишҷӯ аз як донишгоҳи Тоҷикистон Ҷашни мазкур рӯзи 9-уми сентябр сурат гирифт. Вазорати маориф гуфта буд, ки ширкат дар чунин маросим маҷбурӣ нест. Хуршед Мавлонов, сухангӯи вазорат, рӯзи 20-уми октябр бори дигар тасдиқ кард, ки ширкати донишҷӯён дар раҳпаймоӣ ихтиёрист. Дигар чизҳо, ба мисли иштирок накардан дар корҳои ҷамъиятӣ ё маршировка, асос барои аз донишгоҳ хориҷ кардан намешавад." body: Муфтии Тоҷикистон аз сарбозон хостааст, ҳамдигарро озор надиҳанд Пайвандҳои дастрасӣ Ҷаҳиш ба мояи аслӣ Ҷаҳиш ба феҳристи аслӣ Ҷаҳиш ба ҷустор Баъдӣ Пӯшонед Пешӣ Баъдӣ Тасвир саҳнаҳое дорад, ки шояд барои дигарон нофорам бошанд. Пардабардорӣ Пайванд нусхабардорӣ шуд ТАРҲҲО Русский Пайгирӣ кунед Ҳамаи сомонаҳои RFE/RL Ҷустуҷӯ РУС TV TV Ҷустуҷӯ Пешӣ Баъдӣ Хабари нав Дар чанд ҷумла Октябр 21, 2026 Муфтии Тоҷикистон аз сарбозон хостааст, ҳамдигарро озор надиҳанд Саидмукаррам Абдуқлқодирзода Дар ҳоле ки даъвати ҷавонон ба артиши Тоҷикистон идома дорад ва як сабаби худдории онҳо аз хидмат латукӯбу шиканҷа дар баъзе аз қисмҳои ҳарбӣ гуфта мешавад, раиси Шӯрои уламо сарбозонро ба ҳимоят аз якдигар даъват кардааст. Изҳороти камсобиқаи Саидмукаррам Абдулқодирзода рӯзи 20-уми октябр ҳангоми мулоқот бо сарбозони як маркази Нерӯҳои марзбонии Тоҷикистон дар Душанбе садо додааст. Муфтӣ гуфтааст, “на ин ки озор бидиҳед, баръакс, дасти ҳамдигар бигиред.” Шӯрои уламои Маркази исломӣ бо нашри навор гуфт, Абдулқодирзода ба сарбозон тавсия додааст, ки “интизом, эҳтироми якдигар, сабру таҳаммул ва ахлоқи ҳамидаро” риоя кунанд. Ҳарчанд дар навор ошкоро вожаҳое ба мисли меҳтарсолорӣ ё “дедовшина” ва хушунат дар артиш баён нашудааст, ба назар мерасад, ҳадафи насиҳатҳои муфтии Тоҷикистон ҳамин мушкил аст. ИНЧУНИН, БИХОНЕД: Чаро баъзе аз ҷавонон аз хидмат дар артиши Тоҷикистон "мегурезанд"? Шикоят аз бадрафторӣ дар миёни низомиён дар артиши Тоҷикистон, ки гоҳе бо марги сарбозон меанҷомад, як масъалаи ҷиддии артиш дониста мешавад. Бино ба гузориши созмони иҷтимоии "Дафтари озодиҳои шаҳрвандӣ" ва Эътилофи созмонҳои зидди шиканҷа дар Тоҷикистон, агар дар солҳои 2014-2016 дар умум 59 мавриди шиканҷаи сарбозон сабт шуда, 11 нафар ҷон бохтаанд, соли 2025 аз тақрибан ҳафтод мавриди шикоят аз меҳтарсолорӣ хабар дода шудааст. Ҳукумати Тоҷикистон дар гузориши худ ба Созмони Милали Муттаҳид аз зиёда сад мавриди марги низомиён дар солҳои 2019-2021 хабар дода буд. Идома Ба дигарон фиристед Линкро нусхабардорӣ кунед Facebook X (Twitter) Email Ба дигарон фиристед Бидуни филтршикан Ин пайванд (линк) дар минтақаҳое, ки вебсайти мо бастааст, кор мекунад Ҳамаи хабарҳои имрӯзро дар инҷо бихонед Октябр 21, 2026 Озодии як шаҳрванди Амрико аз зиндони Русия Стивен Ҳаббард. Акс аз бойгонӣ Стивен Ҳаббарди 74-сола аз аёлати Мичигани Амрико рӯзи 21-уми октябр аз зиндоне дар Русия озод шудааст. Додгоҳи шаҳри Маскав ӯро соли 2024 ба зархаридӣ ба фоидаи Украина гунаҳкор дониста, шаш солу даҳ моҳ аз озодӣ маҳрум намуд, аммо хонаводааш бепоя донистанд. Владимир Путин, раисҷумҳури Русия, рӯзи чоршанбе дар музокирот бо Стив Виткофф, намояндаи вижаи президенти Амрико Доналд Трамп озодии Ҳаббардро эълом кард. Дертар Трамп низ озодии Ҳаббардро тасдиқ кард ва гуфт, ӯ ба зудӣ ба аъзои хонаводааш мепайвандад. “Ба ватан хуш омадӣ, Стивен. Бисёр хушҳолам, ки ту боз бо мо ҳастӣ,” – навишт раисҷумҳури Амрико дар шабакаи “Truth Social”. Оҷонси давлатии “Интерфакс”-и Русия навишт, Путин дар мулоқот бо Виткофф аз ӯ хостааст, натиҷаҳои музокироти Норвегияро дар мавриди поён додан ба ҷанги Маскав дар Украина ошкор кунад. Виткофф як рӯз пеш бо Владимир Зеленский, раисҷумҳури Украина, дар Осло, пойтахти Норвегия гуфтугӯ дошт. Зеленский рӯзи чоршанбе дар як изҳорот гуфт, Киев омода аст, даргириро бо Русия дар дарозои хати ҳозираи ҷабҳа боздорад ва музокироти дипломатиро барои поён додан ба даргириҳо оғоз кунад. Ӯ дар айни замон вогузории минтақаи Донбассро ба Русия рад кард. Of these, 40% are citizens of Uzbekistan, who are also among the largest groups of foreign nationals captured by Ukrainian forces. Ўзбек тилида O‘zbek tilida На русском языке Yesterday, 22:44 Society The Ukrainian project “I Want to Live” has identified over 20,400 citizens of Central Asian countries who signed contracts with the Russian Armed Forces to participate in the war against Ukraine as of 1 October 2026 . The figures were presented at a briefing attended by regional media on 20 October. Gazeta presents the key figures from the presentation and comments from a project representative. Of the total number, 8,207, or 40%, were citizens of Uzbekistan. The next largest groups were citizens of Tajikistan (5,308 persons, 26%), Kazakhstan (3,819, 19%), Kyrgyzstan (2,219, 11%) and Turkmenistan (884, 4%). Citizens of Central Asian countries account for 44% of all foreign nationals identified by the project as serving in the Russian army under contract. A project representative noted at the briefing that the statistics do not include ethnic Central Asians who hold Russian citizenship. According to the representative, including them would bring the total even higher. Advertising on Gazeta The number of citizens of Central Asian countries who signed contracts with the Russian Armed Forces increased 2.1-fold in 2025, from 4,119 people (including 1,446 from Uzbekistan) in 2024 to 8,497 (including 3,487 from Uzbekistan) in 2025. A further 6,043 people (including 2,602 from Uzbekistan) signed contracts in the first nine months of 2026, equivalent to 71% of the 2025 figure. “Recruiting residents of neighbouring countries is particularly convenient due to linguistic, cultural and migration ties,” the project said . Foreign prisoners of war According to “I Want to Live”, as of 12 October 2026, hundreds of foreign nationals who fought in the Russian Armed Forces were being held in Ukrainian captivity. They are citizens of 59 countries. According to the project representative, their number is increasing every year. According to the project’s presentation, the seven most represented nationalities among foreign prisoners of war were citizens of Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Belarus, Colombia, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan and Kyrgyzstan, in the order in which the countries appear in the presentation. The project did not specify the number of prisoners from each country. Recruitment methods The “I Want to Live” project identifies three main methods of recruiting foreign nationals into the Russian Armed Forces: financial inducements, deception and coercion. According to the presentation, recruiters promise relatively high salaries of $2,000−3,000 per month, Russian citizenship and benefits in exchange for participating in combat operations. The project notes that many foreign nationals knowingly agree to join the Russian Armed Forces in the hope of earning money. Deception involves offering “high-paying jobs” in construction, security, warehouses or driving. Advertisements may state that the work is “in the interests of the Ministry of Defense” without mentioning participation in combat operations. After signing a contract, recruits are sent for a short training course at a military training facility and then deployed to the front. According to the project, this method is most commonly used to recruit citizens of Sri Lanka, Cuba, Nepal and African countries. Coercion involves raids during which police detain undocumented migrants and people whose documents have expired. They are threatened with imprisonment or deportation and offered an “alternative”: signing a contract with the Russian Defense Ministry in exchange for money and citizenship. The project notes that this is a common scenario for people from Central Asia. Reasons for signing contracts with the Russian Armed Forces According to a representative of “I Want to Live”, more than 90% of foreign prisoners of war completed a survey that included questions about their reasons for signing contracts with the Russian Armed Forces and their hopes for the future. The survey results were grouped by region: Central Asia, the Eastern Partnership countries (Armenia, Belarus, Moldova and Georgia), Latin America, Africa, the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) and Asia. The presentation and briefing did not specify the number of respondents. Respondents could select multiple answers, and the percentages are calculated as a share of all responses in each group. According to the results, the main motivation among prisoners of war from Central Asia was the desire to obtain Russian citizenship, accounting for 32% of responses. Another 20% cited a desire to get out of prison or avoid criminal prosecution, the highest proportion among all the regional groups. The desire to earn money accounted for 10% of responses, while 6% cited a desire to avoid deportation from Russia. In 12% of responses, respondents said they had signed contracts voluntarily in support of Russia’s actions. According to a representative of “I Want to Live”, ethnic Russians who had lived in Central Asian countries before the war also cited this reason in personal interviews. The overwhelming majority of responses from prisoners of war from Central Asia regarding their future plans indicated “Return to Russia”, accounting for 82% of answers. Returning to their home country was mentioned in 11% of responses. The project representative said that, in conversations with “I Want to Live”, prisoners from Central Asia stated that they considered themselves Russian citizens, even if they had obtained their passports only after signing contracts. They also feared returning home, saying that mercenary activity is a criminal offense in countries across the region. The prisoners also said they wanted to receive financial compensation for participating in combat operations. Subscribe to our Telegram channel Gazeta 820 # i want to live # war in ukraine

body: Mirziyoyev said government agencies should set an example in their use of the state language, stressing that official documents and responses to public inquiries must be clear, precise and easy to understand. “Laws, decisions, instructions and responses to inquiries must be written in fluent, precise and understandable language. Citizens should not face unnecessary difficulties in understanding their rights and obligations,” the president said in his message. He added that respect for the state language should also be reflected in the quality of public services. On education, Mirziyoyev stressed the need to strengthen students’ reading comprehension, speaking and writing skills. He said teaching methods and textbooks should account for the different needs of children learning Uzbek as their mother tongue and those studying it as the state language. The president also called for wider access to scientific literature in Uzbek and more opportunities to present research findings in the language. Reliable reference materials, high-quality translations and digital resources are particularly needed in medicine, engineering, economics and other fields, he said. Mirziyoyev highlighted the need to expand the use of Uzbek in the digital environment, including through the development of electronic dictionaries, translation and editing tools, and collections of high-quality written and spoken language. He also called for further development of speech-to-text and text-to-speech technologies, stressing that the creation of digital language resources must respect copyright and protect personal data. “The quality of artificial intelligence tools in the state language should be assessed by how accurately and usefully they assist people,” Mirziyoyev said. The president also addressed spelling and writing standards, saying that convenience for users should be the main consideration. Any solutions, he said, should be grounded in scientific research, public consultation and practical preparation. He stressed the importance of ensuring consistency across education, publishing and digital systems while taking into account the needs of different generations. Mirziyoyev also called for greater interest in learning and researching Uzbek abroad. He pointed to cooperation initiatives such as the Uzbek Studies Programme at the University of Oxford as potential platforms for international exchange in language studies and translation.

body: Uzbekistan Uzbekistan and Russia discuss joint ventures for nuclear power plant project Uzbekistan and Russia discussed establishing joint ventures, transferring technology and expanding local production for Uzbekistan's integrated nuclear power plant project during a conference in Tashkent, as the country aims to increase the share of domestically produced goods and services to at least 30% and develop a special industrial zone in the Farish district. Yesterday, 16:01 3 min read 163 views 0 comments 0 Source: Uzatom A conference on establishing joint ventures with Uzbek companies for the implementation of Uzbekistan's integrated nuclear power plant project was held in Tashkent. The event brought together representatives of the Uzatom Agency, relevant government bodies and Uzbek companies, alongside specialists from Rosatom's Engineering Division, the Association of Organizations of the Nuclear Industry Construction Complex and executives from Russian enterprises involved in nuclear power plant construction. The conference focused on technological cooperation, localization and the participation of Uzbek companies in the nuclear power plant project. The opening session addressed the joint implementation of Uzbekistan's nuclear project, technological cooperation, localization and the development of national human resources. Shahzod Alirizaev, Deputy Director of the Uzatom Agency, emphasized the importance of cooperation between the parties in implementing the integrated nuclear power plant project. The project combines high-capacity power units based on VVER-1000 reactors with small-capacity units using RITM-200N reactors. According to Alirizaev, this configuration provides opportunities for exchanging expertise and developing Uzbekistan's domestic industrial base. During the first session, Russian experts and Uzbek representatives discussed approaches to nuclear power plant construction. The discussions covered updated construction methodologies, including a system-based approach and modular installation. Participants also examined the capabilities of specialized materials science organizations and equipment manufacturers to provide technological solutions for nuclear power plant construction. Particular attention was given to backup power supply systems, auxiliary thermal energy infrastructure and other components related to operational efficiency and safety, as well as opportunities for involving local enterprises. Representatives of Russian companies and their Uzbek partners discussed localization, technology transfer and the establishment of joint ventures. The areas considered included automated control and radiation monitoring systems, specialized ventilation and gas purification, polymer piping production, energy-efficient insulation materials, specialized chemical additives for concrete and prefabricated structures for construction and assembly facilities. Participants also discussed establishing production facilities directly in Uzbekistan through joint ventures to meet localization targets and develop domestic industrial and human-resource capacity for the nuclear energy sector. The conference concluded with a business-to-business (B2B) cooperation session involving representatives of Uzbek and Russian companies. During the session, participants exchanged proposals and expressed their commitment to further cooperation in joint production, professional training and the development of related industrial sectors. "The implementation of an integrated nuclear power plant project is more than just the construction of an energy facility; it represents a strategic opportunity for Uzbekistan to develop its own high-tech base, adopt global best practices, and cultivate a new generation of specialists. Joint ventures with Russian partners will serve as a key instrument for achieving these goals and strengthening bilateral cooperation," Alirizaev stated. President Shavkat Mirziyoyev has previously emphasized the importance of the peaceful use of nuclear energy for Uzbekistan's development. During the launch of construction of the first power unit, the president stated that the project marked the beginning of a new phase in the country's technological, industrial and scientific development. Directives have been issued to increase the share of domestically produced goods and services in the nuclear power plant project to at least 30%. A special industrial zone is also being established in the Farish district to supply the plant with locally produced materials and equipment. body: Директор школы No55 Ашхабада получила строгий выговор и находится на испытательном сроке | Turkmen.News Директор школы No55 Ашхабада получила строгий выговор и находится на испытательном сроке 22.10.2026 | Важное | Большая комиссия из сотрудников прокуратуры и Министерства образования Туркменистана добралась до 55-й школы столицы после череды публикаций turkmen.news о тамошних нарушениях. По сообщениям источников, директор школы Джахан Чолиева получила список замечаний по поводу работы школы примерно из десятка пунктов, которые ей надлежит исправить. Самой ей сделали строгий выговор и перевели в статус временно исполняющей обязанности. Накануне осенних каникул, во вторник 20 октября, школу No55 Ашхабада посетила межведомственная комиссия. Как сообщил источник turkmen.news, комиссию возглавил сам министр образования страны Джумамырат Гурбангельдыев , с которым были и другие представители его ведомства, а также органов прокуратуры — всего больше десяти человек. «Проверка длилась 5-6 часов. На этот раз она была очень тщательной, проверили всё от фундамента до крыши», — говорит источник. Инспекцию спровоцировали сообщения о множестве различных нарушений в этой школе под руководством Джахан Чолиевой. Как писал turkmen.news, школа переполнена , и при этом в ней не хватает парт, стульев, кондиционеров. Сама директор берёт взятки за зачисление учеников, подделку их текущих и даже экзаменационных оценок и другие услуги. На подчинённых Чолиевой также поступали жалобы, в том числе на их грубость в отношении учащихся и их физическое наказание. Один из таковых — новый завуч по воспитательной работе Сердар Довлетович (фамилия не установлена). Он смущает своим неадекватным вниманием младших учениц , что не может не тревожить родителей школьниц и других педагогов. Судя по всему, как минимум часть этих сообщений ответственные чиновники проверили всерьёз. Они проинспектировали материальное оснащение классов, а также знания школьников, особенно выпускников, и документацию. По результатам проверки был составлен целый перечень замечаний: 1. В школе, рассчитанной на 2200 учеников, числится более 4500 человек. Первые классы, в которых количество детей превышает максимально установленную законом норму в 35 человек, должны быть расформированы. Тем не менее переполненные классы других параллелей трогать не будут. 2. Срок годности огнетушителей истёк ещё в 2022 году, после чего на них просто переклеивали ярлыки с датами. Огнетушители заменят. 3. Во многих кабинетах не хватает парт и стульев. Докупать новую мебель не будут — её перераспределят, изъяв из других кабинетов. Не возникнет ли после этого нехватка там — непонятно. 4. Санитарно-гигиенические нормы грубо нарушаются. 5. В кабинетах не хватает кондиционеров. Их будут устанавливать, а местами обновлять во время осенних каникул. 6. Многие учителя с опозданием заполняют электронный журнал eMekdep . Педагоги получат за это выговоры. Напомним, что задержки внесения записей в школьные журналы либо, наоборот, заполнение их наперёд, помогают недобросовестным учителям подделывать оценки . В то же время источники turkmen.news среди педагогов обращали внимание на параллельное ведение электронных и бумажных журналов; последние тоже иногда раздваиваются на реальный и официальный. Объём бюрократии приводит к задержкам и ошибкам. 7. Известны факты завышения и занижения оценок. 8. Темы уроков в 11-12-х классах не соответствуют календарному плану. 9. Не все ученики соблюдают требования к школьной форме. Однако ключевое замечание, за которое Джахан Чолиевой сделали строгий выговор, касалось неофициальных финансовых сборов, а по сути — тех поборов, примеры которых приводились выше. Несмотря на такой внушительный объём проблем в школе под её руководством, причём выявленных всего лишь за один день проверки, женщина работу не потеряла. Вдобавок к выговору её перевели на испытательный срок: сейчас она не директор, а временно исполняющая его обязанности. По мнению источника, Чолиеву в очередной раз спасли её связи, в том числе среди высшего руководства Министерства национальной безопасности. Завуч Сердар Довлетович никаких взысканий вообще не получил. Наоборот, его похвалили за укрепление школьной дисциплины. Ранее об этом сотруднике сообщалось, что он с особым рвением добивался дисциплины среди девочек младших классов, вызывая их по одной к себе в кабинет, а у одной даже пытался узнать её телефон и домашний адрес. Кроме того, школьников и коллег завуча смущало, что он регулярно приходил в спортивный зал на занятия младших и средних классов. После каникул, то есть 29-30 октября, проверяющие повторно посетят школу No55. По всей видимости, они будут выяснять, исправлены ли их замечания. Turkmen.news также продолжит следить за ситуацией в этом учреждении и за жалобами на уже скомпрометированных лиц. В руководстве школы No55 Ашхабада могут работать не только взяточники, но и педофилы В классах школы No55 Ашхабада будет учиться до 55 учеников из-за алчности директора Коррумпированная директор ашхабадской школы после проверки сохранила место Директор ашхабадской школы берёт взятки. Они вылавливают и убивают бродячих животных – собак и кошек. Утром 21 октября жители второго микрорайона города вызвали полицию, так как убийства животных осуществлялись на глазах детей. Прибывшие полицейские разъяснили жителям, что мероприятие по очистке города от бездомных собак проводится по решению хякимлика. Варварское уничтожение бесхозных животных осуществляется в городах Туркменистана регулярно. Иногда домоуправления выплачивают вознаграждения работникам в зависимости от количества убитых собак и кошек. body: ХТ Фарид Тухбатуллин: «Звёзды покидают свои гнёзда» Редакция 21 октября 2026 1021 На международной книжной ярмарке «Пражская книжная башня». Прага, 11 сентября 2026 г. (© forall.swiss) Важное Лента Редакция - 22 октября 2026 Состоялась презентация книги Президента Туркменистана на азербайджанском языке ХТ Редакция - 22 октября 2026 В Туркменабаде уничтожают бездомных собак Лента Редакция - 20 октября 2026 Лейла Алиева прилетела с визитом в Туркменистан, ее встречала Огулджахан Атабаева ХТ Редакция - 19 октября 2026 Студенты и их родители опасаются повышения платы за обучение Интервью журналу «Швейцария для всех» В декабре 2002 года его арестовали в связи с так называемым «покушением на Ниязова». Через три месяца приговорили к трём годам лишения свободы, вскоре помиловали. С 2003 года Фарид Тухбатуллин живет в Австрии. Он является соучредителем «Туркменской инициативы по правам человека». Недавно швейцарское издательство Sandermoen Publishing выпустило его книгу «Российская колония: туркменские саги». Ранее Фарид Тухбатуллин печатался в британском журнале Index on Censorship. Он также был среди инициаторов и авторов сборника современных туркменских литераторов « У оврага... за последними домами » (2015). Как память и литература влияют на судьбу? Чем сегодня живет Туркменистан и политические беженцы из этой страны? Этот опыт важен для противников любой диктатуры, в том числе для российской политической эмиграции. Туркменский правозащитник ответил на вопросы редакции «Швейцария для всех». От эколога до писателя — Как эколог стал правозащитником, правозащитник — политзаключённым, а политзаключённый — писателем? После окончания сельскохозяйственного института в Ашхабаде я в 1980-х работал в системе Министерства водного хозяйства Туркменистана. При Горбачеве стали открыто говорить об усыхании Аральского моря и сопутствующих экологических проблемах. Северную часть Туркменистана, где я родился и жил, включили в кризисную зону. По статистике, у нас была самая высокая в СССР детская и материнская смертность. Тогда с единомышленниками мы и стали заниматься общественной деятельностью в защиту экологии. Параллельно в стране устанавливалась диктатура. И я нелегально занялся сбором фактов о нарушениях прав человека, передавал эти сведения в Московское отделение «Мемориала». Участвовал за рубежом в правозащитных конференциях, семинарах, тренингах. Затем были арест, осуждение, помилование и эмиграция. Этот опыт частично вошел в мою книгу. — В книге « Российская колония: туркменские саги » переплетены легенды, мифы, мистика и документальная проза. У звёзд есть гнёзда. Где для вас проходит граница между реальностью и вымыслом? — Я хотел рассказать о реальных событиях и туркменской культуре, дорогой мне и малоизвестной миру, ведь настоящее и прошлое неразделимы. В основе традиционной туркменской мифологии — древний тюркский эпический мир, соединившийся с доисламскими верованиями и исламской традицией. Один из центральных пластов — предания об Огуз-хане, легендарном прародителе огузских племён. Другой важнейший памятник — «Книга моего деда Коркута» («Китаби Деде Коркут»), цикл сказаний о героях, роде, верности, войне, смерти и судьбе. В древнем мифологическом слое важны волк, конь, птицы, дерево, вода, пустыня и гора. Волк может быть проводником и прародителем, конь — спутником и почти продолжением героя. Мир духов, пери и дивов соседствует с исламскими представлениями о джиннах, святых и чудесах. Древние сакральные места после исламизации могли почитаться уже как связанные с новыми святыми. Важнейшая часть традиции — героический эпос «Гёроглы» («Кёроглы»), в котором герой становится воплощением сопротивления, справедливости и свободы. Поэтому на страницах моей книги и живут волки, вороны, Бездна, Бог, предания и голоса умерших. За ними стоит культура, веками сохранявшая историческую память через эпос, родовые предания и устный рассказ. — Насколько отличаются устная память и официальная история Туркменистана? Кто решает, что людям помнить, что забыть? Советская пропаганда семьдесят лет извращала туркменскую историю. Исторические личности, защищавшие свою землю, традиции, веру, стали отрицательными персонажами. А люди, которые переметнулись к большевикам, то есть фактически стали предателями своей культуры и народа, почитались советской властью как герои. Эта подмена жива в памяти многих туркмен и в наше время. После обретения независимости власти поначалу пытались исправить официальную политику памяти. Но быстро поняли, что на фоне реальных героев, сражавшихся против Российской империи, а затем и с большевиками, героическая биография Туркменбаши соткана слишком грубо — подмена видна в самом узоре. Туркменистан обрел независимость в результате распада СССР, заслуги Ниязова тут нет. А он при жизни ставил памятники себе и своим родным. Пришедшие ему на смену поступают так же. — В названии «Российская колония» читается и колония империи, и место заключения. Чувствуете ли вы связь с традицией лагерной литературы, например, с прозой Шаламова? — Название книги я выбрал осознанно. Что касается прозы Шаламова, возможно, в главе «Сто и одна ночь при свете лампочки» есть такая связь. Как и он, я старался тоже не указывать, кто хороший, а кто плохой. Просто описывал ситуацию и реакцию тех или иных персонажей. — Обвинения в покушении на Ниязова, тюрьма... О чём труднее говорить — о насилии столетней давности или о пережитом лично? — О пережитом лично. Наверное, поэтому книге, чтобы появиться, потребовалось почти двадцать лет. Туркменская правозащита — Что можно рассказать о работе туркменских правозащитников, которые наблюдают за нарушением прав и свобод человека в Туркменистане? Как это начиналось? — После провозглашения независимости Туркменистана в 1991 году возможности для независимого наблюдения за соблюдением прав человека быстро сокращались. Уже в начале 1990-х правозащитная деятельность существовала главным образом как работа отдельных активистов, диссидентов и представителей немногочисленных общественных объединений, а не легально действующих специализированных организаций. Human Rights Watch отмечала , что к 1993 году число людей, открыто критиковавших власть, сократилось с нескольких тысяч в конце 1980-х до нескольких десятков. Правозащитники и оппозиционные активисты подвергались задержаниям, допросам, слежке, ограничениям на выезд, увольнениям, давление распространялось и на родственников. В условиях, когда собственно правозащитные объединения практически не могли существовать, частью независимого гражданского наблюдения становились экологические, культурные и другие общественные инициативы. Один из примеров — Дашогузский экологический клуб, к которому я присоединился в 1993 году и впоследствии стал его сопредседателем. Мы занимались не только экологией. Создали и поддерживали в 1995–1998 годах независимую общественную библиотеку, а в 2001–2002 годах организовали центр поддержки гражданских инициатив. Я одновременно участвовал в мониторинге положения с правами человека и сотрудничал с международными правозащитными структурами. Власть это раздражало. Одна из главных задач туркменских активистов заключалась уже не только в публичном протесте, но и в сборе информации и передаче её наружу — за пределы страны: сведений о задержанных, заключённых, судебных процессах, давлении на семьи и ограничении основных свобод. Закрытость страны одновременно делала такую информацию особенно ценной и чрезвычайно опасной для её источников. Между легендой и тюрьмой — Покушение на Ниязова произошло 25 ноября 2002 года. Насильственная смена власти — не редкость при диктатурах. У участников событий было оружие? — В книге есть описание, как они готовились, накануне вечером привезли оружие, и оно было при них на следующее утро. Затем последовали массовые аресты, закрытые судебные процессы и сообщения о пытках. По данным Международной Хельсинкской федерации по правам человека (МХФ) и «Мемориала», не менее 200 человек были задержаны, более 100 — обвинены. Власти официально сообщали о 67 арестованн

Газопровод Туркменистан — Китай действует с декабря 2009 года. Между странами достигнуты договоренности о прокладке четвертой линии газопровода Туркменистан — Узбекистан — Казахстан — Китай. Ежегодный объем поставок туркменского природного газа в Китай составляет около 40 млрд кубометров. body: Armenia faces 'apocalyptic' economic consequences if it leaves EAEU, opposition MP warns 22 October 2026 12:25 (UTC+04:00) Akbar Novruz Read more Armenia could face severe economic consequences if it withdraws from the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU), even if only half of the projected losses materialise, Armenian opposition lawmaker Artur Khachatryan has warned. Speaking to journalists, Khachatryan expressed concern over the potential economic and political implications of Armenia's departure from the Russia-led economic bloc, arguing that the country could suffer significant losses in trade, energy supplies and economic output. "Even if the calculations are only 50% accurate, the future that awaits us could truly be apocalyptic," he said. The lawmaker questioned suggestions that Armenian exporters could easily compensate for the loss of access to EAEU markets by redirecting their products to other countries. "I understand what is being said: that we won't just let these apricots go to waste—we will take them elsewhere and sell them, and the money will come back to us regardless," Khachatryan stated. He referred specifically to discussions about exporting Armenian agricultural products to Uzbekistan, expressing doubts about whether the available trade statistics supported such expectations. "I would like to look at some statistics, because there was talk about exporting apricots to Uzbekistan; I’ve seen the Uzbek statistics, and the figures don't quite align—there are some issues regarding Uzbekistan's statistics," he said. Khachatryan emphasised that the consequences of leaving the EAEU should not be assessed solely through economic calculations, arguing that political considerations and the loss of existing trade arrangements must also be taken into account. "Regardless, we need to understand that this involves not only economic calculations but also, primarily, political considerations. Specifically, what advantages would the Republic of Armenia lose if it were no longer a member of the EAEU?" he asked. The opposition politician referred to projections suggesting that Armenia's withdrawal could result in a GDP contraction of approximately 17%. "If the EAEU has projected, for instance, a significant GDP decline—let’s say around 17%—and even if the actual impact turns out to be half of that, it still represents a very serious problem," Khachatryan warned. He also raised concerns about Armenia's dependence on imported natural gas, suggesting that leaving the EAEU could complicate existing energy supply arrangements. Khachatryan argued that changes in commercial and political relations could affect not only the price of gas but also the volumes available to Armenia. "If we obtain the gas at that price—and what other option would there be if we didn't buy it?, the buyer might say, 'Fine, if it costs this much...' but the seller could respond, 'At that price, I’m only selling half the volume,'" he said. His remarks come amid renewed debate over Armenia's economic future following an EAEU assessment of the potential consequences of Yerevan leaving the organisation. Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan have reportedly examined the implications of Armenia's possible withdrawal, warning that the economic impact on Armenia could be substantial while the consequences for the remaining member states would be comparatively limited. Armenia has been a member of the EAEU since 2015 but has increasingly pursued closer relations with the European Union. In 2025, the Armenian Parliament adopted legislation initiating the country's EU accession process, prompting objections from Moscow and Minsk over the compatibility of membership in both economic frameworks. Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan has maintained that Armenia has not violated its obligations to the EAEU and has not made a formal decision to withdraw. Khachatryan's warning reflects concerns within Armenia's opposition over the economic risks of a potential departure, although the projected GDP losses remain estimates rather than confirmed outcomes. body: Home Central Asia Kazakhstan Kazakhstan, China's Guoyou sign $1B Kuryk port investment deal Kazakhstan News 22 October 2026 13:50 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Kazakhstan’s Baiterek Holding Company Alyona Pavlenko Journalist, International Desk Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 22. Kazakhstan’s Baiterek Holding Company has signed a memorandum of cooperation with China’s Guoyou Materials Group on an investment project worth $1 billion, according to the holding. The document was signed during the Kazakhstan Global Investment Roundtable 2026 (KGIR-2026) in Shymkent, chaired by Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov. The memorandum was signed by Baiterek Chairman of the Board Rustam Karagoishin and Guoyou Materials Group Chairman of the Board of Directors Yu Boyan. It covers cooperation on the construction of a multifunctional terminal as part of the first stage of the Kuryk Port development. The holding is considering comprehensive support for the project using the tools of its subsidiaries. "The Kuryk project provides for the creation of a multifunctional terminal with a capacity of 15 million tons of cargo per year at the first stage with the prospect of further expansion. The development of the port infrastructure will increase the possibilities of cargo transportation along the Trans-Caspian International Transport route, strengthen the transit potential of Kazakhstan and expand the access of domestic exporters to foreign markets", the holding said. The forum brought together representatives of government agencies, international financial institutions and foreign companies. The central theme of the plenary session was Kazakhstan’s new investment cycle, including the attraction of long-term capital and the implementation of projects in priority sectors of the economy. The Baiterek delegation is scheduled to hold talks with Guoyou Materials Group’s management to discuss the project’s financial model, possible support mechanisms and next steps. Guoyou Materials Group specializes in international trade, logistics and supply chain management. Headquartered in Tianjin, the group unites 33 subsidiaries. In Kazakhstan, it is represented by Kazakhstan Guoyou Investment, which implements a port and logistics project in the Mangystau region. He made the remarks during the session “Gas Monetization, Petrochemicals and Industrial Value Creation” at the 31st International Conference and Exhibition “Oil and Gas of Turkmenistan” (OGT 2026) in Ashgabat. At the same time, he added that the country is developing its transport and logistics infrastructure to expand exports of domestic products to global markets. According to him, Turkmen banks work exclusively with first-class banks that have high credit ratings and impose strict requirements for regulatory compliance and transaction transparency in their daily operations. “The banking sector is indeed focused on preventing restrictions-related issues and sanctions risks. That is why we operate with complete transparency: the banking sector is investing in new technologies that ensure transparency in daily transactions,” Jepbarov said. He clarified that software solutions are used to screen transactions against sanctions lists and monitor them to identify potential sanctions risks and restrictions. Meanwhile, the second day of the 31st International Conference and Exhibition “Oil and Gas of Turkmenistan” (OGT 2026) has begun in Ashgabat. As part of the event, a session is being held on the topic “Investment and development opportunities in the Turkmen sector of the Caspian Sea.” Discussions are focusing on investment opportunities for developing the Turkmen sector, prospects for offshore exploration and production of hydrocarbons, and the development of international partnerships. body: Home Azerbaijan Politics Azerbaijan’s parliament voices concern over French protest violence Politics News 22 October 2026 12:25 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Trend News Agency Alish Abdulla Parliamentary Correspondent Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 22. The Parliament of Azerbaijan (Milli Majlis) has expressed concern over the mass protests, police violence, injuries among minors, and mass arrests of peaceful demonstrators that took place in France in September-October 2026. This was reflected in the statement of the Parliament of the Republic of Azerbaijan on the mass protests and cases of human rights violations in France. The statement notes that the protests, which began in France over the situation in the education system, the rising cost of living, and social problems, spread to various cities across the country on October 17. According to official figures, 550,000 people took part in the demonstrations that day. Riots, arson, and looting in Paris, Marseille, Lyon, and other cities created serious problems for maintaining public order and ensuring the safety of citizens. The Parliament of Azerbaijan expressed particular concern over reports that minors were being subjected to police violence. It declared that the use of batons, tear gas, rubber bullets, and other special equipment against schoolchildren is unacceptable. Cases in which, as a result of police intervention, a 15-year-old boy in Lens lost a hand and a 17-year-old girl in Mulhouse lost the sight in one eye were highlighted as grounds for deep alarm. The statement notes that protecting the lives and health of children is a direct obligation of the state, and that the need to maintain public order cannot justify the use of disproportionate force against them. It stressed the importance of an independent and transparent investigation of such incidents. In the document, arrests during the mass protests (including those involving minors), restrictions on the freedom of movement of peaceful demonstrators, and bans on assemblies in certain cities were assessed as matters of concern from the standpoint of freedom of assembly. It is reported that around 2,400 people were detained in connection with the events of October 17. The Parliament of Azerbaijan called on the French authorities to respect the right of citizens to peaceful protest. The statement also draws attention to problems related to the protection of fundamental rights in France’s overseas territories. It reports that, following the riots, arson, and attacks on commercial premises that took place in Guadeloupe on the night of October 17-18, a curfew was imposed in some areas. In addition, concern was expressed over the state of fundamental rights of the Kanak population in New Caledonia, manifestations of discrimination, and the use of excessive force by law enforcement authorities. The Azerbaijani Parliament considers that the events taking place in France are not limited to a mere breach of public order, but reveal political and governance problems in the country, as well as difficulties in responding to social discontent and ensuring the security of citizens. The statement emphasizes that the French authorities have failed to protect both peaceful demonstrators from disproportionate police intervention and citizens and their property from violence during the riots. Moreover, Azerbaijani Parliament called on the French authorities to put an end to the use of disproportionate force against children and peaceful demonstrators, to conduct comprehensive investigations into incidents that resulted in serious injuries, to ensure that those responsible are held accountable, to protect the rights of detainees (especially minors), and to respect freedom of assembly. The statement also criticizes the position of the European Parliament and the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe regarding the events in France, and condemns selective approaches to human rights issues and double standards. In addition, the Milli Majlis expressed serious doubts that cases of police violence and human rights violations in France would be objectively investigated by national investigative and judicial bodies. For this reason, international organizations, primarily the UN Human Rights Council, were called upon to establish an independent international commission of inquiry. The Azerbaijani Parliament called on the French Parliament, international parliamentary organizations, and human rights institutions to take a firm stance on the recent events, to support an independent international investigation, and to demand that France comply with its international human rights obligations. body: Home Azerbaijan Azerbaijan’s Finance Ministry council backs digital public finance reform Azerbaijan News 22 October 2026 11:35 (UTC +04:00) Photo: Trend News Agency Sadig Javadov Economic Journalist Read more BAKU, Azerbaijan, October 22. Digitalization plays an important role in improving public finance management, increasing transparency and accountability, and reducing corruption risks, Ingilab Ahmadov, chairman of the Public Council under Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance, said, Trend 's correspondent reports from the event. Ahmadov made the remarks on Thursday at a conference in Baku dedicated to the digital transformation of public finance. He said the Public Council under the Ministry of Finance was established relatively recently and that the conference was its first event. According to Ahmadov, choosing digitalization as the subject of the inaugural event carries symbolic significance. He noted that digitalization is one of the key areas of ongoing reforms in Azerbaijan and plays a leading role in the reforms being carried out at the Finance Ministry. “Digitalization is a global trend and a reality of our time. In the financial sector, particularly in public finance management, digitalization is becoming one of the key pillars of sustainable socio-economic development,” he said. Ahmadov stressed that digitalizing public finance and fiscal policy is a fundamental transformation that improves the efficiency, transparency and responsiveness of the budget and tax system. This approach involves building mechanisms for collecting, allocating and managing public resources around modern technologies. According to him, digitalization is not merely a technological innovation in the financial sector, but also a strategic necessity and a source of competitive advantage. It also helps strengthen discipline in public finance management. “Digitalization is also a call for discipline. Discipline plays a key role in the efficient management of financial resources, particularly public funds,” Ahmadov noted. He added that digitalization could also help reduce state intervention in the economy. Excessive government regulation does not always produce positive results, he said, while automating financial operations reduces the need for state intervention and helps optimize processes in the public sector. Ahmadov also highlighted the role of digitalization in combating corruption. The use of objective criteria, data-driven fiscal decision-making and greater access to public procurement data can help reduce abuses, he said. “Undoubtedly, one of the most important issues for the public sector is the indispensable role digitalization plays in increasing transparency and accountability,” he stressed. The Public Council chairman noted that digitalization begins with data collection and the development of the necessary infrastructure, but does not end there. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) enable more effective analysis of digital data, process automation and new opportunities for decision-making. “If digitalization provides the necessary infrastructure for data, artificial intelligence offers the analytical power and automated decision-making capabilities that turn digital processes into intelligent systems,” Ahmadov said. He added that digitalization and AI not only minimize the influence of human factors in decision-making but also change the requirements for human capital. In this context, financial and technological literacy is becoming increasingly important.
